en: The Flower Adornment Sutra of the Buddha of Great Vaipulya, Scroll One.
Translated by the Tripitaka Master Śikṣānanda of Khotan by Imperial Decree.
Chapter One: The Sublime Array of the World Rulers.
Thus have I heard:
At one time, the Buddha was staying at the Bodhimanda in the forest retreat of Ārāḍa in the kingdom of Magadha, having newly attained perfect enlightenment.
That ground was firm, being composed of vajra.
It was adorned with supreme and wondrous jewel wheels, various precious flowers, and pure maṇi gems;
oceans of all manner of forms and marks appeared boundlessly;
maṇi banners constantly emitted radiance and perpetually produced sublime sounds; and nets of various jewels, along with garlands of exquisite fragrant flowers, were draped all around.
The sovereign maṇi-jewel king manifests with sovereign mastery, raining down inexhaustible jewels and various wondrous flowers scattered upon the ground;
rows of jewel trees stand in order, their branches and leaves lush and radiant.
By the spiritual power of the Buddha, all the adornments of this site of enlightenment were reflected therein.
That Bodhi tree was lofty, prominent, and extraordinary:
its trunk was made of diamond and its main stem of lapis lazuli.
Various exquisite jewels formed its branches;
precious leaves grew lush and dense, casting shade like clouds.
Jeweled flowers of diverse colors spread their shadows across the boughs, while *maṇi* gems served as its fruit, containing radiance and emitting flames, interspersed among the blossoms.

The circumference of that tree radiated light in all directions; from within that light, mani-jewels rained down, and from within those mani-jewels, hosts of bodhisattvas appeared simultaneously like clouds.
Furthermore, by the majestic spiritual power of the Tathāgata, that Bodhi tree constantly emits wondrous sounds, preaching various dharmas without end or limit.

The palaces and towers where the Tathāgata dwells are vast, magnificent, and pervasive throughout the ten directions; they are composed of mani-jewels of myriad colors and adorned with various precious flowers.
From these various ornaments, streams of light flow like clouds, and as shadows gather from within the palaces, they form banners.

The assemblies at the bodhimanda of boundless Bodhisattvas gathered there; it was adorned with a net made of inconceivable-sounding mani-jewel kings that manifest the light of all Buddhas, from which emerge all the realms of the Tathāgata’s sovereign power of spiritual transformations;
and the dwellings and houses of all sentient beings all appear as reflections within it.
Furthermore, through the empowerment of the spiritual power of all Buddhas, within a single thought-moment, he completely encompasses the entire Dharma-realm.
His lion throne is high, vast, and exquisitely beautiful:
its dais is made of mani-jewels, its canopy is a net of lotus flowers, its wheels are formed of pure and wondrous gems, and it is adorned with necklaces of various colored blossoms.
The halls, pavilions, towers, galleries, steps, and windows—all such objects and forms—are complete in their physical adornment;
jeweled trees with branches and fruits are arranged in rows all around.
Clouds of mani-jewel light shine upon one another;
the Buddhas of the ten directions manifest as pearls and jade;
and the wondrous jewels within the topknots of all Bodhisattvas emit radiance that comes to illuminate [the assembly] with brilliant clarity.

Furthermore, sustained by the majestic spiritual power of all Buddhas, he expounded upon the vast realm of the Tathāgata; his wondrous voice resonated far and wide, reaching everywhere without exception.

At that time, the World-Honored One sat upon this seat, having attained supreme perfect enlightenment regarding all dharmas; his wisdom entered the three periods of time as entirely equal, his body filled all worlds, and his voice universally accorded with the lands of the ten directions.
For example, just as space contains all forms yet makes no distinctions among any objects;
and just as space is omnipresent, entering equally into all lands.

His body constantly and universally occupies all sites of enlightenment (*bodhimaṇḍa*); amidst the assembly of bodhisattvas, his majestic radiance blazes forth like the rising sun, illuminating the world.
Having already purified the great ocean of merit from all practices throughout the three periods of time, he constantly manifests birth in the lands of all Buddhas.
With boundless forms and marks, perfect radiance pervades the entire dharma-realm without distinction;
it expounds all dharmas like the spreading of a great cloud.

Upon every single tip of a hair, they are able to contain all worlds without obstruction, each manifesting immeasurable powers of spiritual transformation to teach, convert, and subdue all sentient beings;
their bodies pervade the ten directions without coming or going, their wisdom enters into all phenomena, and they realize the emptiness and quiescence of all dharmas.
All the spiritual transformations of all Buddhas of the three periods of time were fully beheld within that radiance;
and all the inconceivable adornments of all Buddha-lands throughout inconceivable eons were made entirely manifest.
He was surrounded by bodhisattva-mahāsattvas as numerous as the atoms in ten buddha-worlds, whose names were:
the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Samantabhadra; the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Universal Virtue Supreme Lamp Radiance;
the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Universal Light Lion Banner; and the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Universal Jewel Flame Wondrous Light.
...the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Samantaghoṣaguṇasāgaradhvaja, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Samantajñānāvabhāsatathāgataviṣaya, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Samantaratanacūḍapuṣpadhvaja,
the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Samantasambodhimanojñasvara, and the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Samantapariśuddhākṣayapuṇyaprabha...
...the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Samantaprabhāsalakṣaṇa, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Sāgaracandraprabhamahātejas, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Meghasvarasāgaraprabhāvimalagarbha,
the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Guṇaratnacūḍajñānaja, and the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Guṇeśvararājamahāprabha.
[Sākyamuni], the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Suvīra-padma-śekhara, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Samantajñāna-megha-sūrya-dhvaja,
the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Mahāvīrya-vajra-ketu, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Gandhārciḥ-prabhā-dhvaja,
the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Mahāprabhāsa-gambhīra-manojña-ghoṣa, the Great... [and so forth].
The Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Puṇyaprabhā-jñānasaṃbhava...
with these as their leaders, there were as many as there are atoms in ten Buddha-worlds.
All these bodhisattvas had, in the past, together with the Tathāgata Vairocana, accumulated roots of goodness and cultivated the practices of a bodhisattva.
All have arisen from the ocean of the Tathāgata’s roots of goodness; they have fully perfected all the pāramitās;
their eye of wisdom is clear and penetrating, observing the three periods of time with equanimity;
and regarding all samādhis, they possess complete purity.
His eloquence is like the ocean, vast and inexhaustible;
he possesses the merits of a Buddha, majestic and worthy of veneration;
knowing the faculties of sentient beings, he transforms and subdues them according to what is appropriate.
Entering the treasury of the Dharma-realm, their wisdom is without differentiation;
they realize the liberation of the Buddhas, which is profoundly deep and vast;
able to enter the first stage through skillful means, they are sustained by the ocean of all vows and remain ever conjoined with wisdom until the end of the future.

Having realized the rare, vast, and secret realm of all Buddhas, they are well-versed in the equal Dharma of all Buddhas; having already trodden the Tathāgata’s stage of Universal Radiance, they enter the ocean-gates of immeasurable samādhis;
in all places, they manifest bodies in accordance with circumstances;
and in all worldly activities, they act in complete conformity with them.
Their dhāraṇīs are vast, gathering the ocean of all dharmas;
their eloquence is skillful, turning the non-retrogressive wheel;
and the great ocean of merits of all Tathāgatas enters entirely into their bodies.
They go to all the lands where all Buddhas reside, according to their vows;
they have already made offerings to all Buddhas throughout boundless eons with joy and without weariness;
and at the places where all Tathāgatas attain Bodhi, they always remain therein, drawing near and never forsaking them.
Constantly employing the ocean of Samantabhadra’s vows that they have attained, they cause all sentient beings to be fully endowed with the body of wisdom.
They thus accomplish such immeasurable merits.
Furthermore, there are Vajradhara spirits as numerous as the atoms within a Buddha-world, namely:

The Vajra-holding deity Subhavarṇanārāyaṇa; the Vajra-holding deity Sūryamaṇḍalāśugadhvaja; the Vajra-holding deity Merupuṣpābha; the Vajra-holding deity Vimalameghanirghoṣa; the Vajra-holding deity Surucitendriya; the Vajra-holding deity Priyadarśanaprabha; the Vajra-holding deity Mahāvṛkṣagarjitasvara; the Vajra-holding deity Siṃharājaprabha; the Vajra-holding deity Ghanajvālājayacakṣus; the Vajra-holding deity Padmaprabhamaṇicūḍa... [and so forth].

With these as their leaders, there were as many [bodhisattvas] as there are atoms in a buddha-world, all of whom had for immeasurable kalpas in the past constantly made great vows, vowing to always draw near to and make offerings to all Buddhas;
having fulfilled their practices according to those vows, they had reached the other shore;
they had accumulated boundless pure karmic merits and had attained complete clarity regarding the spheres of activity of all samādhis.
Having attained the power of spiritual penetrations, they abide together with the Tathāgatas and enter the inconceivable realm of liberation;
dwelling amidst the assemblies, their majestic radiance is preeminent, and they manifest in whatever forms are appropriate for sentient beings to subdue them;
wherever all Buddhas manifest emanated bodies, they follow those emanations to every place.
They constantly and diligently protect all the abodes where the Tathāgatas dwell. Furthermore, there are body-guarding spirits as numerous as the atoms within a Buddha-world, namely:

the Body-Guarding Spirits Adorned with Flower Topknots; the Body-Guarding Spirits Illuminating the Ten Directions; the Body-Guarding Spirits Subduing with Oceanic Sounds; the Body-Guarding Spirits with Pure Flower-Adorned Topknots; the Body-Guarding Spirits of Immeasurable Dignified Manner; the Body-Guarding Spirits Adorned with Supreme Light; the Body-Guarding Spirits of Pure Radiant Fragrant Clouds; the Body-Guarding Spirits Who Protect and Sustain; the Body-Guarding Spirits Who Universally Manifest and Gather; the Body-Guarding Spirits of Immovable Radiance; and so forth.

With these as their leaders, there were as many [bodhisattvas] as there are atoms in a Buddha-world, all of whom had accomplished great vows in the past and had made offerings to and served all Buddhas.
Furthermore, there were foot-following spirits as numerous as the atoms in a Buddha-world, namely:

the foot-following spirit Jewel-Seal Hand-and-Foot, the foot-following spirit Lotus-Light, the foot-following spirit Pure Flower Topknot, the foot-following spirit Gathering All Good Views, the foot-following spirit Wondrous Jewel Star Banner, the foot-following spirit Delighting in Emitting Sublime Sounds, the foot-following spirit Sandalwood Tree Light, the foot-following spirit Lotus Radiance, the foot-following spirit Subtle and Wondrous Radiance, and the foot-following spirit Accumulated Exquisite Flowers... [and so forth].

With these as their leaders, there were as many as there are atoms in a Buddha-world, all of whom had, throughout immeasurable kalpas in the past, drawn near to the Tathāgata and followed him without ever abandoning him.
Furthermore, there were bodhisattvas equal in number to the atoms within a buddha-world who were site-guardians (*maṇḍala-devatā*), namely:

the site-guardian Pure Adornment Banner, the site-guardian Sumeru Jewel Light, the site-guardian Thunder Sound Banner Mark, the site-guardian Flower Rain Subtle Eye, the site-guardian Flower Garland Radiant Topknot, the site-guardian Precious Rain Adornment, the site-guardian Courageous Fragrant Eye, the site-guardian Vajra Variegated Cloud, the site-guardian Lotus Radiance, and the site-guardian Sublime Light Illumination...

With these as their leaders, there were as many as atoms in a Buddha-world, all of whom had encountered immeasurable Buddhas in the past, perfected their power of vows, and extensively made offerings.
Furthermore, there were city-ruling spirits as numerous as the atoms in a Buddha-world, namely:

the City-Ruling Spirit Jewel Peak Radiance, the City-Ruling Spirit Exquisite Adornment Palace, the City-Ruling Spirit Pure Joyful Jewels, the City-Ruling Spirit Free from Sorrow and Pure, the City-Ruling Spirit Flower Lamp Flame Eye, the City-Ruling Spirit Manifesting the Brightness of the Flame Banner, the City-Ruling Spirit Abundant Merit Radiance, the City-Ruling Spirit Pure Radiance, the City-Ruling Spirit Fragrant Topknot Adornment, and the City-Ruling Spirit Exquisite Jewel Radiance...

With these as their leaders, there were as many [bodhisattvas] as there are atoms in a Buddha-world, all of whom, throughout immeasurable and inconceivable eons, had adorned and purified the palaces where the Tathāgatas dwell.

Furthermore, there were earth-ruling goddesses as numerous as the atoms in a buddha-world, namely: the Earth-Ruling Goddess Universal Virtue Pure Flower; the Earth-Ruling Goddess Firm Merit Adornment;

the Earth-Ruling Goddess Exquisite Flower Adorned Tree; the Earth-Ruling Goddess Universally Scattering All Jewels; the Earth-Ruling Goddess Pure Eyes Observing the Seasons; the Earth-Ruling Goddess Exquisite Color Supreme Eye; the Earth-Ruling Goddess Fragrant Hair Emitting Light; the Earth-Ruling Goddess Pleasing Sound; the Earth-Ruling Goddess Exquisite Flower Swirling Topknot; the Earth-Ruling Goddess Vajra-Adorned Body; and so forth.

With these as their leaders, there were as many as atoms in a buddha-world, all of whom had in the past made profound and solemn vows, vowing to always draw near to the Buddhas, the Tathāgatas, and together cultivate meritorious deeds.
Furthermore, there were immeasurable mountain-ruling spirits, namely:

the Mountain-Ruling Spirit Jewel-Peak Blooming-Flower; the Mountain-Ruling Spirit Flower-Forest Wondrous-Crest; the Mountain-Ruling Spirit High-Banner Universally Illuminating; the Mountain-Ruling Spirit Dust-Free Pure-Crest; the Mountain-Ruling Spirit Light-Illuminating the Ten Directions; the Mountain-Ruling Spirit Great-Power Radiance; the Mountain-Ruling Spirit Majestic-Light Universally Victorious; the Mountain-Ruling Spirit Subtle-Dense Light-Wheel; the Mountain-Ruling Spirit Universal-Eye Manifestly Seeing; the Mountain-Ruling Spirit Vajra-Dense-Eye; and so forth.
These and others were the leaders, numbering in the infinite, all of whom had attained the pure eye regarding all dharmas.
Furthermore, there were forest-deity kings (*vanavasinī-devatā*) of inconceivable number, namely:

the Forest-Deity King Cloud-like Flower-Spreader; the Forest-Deity King Stem-Erecting Light-Radiating; the Forest-Deity King Sprout-Bearing Radiance-Arising; the Forest-Deity King Auspicious Pure Leaf; the Forest-Deity King Hanging Flame-Treasury; the Forest-Deity King Pure Radiance; the Forest-Deity King Pleasing Thunder-Sound; the Forest-Deity King Universal Pervasion of Light and Fragrance; the Forest-Deity King Wondrous Light-Reverting Radiance; and the Forest-Deity King Flower-Fruit Light-Taste... [and so forth].
These and others were the leaders, numbering in inconceivable quantities, each possessing immeasurable and lovely radiance.
Furthermore, there were immeasurable medicinal lord spirits (*bhaiṣajya-devī*), namely:

the Medicinal Lord Spirit Auspiciousness, the Medicinal Lord Spirit Sandalwood Forest, the Medicinal Lord Spirit Pure Radiance, the Medicinal Lord Spirit Universal Renown, the Medicinal Lord Spirit Pore Radiance, the Medicinal Lord Spirit Universal Purification, the Medicinal Lord Spirit Great Roaring Sound, the Medicinal Lord Spirit Banner Outshining the Sun, the Medicinal Lord Spirit Clearly Seeing the Ten Directions, and the Medicinal Lord Spirit Benefiting Vitality and Clarifying the Eyes...

These were the leaders, numbering in the infinite, all of whom were by nature free from defilement and benevolently protected all beings. Furthermore, there were immeasurable field-protecting deities (*sasyādhipati-deva*), namely: the Field-Protecting Deity of Soft and Supreme Flavor; the Field-Protecting Deity of Pure Radiance of Seasonal Flowers;

the Field-Protecting Deity of Vigorous Strength of Physical Form; the Field-Protecting Deity of Increasing Vital Energy; the Field-Protecting Deity of Universally Producing Roots and Fruits; the Field-Protecting Deity of the Beautifully Adorned Circular Topknot; the Field-Protecting Deity of Moistening Pure Flowers; the Field-Protecting Deity of Accomplishing Sublime Fragrance; the Field-Protecting Deity Loved by All Who Behold Them; the Field-Protecting Deity of Stainless Pure Radiance... [and so forth].
These and others were their leaders, numbering in the infinite, all of whom had attained the accomplishment of great joy.
Furthermore, there were immeasurable river-gods, namely: the River-God Universal Emission of Swift Currents;

the River-God Universal Purification of Springs and Streams; the River-God Dust-Free Pure Eye; the River-God Universal Roar in the Ten Directions; the River-God Protector and Savior of Sentient Beings; the River-God Heatless Pure Radiance; the River-God Universal Birth of Joy; the River-God Banner of Vast Virtue; the River-God Light Illumining All Worlds; the River-God Ocean-Virtue Radiance; and so forth.
With these as their leaders, there were immeasurable numbers of them, all diligently applying their minds to benefit sentient beings.
Furthermore, there were immeasurable sea-governing spirits, namely:

the Sea-Governing Spirit Manifesting Jewel Light; the Sea-Governing Spirit Accomplishing the Vajra Banner; the Sea-Governing Spirit Far Removed from Dust and Defilement; the Sea-Governing Spirit Universal Palace of Waters; the Sea-Governing Spirit Auspicious Jewel Moon; the Sea-Governing Spirit Exquisite Flower Dragon Topknot; the Sea-Governing Spirit Universally Sustaining the Flavor of Light; the Sea-Governing Spirit Jewel Flame Flower Light; the Sea-Governing Spirit Vajra Exquisite Topknot; and the Sea-Governing Spirit Thunderous Sound of the Ocean Tide...
These and others were the leaders, numbering in the infinite, all of whom had their bodies filled by the great ocean of the Tathāgata’s merits.

Furthermore, there were immeasurable water-ruling spirits (*udaka-devatā*), namely: the water-ruling spirit Cloud-Banner Universally Arising; the water-ruling spirit Ocean-Tide-Cloud-Sound; the water-ruling spirit Wondrous-Colored-Crest; the water-ruling spirit Skillful Whirlpool; the water-ruling spirit Stainless Fragrance-Accumulation; the water-ruling spirit Merit-Bridge-Light-Sound; the water-ruling spirit Contentment-Sovereignty; the water-ruling spirit Pure-Joy-Excellent-Sound; the water-ruling spirit Universally-Manifesting-Majestic-Light; the water-ruling spirit Roaring-Sound-Pervading-the-Ocean... [and so forth].
These and others were their leaders, numbering in the infinite, constantly and diligently protecting all sentient beings for their benefit.
Furthermore, there were countless fire-governing spirits (*tejorājadevatā*), namely:

the Fire-Governing Spirit Universal Radiant Flame-Treasury; the Fire-Governing Spirit Banner of Universally Assembled Light; the Fire-Governing Spirit Great Light Universally Illuminating; the Fire-Governing Spirit Myriad Wondrous Palaces; the Fire-Governing Spirit Inexhaustible Light Topknot; the Fire-Governing Spirit Various Flames-Eyes; the Fire-Governing Spirit Palace of the Ten Directions Like Mount Sumeru; the Fire-Governing Spirit Sovereign Majestic Light; the Fire-Governing Spirit Radiance Dispelling Darkness; and the Fire-Governing Spirit Thunder-Sound Lightning-Light. [...]
With these as their leaders, they were beyond counting; all were able to manifest various kinds of light, causing the burning afflictions of all sentient beings to be extinguished.

Furthermore, there were immeasurable wind-ruling spirits, namely: the wind-ruling spirit Unobstructed Radiance; the wind-ruling spirit Universal Manifestation of Heroic Power; the wind-ruling spirit Cloud Banner Whipping; the wind-ruling spirit Adorned with Pure Light; the wind-ruling spirit Power Able to Exhaust Water; the wind-ruling spirit Great Sound Roaring Everywhere; the wind-ruling spirit Topknot Hanging from Tree Toppers; the wind-ruling spirit Unobstructed in All Movements; the wind-ruling spirit Various Palaces; the wind-ruling spirit Great Light Shining Universally; and so forth.
With these as their leaders, they were immeasurable in number, all diligently dispersing and extinguishing the mind of self-conceit (*māna*).
Furthermore, there were immeasurable space-ruling spirits (*ākāśadevatā*), namely:

the Space-Ruling Spirit Pure Light Shining Everywhere; the Space-Ruling Spirit Wandering Universally in Profundity and Breadth; the Space-Ruling Spirit Producing Auspicious Winds; the Space-Ruling Spirit Abiding Free from Obstructions; the Space-Ruling Spirit Vast Steps and Sublime Topknot; the Space-Ruling Spirit Unobstructed Radiance; the Space-Ruling Spirit Unobstructed Supreme Power; the Space-Ruling Spirit Stainless Radiance; the Space-Ruling Spirit Profound and Distant Sublime Sound; the Space-Ruling Spirit Light Pervading the Ten Directions... [and so forth].
These and others were their leaders, numbering in the infinite, all of whom had minds free from defilement, vast, luminous, and pure.
Furthermore, there were immeasurable directional guardian deities (*dig-pāla-devatā*), namely:

the Universal Dweller Everywhere Directional Guardian Deity, the Universally Manifesting Radiance Directional Guardian Deity, the Radiant Conduct Adornment Directional Guardian Deity, the Unobstructed Wandering Everywhere Directional Guardian Deity, the Permanently Severing Delusion Directional Guardian Deity, the Universally Roaming Pure Space Directional Guardian Deity, the Great Cloud Banner Sound Directional Guardian Deity, the Unturbid Topknot-Eye Directional Guardian Deity, the Universally Observing Worldly Beings Directional Guardian Deity, and the Universally Roaming and Surveying Directional Guardian Deity...
With these as their leaders, they were infinite in number; through skillful means, they universally emitted radiance that constantly illuminated the ten directions in an uninterrupted succession.
Furthermore, there were immeasurable night goddesses, namely:

the Night Goddess Universal Virtue Pure Light; the Night Goddess Joyful Eye Beholding the World; the Night Goddess Protecting the Vital Energy of the World; the Night Goddess Silent Ocean Sound; the Night Goddess Universally Manifesting Auspiciousness; the Night Goddess Universally Producing Tree Blossoms; the Night Goddess Equanimous Protection and Nurturing; the Night Goddess Sporting in Happiness; the Night Goddess Constant Joy of All Faculties; the Night Goddess Producing Pure Blessings; and so forth.

These and others were their leaders, numbering in the infinite, all of whom diligently practiced and took delight in the Dharma. Furthermore, there were immeasurable Day-Governing Deities (*divā-viṣaya-devatā*), such as: the Day-Governing Deity Manifesting Palaces; the Day-Governing Deity Initiating the Fragrance of Wisdom;

the Day-Governing Deity Delighting in Supreme Adornments; the Day-Governing Deity Sublime Light of Fragrant Flowers; the Day-Governing Deity Universally Gathering Wondrous Medicines; the Day-Governing Deity Delighting in Creating Joyful Eyes; the Day-Governing Deity Universally Appearing in All Directions; the Day-Governing Deity Radiance of Great Compassion; the Day-Governing Deity Illumination of the Light of Roots of Goodness; and the Day-Governing Deity Wondrous Flower Garlands. [...]

With these as their leaders, they were infinite in number; all were able to give rise to faith and understanding in the sublime Dharma, and together they constantly applied themselves with diligence to adorning their palaces.
Furthermore, there were immeasurable asura kings, namely:

Rāhu Asura King, Vemacitra Asura King, Skillful Illusionist Asura King, Great Retinue Asura King, Great Power Asura King, Universal Illuminator Asura King, Firm Practice of Sublime Adornment Asura King, Vast Causal Wisdom Asura King, Manifestation of Supreme Virtue Asura King, and Exquisite Sound Asura King...
With these as their leaders, there were immeasurable numbers of them, all of whom had diligently subdued their pride and various afflictions.
Furthermore, there were inconceivable numbers of Garuḍa kings, namely:

the Garuḍa King Great Swift Power, the Garuḍa King Indestructible Jewel Topknot, the Garuḍa King Pure Swift Speed, the Garuḍa King Non-retrogressive Mind, the Garuḍa King Sustaining Power of the Great Ocean Abode, the Garuḍa King Firm Pure Light, the Garuḍa King Skillfully Adorned Crown Topknot, the Garuḍa King Universal Manifestation of Quickness, the Garuḍa King Universally Surveying the Ocean, and the Garuḍa King Universal Sound and Broad Eyes...
With these as their leaders, they were inconceivable in number; all had already perfected the power of great skillful means and were well able to rescue and gather in all sentient beings.
Furthermore, there were immeasurable kinnara kings, namely:

the Kinnara King Light of Good Wisdom, the Kinnara King Wondrous Flower Banner, the Kinnara King Various Adornments, the Kinnara King Pleasing Roar, the Kinnara King Radiance of Jewel Trees, the Kinnara King Joy for All Who See, the Kinnara King Adorned with Supreme Light, the Kinnara King Subtle and Wondrous Flower Banner, the Kinnara King Power to Shake the Earth, and the Kinnara King Subduing Evil Multitudes...
With these as their leaders, they were infinite in number; all were diligent and energetic in contemplating all phenomena, their minds constantly joyful as they sported with sovereign ease.
Furthermore, there were immeasurable mahoraga kings, namely:

the Mahoraga King Good Wisdom, the Mahoraga King Pure Majestic Sound, the Mahoraga King Victorious Wisdom Adorned Topknot, the Mahoraga King Sovereign of Wondrous Eyes, the Mahoraga King Lamp Banner to Whom All Turn, the Mahoraga King Supreme Radiance Banner, the Mahoraga King Lion Chest, the Mahoraga King Sound Adorned with Myriad Wonders, the Mahoraga King Firm as Mount Sumeru, and the Mahoraga King Delightful Radiance...
With these as their leaders, they were infinite in number; all diligently practiced vast skillful means to cause all sentient beings to forever sever the net of ignorance.
Furthermore, there were immeasurable yakṣa kings, namely:

Vaiśravaṇa Yakṣa King, Sovereign Sound Yakṣa King, Adorned with Weapons Yakṣa King, Great Wisdom Yakṣa King, Lord of Flaming Eyes Yakṣa King, Vajra Eye Yakṣa King, Brave and Strong Arm Yakṣa King, Valiant Enemy of Great Armies Yakṣa King, Wealthy Resources Yakṣa King, and Power that Demolishes High Mountains Yakṣa King...
With these as their leaders, there were immeasurable numbers of them, all diligently protecting all sentient beings.
Furthermore, there were immeasurable great dragon kings, namely:

the Dragon King Vairocana, the Dragon King Sāgara, the Dragon King Meghasvaraghoṣavicitradhvaja, the Dragon King Jvālāmukhasāgaraprabha, the Dragon King Samantocchrayameghadhvaja, the Dragon King Takṣaka, the Dragon King Anantapada, the Dragon King Viśuddhavarṇa, the Dragon King Samantavāhanamahārava, and the Dragon King Anavatapta...

With these as their leaders, they were infinite in number; there was not one among them who did not diligently exert effort to raise clouds and spread rain, causing the burning afflictions of all sentient beings to be extinguished.
Furthermore, there were immeasurable kumbhāṇḍa kings, namely:

the kumbhāṇḍa king Vardhana, the kumbhāṇḍa king Nāgendra, the kumbhāṇḍa king Suvyūhita-dhvaja, the kumbhāṇḍa king Samantopakārī-caryā, the kumbhāṇḍa king Atibhīṣaṇa, the kumbhāṇḍa king Surucira-viśuddha-nayana, the kumbhāṇḍa king Uccagiri-mati, the kumbhāṇḍa king Vikrāntabhuja, the kumbhāṇḍa king Ananta-viśuddha-padmanetra, and the kumbhāṇḍa king Mahādeva-mukha-asura-nayana...
With these as their leaders, there were immeasurable numbers of them, all of whom diligently studied the Dharma-gate of Non-obstruction and emitted great radiance.
Furthermore, there were immeasurable gandharva kings, namely:

the Gandharva King Dhṛtarāṣṭra, the Gandharva King Vṛkṣaprabha, the Gandharva King Viśuddhanetra, the Gandharva King Puṣpamakuṭa, the Gandharva King Samantaghoṣa, the Gandharva King Rucirakampitavicitranetra, the Gandharva King Manojñasimhadhvaja, the Gandharva King Samantaratnaprabhāsa, the Gandharva King Vajravṛkṣapuṣpadhvaja, and the Gandharva King Ruciralakṣaṇasamantadarśana. [...]

With these as their leaders, they were immeasurable in number; all had conceived deep faith and understanding in the Great Dharma, regarding it with joy and reverence, and practicing it diligently without weariness.
Furthermore, there were immeasurable Moon Devas, namely: the Moon Deva; the Deva Flower-King-Tuft-Radiance;

the Deva Multitude-Sublime-Pure-Radiance; the Deva Peace-and-Happiness-in-the-World-Mind; the Deva Tree-King-Eye-Radiance; the Deva Manifestation-of-Pure-Light; the Deva Universal-Wandering-Immovable-Light; the Deva Constellation-King-Sovereign; the Deva Pure-Awakening-Moon; the Deva Great-Majesty-Virtue-Radiance... and so forth.
These and others were their leaders, numbering in the infinite, all diligently manifesting the jewel of the sentient beings' minds.
Furthermore, there were immeasurable Sun Devas (Sūryadevaputra), namely:

the Sun Deva; the Deva Light-Flame-Eye; the Deva Sumeru-Light-Terrifying-Venerable-Banner; the Deva Stainless-Jewel-Adornment; the Deva Valiant-Non-Retrogression; the Deva Wondrous-Flower-Garland-Luminous; the Deva Supreme-Banner-Luminous; the Deva Jewel-Crest-Universal-Luminous; the Deva Luminous-Eye; the Deva Sustainer-of-Superior-Virtue; and the Deva Universal-Luminous. [...]
These and others were the leaders, their number being immeasurable; all of them diligently practiced to benefit sentient beings and increase their roots of goodness.
Furthermore, there were immeasurable kings of the Trāyastriṃśa Heaven, namely:

Śakrendra, Universal Renown Full Sound, Compassionate Eye Jewel-Crest, Jewel-Light Banner Renowned Name, Producing Joyful Bliss Crest, Delightful Right Mindfulness, Sumeru Supreme Sound, Accomplished Mindfulness, Delightful Pure Flower Light, Wisdom-Sun Eye, and Sovereign Radiance Capable of Awakening. [...]
With these as their leaders, they were immeasurable in number, all diligently undertaking vast activities for the sake of all worlds.
Furthermore, there were immeasurable Suyāma Heavenly Kings, namely:

the Heavenly King Śubhakāla, the Heavenly King Priyadarśanaprabhāsa, the Heavenly King Akṣayamati-guṇadhvaja, the Heavenly King Suvikurvaṇa-sundara, the Heavenly King Dhāraṇī-mahāprabha, the Heavenly King Acintya-jñāna, the Heavenly King Cakrāṅka, the Heavenly King Arciḥprabha, the Heavenly King Ābhāsaprabha, and the Heavenly King Samantavyūha-mahāyaśas...
These and others were their leaders, numbering in the infinite, all of whom had diligently cultivated vast roots of goodness and whose minds were ever contented.
Furthermore, there were inconceivable numbers of Tuṣita Heaven kings, namely:

King Saṃtuṣita (Contented), King Ratisāgaracūḍa (Sea-Crest of Joy), King Varaguṇadhvaja (Banner of Supreme Virtue), King Śāntaprabha (Tranquil Light), King Priyadarśanamanojña (Delightful and Lovely Eyes), King Ratnaśikharaviśuddhacandra (Pure Moon of the Jewel Peak), King Varavīryabaladharin (Possessor of Supreme Heroic Power), King Vajrasuprabhāsvara (Vajra of Sublime Radiance), King Jyotirvyūhadhvaja (Banner Adorned with Constellations), and King Priyadarśanavyūha (Adornment of Delightful Appearance)….
With these as their leaders, there were inconceivable numbers [of deities], all of whom diligently recited and maintained the names of all Buddhas.
Furthermore, there were immeasurable kings of the Heaven of Delight in Emanation (*Nirmāṇarati*), namely:

the King of Heaven Skillful Transformation, the King of Heaven Radiance of Tranquil Sound, the King of Heaven Radiance of Transformative Power, the King of Heaven Lord of Adornments, the King of Heaven Light of Mindfulness, the King of Heaven Supreme Cloud-Sound, the King of Heaven Most Victorious Light of Myriad Wonders, the King of Heaven Radiance of the Beautiful Topknot, the King of Heaven Accomplished Joyful Wisdom, the King of Heaven Flower-Light Topknot, and the King of Heaven Universally Beholding the Ten Directions...
These were the leaders, numbering in the infinite, all of whom diligently subdued all sentient beings to bring them to liberation.
Furthermore, there were countless kings of the Heaven of Making Use of Others' Transformations (*paranirmita-vaśavartin*), namely:

King Sovereign Mastery, King Lord of Wondrous Eyes, King Wondrous Crown Banner, King Courageous Wisdom, King Wondrous Sound Phrases, King Wondrous Light Banner, King Gate of the Tranquil Realm, King Adorned Banner of the Wondrous Wheel, King Sovereign Wisdom of Flower Calyx, and King Indra-Power Wondrously Adorned Radiance. [...]
These and others were the leaders, numbering in the infinite, all of whom diligently practiced the vast Dharma-gates of sovereign skillful means.
Furthermore, there were incalculable Great Brahma Kings, namely:

King Śikhin, King Prajñāprabha, King Sudharmaprabhāsa, King Samantameghasvara, King Lokeśvararutasvara, King Śāntaprabhānetra, King Prabhāvyāptadaśadik, King Nirmāṇasvara, King Prabhābhāsuranetra, and King Manojñasāgarasvara...
With these as their leaders, they were beyond counting; all were endowed with great compassion, feeling pity for sentient beings, emitting light that shone everywhere to bring them joy.
Furthermore, there were immeasurable kings of the Ābhāsvara Heaven, namely:

King Lovely and Delightful Light, King Pure and Sublime Light, King Sovereign Sound, King Supreme Mindfulness and Wisdom, King Lovely and Delightful Pure Sublime Sound, King Well-Considered Sound, King Universal Sound Illuminating Everywhere, King Profound Light-Sound, King Stainless Renown Light, and King Supreme Pure Light...
These and others were their leaders, numbering in the infinite, all of whom dwelt in the vast, tranquil, joyful, and unimpeded Dharma-gate.
Furthermore, there were immeasurable kings of the Śubhakṛtsna Heaven, namely:

the King of Heaven Pure Renown, the King of Heaven Supreme Vision, the King of Heaven Tranquil Virtue, the King of Heaven Sumeru Sound, the King of Heaven Pure Mindful Eye, the King of Heaven Lovely and Delightful Supreme Radiance, the King of Heaven Sovereign Lord of the World, the King of Heaven Sovereign of Light-Flames, the King of Heaven Joyful Contemplation of Dharma Transformations, the King of Heaven Transformation Banner, and the King of Heaven Exquisite Adornment of Celestial Sounds...
With these as their leaders, they were immeasurable in number; all had already established themselves in the vast Dharma-gates and were diligently working for the benefit of all worlds.
Furthermore, there were immeasurable kings of the Bṛhatphala Heaven, namely:

the Deva King Banner of Delight in the Light of Dharma, the Deva King Ocean of Pure Adornments, the Deva King Light of Supreme Wisdom, the Deva King Banner of Sovereign Wisdom, the Deva King Delighting in Tranquility, the Deva King Universal Eye of Wisdom, the Deva King Delighting in Revolving Wisdom, the Deva King Light of Wisdom from Good Seeds, the Deva King Stainless Tranquil Light, and the Deva King Vast Pure Light...
With these as their leaders, they were infinite in number; there was not one among them who did not dwell within palaces formed of the dharma of tranquility.
Furthermore, there were countless Great Maheśvara Heavenly Kings, namely: the Heavenly King Wondrous Flame Ocean;

the Heavenly King Sovereign Renown Light; the Heavenly King Pure Merit Eye; the Heavenly King Delightful Great Wisdom; the Heavenly King Immovable Light Sovereignty; the Heavenly King Wondrous Adornment Eye; the Heavenly King Light of Good Contemplation; the Heavenly King Delightful Great Knowledge; the Heavenly King Universal Sound Adorned Banner; and the Heavenly King Light of Supreme Diligence Renown... [and so forth].
With these as their leaders, they were beyond counting; all diligently observed the dharma of signlessness, and their conduct was equal.
*The Great Vaipulya Buddha Avataṃsaka Sūtra*, Fascicle One.
*The Great Vaipulya Buddha Avataṃsaka Sūtra*, Fascicle Two.
Translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Śikṣānanda of Khotan by Imperial Decree,
Part Two of the First Chapter, "The Sublime Adornment of the Second Lord of the World.
At that time, the ocean-like assembly at the Tathāgata’s place of enlightenment had all gathered like clouds.
Of infinite varieties, they filled the space on all sides;
distinguished by their forms and colors, each group remained distinct;
coming from their respective directions, they drew near to the World-Honored One and gazed upon him with single-minded devotion.

This entire assembly has already abandoned all defilements of the mind and their residual habitual tendencies; having shattered the mountain of heavy obstructions, they behold the Buddha without hindrance.
This is because, in times past, during oceans of kalpas, Vairocana Tathāgata cultivated the practices of a bodhisattva and gathered them in through the four means of attraction (*saṃgrahavastu*);

at each stage when he planted roots of goodness under various Buddhas, he skillfully employed diverse expedient means to teach, transform, and bring them to maturity, establishing them upon the path to omniscience.
They have planted immeasurable roots of goodness and attained manifold great merits, having fully entered the ocean of skillful means and vows;
their practiced conduct is perfectly pure,
and they have already been able to skillfully emerge upon the path of renunciation.
They constantly behold the Buddhas with clear and distinct illumination;
through the power of resolute conviction, they enter the great ocean of the Tathāgatas' merits and attain the gateways of liberation of all Buddhas, sporting in supernormal powers.
They were as follows:
the Great Lord Heavenly King Sublime Flame Ocean attained the liberation door of the power of skillful means for the tranquility of the dharma-realm and the space-realm;
the Heavenly King Sovereign Renown Light attained the liberation door of universally observing all phenomena with complete mastery.
The Celestial King Pure Merit-Eye attained the liberation door of the effortless practice that realizes all phenomena are neither born nor extinguished, neither coming nor going;
the Celestial King Delightful Great Wisdom attained the liberation door of the ocean of wisdom that directly perceives the true reality of all phenomena;
and the Celestial King Sovereign Immovable Light attained the liberation door of the great skillful means of meditative concentration that bestows boundless peace and happiness upon sentient beings.
The Celestial King Sublime Adorned Eye attained the liberation door of causing the observation of quiescent dharmas to extinguish all darkness of delusion and fear;
the Celestial King Light of Excellent Contemplation attained the liberation door of skillfully entering boundless realms without giving rise to any thoughts of existence;
the Celestial King Great Wisdom Delightful attained the liberation door of traveling everywhere throughout the ten directions to preach the Dharma while remaining unmoving and without dependence.
The Celestial King Universal Sound Adorned Banner attained the liberation door of entering the Buddha’s realm of tranquility and universally manifesting radiance;
the Celestial King Renowned Light of Virtuous Diligence attained the liberation door of abiding in the place of his own realization while taking infinite, vast realms as his object of focus.
At that time, the Celestial King Ocean of Wondrous Flames, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed all the hosts of the Sovereign Gods (*Īśvara*) and spoke in verse:
“The Buddha-body pervades all great assemblies, Filling the Dharma-realm without end;
Quiescent, without self-nature, and ungraspable, He appears for the sake of saving the world.”
The Tathāgata, King of Dharma, has appeared in the world, Able to light the wondrous lamp of Dharma that illuminates the world;
His realm is boundless and inexhaustible— This is what is realized by the one named Sovereign.
The Buddha is inconceivable and free from conceptualization; He thoroughly understands that the marks of the ten directions are non-existent.
For the sake of the world, he widely opens the path of purity; One with such pure eyes is able to behold this.
The Tathāgata’s wisdom is boundless; no one in all the worlds can fathom it.
It forever extinguishes the deluded and darkened minds of sentient beings; Great Wisdom enters this depth and dwells therein securely.
The Tathāgata’s merit is inconceivable; those sentient beings who behold him have their afflictions extinguished.
He causes all the world to attain peace and happiness—this the sovereign Akaniṣṭha deva is able to see.
Sentient beings are constantly deluded and obscured by the darkness of ignorance; the Tathāgata preaches for them the Dharma of tranquility.
This is the lamp of wisdom that illuminates the world, a sublime eye capable of knowing this skillful means.
The Tathāgata’s pure and wondrous form-body appears universally throughout the ten directions without peer;
this body is without intrinsic nature and has no place of dependence, as observed by the Deva of Skillful Contemplation.
The Tathāgata’s voice is without limit or obstruction;
Those capable of being transformed hear it all, yet the Buddha remains tranquil and ever unmoving— This is the liberation of the Deva of Joyful Wisdom.
Tranquil in liberation, Lord of gods and men, you appear before all beings throughout the ten directions;
with light illuminating and filling the world, this is the vision of the Unobstructed Dharma-Adorned Banner.
Throughout an ocean of boundless great kalpas, the Buddha sought Bodhi for the sake of sentient beings;
through various supernatural powers he transformed all, and the deity Renowned Light realized this Dharma.

Furthermore, the Celestial King Banner of the Radiance of Dharma Delightful to Behold attained the liberation door of universally observing the faculties of all sentient beings to preach the Dharma and sever their doubts;
the Celestial King Sea of Pure Adornments attained the liberation door of causing [beings] to see the Buddha according to their recollections;
and the Celestial King Light of Supreme Wisdom attained the liberation door of adorning the body through the equality of the nature of phenomena, which is without dependence.
The Celestial King Sovereign Wisdom Banner attained the liberation door of knowing all worldly phenomena and establishing inconceivable oceans of adornments within a single thought-moment;
the Celestial King Delighting in Tranquility attained the liberation door of manifesting inconceivable Buddha-lands within a single pore without obstruction;
and the Celestial King Universal Wisdom Eye attained the liberation door of entering universal gates to observe the dharma-realm.
The Celestial King Joyful Revolving Wisdom attained the liberation door of manifesting in various forms for all sentient beings, remaining ever-present throughout boundless eons;
the Celestial King Light of the Radiance of Good Roots attained the liberation door of observing all worldly realms and entering the inconceivable Dharma;
the Celestial King Stainless Tranquil Light attained the liberation door of demonstrating the methods of transcendence to all sentient beings.
The Celestial King Vast Pure Light attained the liberation door of observing all sentient beings who are to be transformed, causing them to enter the Buddha-dharma.

At that time, the Celestial King Banner of the Radiance of Delightful Dharmas, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed all the assemblies of the Parīttābha, Apramāṇābha, and Bṛhatphala devas, and spoke in verse:
“The realm of the Buddhas is inconceivable; No sentient beings can fathom it.”
Universally causing their minds to give rise to faith and understanding, with vast aspirations that are inexhaustible.

If there are sentient beings capable of receiving the Dharma, the Buddha’s majestic spiritual power guides them, causing them to constantly behold the Buddha appearing before them; thus did the Celestial King Ocean of Adornments see.
The nature of all phenomena has no basis; the Buddha’s appearance in the world is likewise.
He is universally without a place of dependence within all states of existence; this meaning can be observed by superior wisdom.
According to the desires of the minds of all sentient beings, The Buddha’s power of spiritual transformations can manifest them all;
Each is distinct and inconceivable— This is the ocean of liberation of the King of Wisdom Banner.
All the lands that have existed in the past are manifested within a single pore;
this is the great supernormal power of all Buddhas, which those who delight in tranquility are able to proclaim.
The inexhaustible ocean of all dharma-gates Gathers together within the single dharma-site;
Such is the nature of dharmas as taught by the Buddha— Only the eye of wisdom can clarify this skillful means.
In all the lands throughout the ten directions, he preaches the Dharma within them all;
the Buddha-body neither departs nor arrives—this is the realm of the wheel of joyful wisdom.
The Buddha contemplates the world’s phenomena as like reflections and shadows; Entering those most profound and obscure depths, he proclaims that the nature of all dharmas is eternally quiescent;
Those with virtuous seeds who practice right reflection can perceive this.
The Buddha thoroughly understands all realms of experience; according to the faculties of sentient beings, he rains down the rain of Dharma.
To reveal the inconceivable gateway to liberation, the deva Śāntideva is able to awaken to and enter this.
The World-Honored One, ever with great compassion, appears to benefit sentient beings;
like rain falling equally upon all vessels, the Pure Radiance Heaven is able to proclaim this.
Furthermore, the Celestial King Renowned for Pure Wisdom attained the liberation door of skillful means for realizing the path of liberation for all sentient beings;
the Celestial King Supreme Vision attained the liberation door of universally manifesting according to the inclinations of all celestial hosts like reflections and shadows;
and the Celestial King Tranquil Virtue attained the liberation door of great skillful means for universally adorning and purifying the realms of all Buddhas.
The Celestial King Sumeru-ghoṣa attained the liberation door of following all sentient beings through their eternal wandering in the ocean of birth and death;
the Celestial King Viśuddha-smṛti-nayana attained the liberation door of recollecting the Tathāgata’s practices for taming sentient beings;
the Celestial King Priya-rati-samanta-prabhā attained the liberation door of that which flows forth from the ocean of the universal gate dhāraṇī.
The Celestial King Lord of Sovereignty over the World attained the liberation door of enabling sentient beings to encounter the Buddha and give rise to the treasury of faith;
the Celestial King Sovereign of Radiant Flames attained the liberation door of enabling all sentient beings to hear the Dharma with faith and joy and thereby achieve transcendence;

the Celestial King of Transformation Who Delights in Contemplating the Dharma attained the liberation door of entering the boundless and inexhaustible conduct of taming practiced by all bodhisattvas, which is like space.
The Celestial King Banner of Transformation attained the liberation door of universally compassionate wisdom that observes the immeasurable afflictions of sentient beings;
the Celestial King Exquisite Adornment of Constellation Sounds attained the liberation door of emitting light to manifest the Buddha’s three wheels of conversion and guidance.

At that time, the Celestial King Renowned for Pure Wisdom, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed all the gods of the Heaven of Limited Purity, the Heaven of Infinite Purity, and the Heaven of Universal Purity, and spoke in verse:
“Those who realize the unobstructed nature of phenomena Manifest throughout the infinite lands of the ten directions,
Expounding the inconceivable realm of the Buddhas, Causing all beings to return together to the ocean of liberation.”
The Tathāgata dwells in the world without dependence, like reflections and shadows appearing in many lands;
the nature of phenomena is ultimately without arising—this is the gateway entered by King Viśeṣadṛś.
Having cultivated skillful means for an ocean of immeasurable eons, Universally purifying all lands throughout the ten directions,
The Dharma-realm remains eternally unmoving in its suchness— This is what the deity Śāntaguṇa has realized.
Sentient beings are shrouded and obstructed by ignorance; Blind and dark, they dwell perpetually within birth and death.
The Tathāgata reveals to them the path of purity; This is the liberation of Sumerughoṣa.
The unsurpassed path traversed by all Buddhas cannot be fathomed by any sentient being;
yet by manifesting various gates of skillful means, those with pure eyes can observe it and understand it completely.

The Tathāgata constantly uses the gates of dhāraṇī, As numerous as the atoms within oceans of lands, To instruct and guide sentient beings throughout all places; The Celestial King Universal Illumination is able to enter this.
The appearance of a Tathāgata in the world is extremely difficult to encounter; Only once in an ocean of immeasurable kalpas is such a one met.
That he can cause sentient beings to give rise to faith and understanding— This is what this Lord of the Gods has attained.
The Buddha teaches that the nature of all phenomena is devoid of inherent nature;
Profound, vast, and inconceivable, it causes all sentient beings everywhere to give rise to pure faith— This the Celestial King Radiant Flame understands well.
The Tathāgatas of the three periods of time are full of merit; their transformation of the realms of sentient beings is inconceivable.
Contemplating this, one gives rise to joy; thus, delighting in the Dharma, one is able to expound it.
Sentient beings are submerged in the ocean of afflictions; the turbidity of ignorance and views is most terrifying.
The Great Teacher, out of compassion, causes them to leave it forever—this is the realm perceived by the King of the Banner of Transformation.

The Tathāgata constantly radiates great beams of light; within each and every beam are immeasurable Buddhas, each manifesting deeds to transform sentient beings—this is the gateway entered by the Deva Sublime Sound.
Furthermore, the Celestial King Light of Delightful Radiance attained the liberation door of constantly experiencing peaceful bliss while manifesting to eliminate the sufferings of the world;
the Celestial King Pure Sublime Light attained the liberation door of the ocean of great compassion corresponding to the treasury of joy and happiness of all sentient beings;

and the Celestial King Sovereign Sound attained the liberation door of universally manifesting, within a single thought-moment, the power of the merit of all sentient beings throughout boundless eons.
The Celestial King Supreme Mindfulness and Wisdom attained the liberation door of universally causing all worlds—whether forming, abiding, or decaying—to be entirely pure like space;
the Celestial King Lovely Pure Melody attained the liberation door of loving, delighting in, and faithfully accepting the teachings of all holy ones;
the Celestial King Well-Considered Sound attained the liberation door of being able to abide for eons and expound the meanings of all stages and their skillful means.
The Celestial King Manifesting Adorned Sounds attained the liberation door of the skillful means for making great offerings when all Bodhisattvas descend from the Tuṣita Heaven to take birth below;
the Celestial King Profound Light Sound attained the liberation door of observing the ocean of inexhaustible supernatural powers and wisdom;
the Celestial King Vast Renown attained the liberation door of the power of skillful means for manifesting in the world with the fulfillment of the ocean of merits of all Buddhas.
The Celestial King Supreme Pure Light attained the liberation door of the treasury of profound faith and joyful love, which arises from the power of the Tathāgata’s past vows.

At that time, the Celestial King Delightful Light, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed all the assemblies of the Gods of Limited Light, the Gods of Immeasurable Light, and the Gods of Ultimate Light, and spoke these verses:
“I recall the deeds performed by the Tathāgata in the past, Serving and making offerings to boundless Buddhas.”
Just as his original karma of pure faith, he now beholds it all through the Buddha’s majestic spiritual power.

The Buddha’s body is signless and free from all defilements; he dwells eternally in the ground of compassion and pity, causing all the anxieties and afflictions of the world to be removed—this is the liberation of Sublime Light.
The Buddha-dharma is vast and boundless; within it, all oceans of lands appear.
Just as their formation and destruction each differ, such is the power of liberation of the deity Svaramati.

The Buddha’s power of spiritual penetrations is without equal; He universally manifests vast lands throughout the ten directions, Causing them all to be pure and ever-present before him— This is the skillful means of supreme mindfulness and liberation.
As numerous as the atoms within oceans of lands, all Tathāgatas are reverently served;
hearing the Dharma, they leave defilement behind without fail—this is the function of the Dharma-door of the Deva Sublime Sound.
Throughout oceans of immeasurable great kalpas, the Buddha has expounded the peerless skillful means of the stages;
what he has taught is boundless and inexhaustible—a truth known by the Deva Suvicintitaśabda.
The Tathāgata’s gateways of spiritual transformations are immeasurable; in a single thought-moment, they manifest in all places.
This great skillful means of descending from the heavens and attaining enlightenment is the liberation of Adorned Sound.
Empowered by majestic strength, they are able to expound the Dharma and manifest the supernatural powers of all Buddhas;
according to their faculties and inclinations, they bring them all to purification—this is the liberation door of the Ābhāsvara Heaven.
The Tathāgata’s wisdom is boundless; in the world there is none equal to him, nor does he cling to anything.
With a compassionate heart, he manifests universally in response to beings; the Greatly Renowned Celestial Being has awakened to this Way.
In the past, when the Buddha cultivated the practices for enlightenment, he made offerings to all Buddhas of the ten directions;
at the feet of each Buddha, he gave rise to a vow-mind, which Most Victorious Light heard with great joy.

Furthermore, the Brahma King Śikhin attained the liberation door of dwelling everywhere at the sites of enlightenment throughout the ten directions to preach the Dharma, with conduct that is pure and free from attachment;
the Brahma King Wisdom Light attained the liberation door of causing all sentient beings to enter meditative concentration and abide therein;
and the Brahma King Radiance of Well-Considered Wisdom attained the liberation door of universally entering all inconceivable dharmas.
The Brahma King Universal Cloud Sound attained the liberation door of entering the ocean of all the voices of the Buddhas;

the Brahma King Sovereign over the Speech and Sounds of the World attained the liberation door of being able to recollect the skillful means by which Bodhisattvas teach and transform all sentient beings;
and the Brahma King Tranquil Radiant Eye attained the liberation door of manifesting the distinct characteristics of the karmic retributions of all worlds.
The Brahma King Universal Radiance attained the liberation door of manifesting before all categories of sentient beings according to their differences to discipline and liberate them;
the Brahma King Transformative Sound attained the liberation door of dwelling in the realm of the practice of quiescence regarding the pure marks of all phenomena;
the Brahma King Blazing Light attained the liberation door of being unattached to all existence and non-existence, being boundless, having no dependence, and constantly and diligently appearing.
The Brahma King Manojñā-sāgaraghoṣa attained the liberation door of "Constantly Contemplating and Observing the Inexhaustible Dharma.

At that time, the Great Brahma King Śikhin, sustained by the Buddha’s spiritual power, surveyed all the assemblies of the Brahmakāyika, Brahmapurohita, Brahmakāyika, and Mahābrahmā devas and spoke these verses:
"The Buddha's body is pure and eternally quiescent; Its radiance shines throughout the world."
Without marks, without activity, and without image, It is seen like empty clouds;

such is the meditative realm of the Buddha’s body. All sentient beings are unable to fathom it, Yet he reveals to them inconceivable gates of skillful means— This is what the King of Wisdom-Light has realized.
The ocean of Dharma-gates, as numerous as the atoms within a Buddha-field, he expounds in a single word without remainder;
thus, throughout oceans of eons, his exposition is inexhaustible—this is the liberation of the Light of Well-Considered Wisdom.

The perfect voices of all Buddhas are equal to the world; Sentient beings each attain understanding according to their kind, Yet within those sounds there is no discrimination— Thus did the Brahmā Universal Sound awaken.

The skillful means of practice for entering enlightenment, as employed by all Tathāgatas throughout the three periods of time—all of these appear within the Buddha’s body; this is the liberation of the deity Svayambhūghoṣa.
The diverse karmas of all sentient beings, Each eliciting various distinct results according to their causes—
The Buddha manifests throughout the world in such a manner, Which the deity Śāntaprabha is able to comprehend and enter.
Mastery over all immeasurable Dharma gates, Taming sentient beings throughout the ten directions,
Yet never giving rise to discrimination therein— This is the realm of Samantaprabha.
The Buddha’s body is like space, inexhaustible; Formless and unimpeded, it pervades the ten directions.
All manifestations are like magical illusions; King of Transformation Sound has awakened to this path.
The physical marks of the Tathāgata are boundless, And his wisdom and voice are likewise so;
Appearing in form within the world without attachment— King Radiant Light enters this gate.
The Dharma King dwells securely in the palace of the sublime Dharma; The radiance of his Dharma-body shines everywhere without exception.
The nature of phenomena is peerless and devoid of all marks; This is the liberation of King Ocean-Sound.
Furthermore, the Celestial King Īśvara attained the liberation door of the sovereign treasury that brings immeasurable sentient beings to maturity before one's eyes;
the Celestial King Sunetra attained the liberation door of observing the joys of all sentient beings and causing them to enter the joy of the noble realm;
and the Celestial King Ratnaketu-mukuṭa attained the liberation door of causing various practices to arise according to the diverse desires and understandings of sentient beings.
The Celestial King Courageous Wisdom attained the liberation door of universally gathering all spoken meanings for the sake of all sentient beings;
the Celestial King Wondrous Sound Syllables attained the liberation door of recollecting the Tathāgata’s vast compassion and advancing one's own practice;
the Celestial King Banner of Sublime Light attained the liberation door of manifesting the gate of great compassion to destroy all banners of pride.
The Celestial King Śāntaviṣaya attained the liberation door of subduing all worldly minds of anger and malice;
the Celestial King Citracakravibhūṣaṇadhvaja attained the liberation door of all Buddhas of the ten directions coming to his presence whenever he calls them to mind;
the Celestial King Puṣpaprabhāprabha attained the liberation door of universally manifesting the attainment of perfect enlightenment in accordance with the mental inclinations of sentient beings.
The Celestial King Indramukhaprabha attained the liberation door of the sovereign dharma of great majestic power that universally enters all worlds.
At that time, the Celestial King Īśvara, sustained by the Buddha’s spiritual authority, surveyed the entire assembly of the Īśvara devas and spoke in verse:
“The Buddha-body pervades everywhere, equal to the Dharma-realm; Universally responding to sentient beings, it appears before them all.”
Constantly transforming and guiding through various gates of teaching, He is sovereign over the Dharma and able to bring awakening.
Of all the various pleasures found in the world, The noble joy of cessation is the most supreme.
Abiding within the vast nature of phenomena— This the Celestial King Subtle Eye beholds.
The Tathāgata appears throughout the ten directions, Universally responding to the minds of all beings to preach the Dharma;
All doubts and delusions are completely severed— This is the liberation door of the Wondrous Banner Crown.
The Buddhas pervade the world proclaiming wondrous sounds;
the Dharma they have taught throughout immeasurable eons can all be fully expressed in a single word—this is the liberation of great courageous wisdom.
All the vast compassion found in the world Is not equal to even a single hair’s breadth of the Tathāgata’s;
The Buddha’s compassion is like space, inexhaustible— This is what the deva Subhāṣitaghoṣa has attained.
The high mountains of pride of all sentient beings, The One of Ten Powers has utterly crushed them without remainder;
This is the application of the Tathāgata’s great compassion, The path traversed by King Wondrous Light Banner.

The light of wisdom is pure and fills the world; whoever beholds it is freed from the darkness of delusion and led away from all evil realms—this is the Dharma realized by the Celestial King Śāntideva.
The light from his pores can proclaim the names of Buddhas as numerous as all sentient beings;
according to their inclinations, they all hear them—this is the liberation of Wondrous Wheel Banner.
The Tathāgata’s sovereign power is immeasurable, Pervading the entirety of the Dharma-realm and empty space;
All those in the assembly clearly behold it— This gate of liberation was entered by Flower Wisdom.
Throughout immeasurable and boundless oceans of great eons, you appear universally throughout the ten directions to preach the Dharma;
yet never have you seen the Buddha come or go—this is what the Lord of Radiant Devas has realized.
Furthermore, the Celestial King Skillful Transformation attained the liberation door of revealing the power of the transformations of all karma;
the Celestial King Light of Silent Sound attained the liberation door of relinquishing all objective attachments;

and the Celestial King Light of Transformative Power attained the liberation door of universally extinguishing the ignorant darkness of the minds of all sentient beings so that their wisdom becomes perfected.
The Celestial King Lord of Adornment attained the liberation door of manifesting boundless, pleasing sounds;
the Celestial King Light of Mindfulness attained the liberation door of knowing the inexhaustible marks of the merit of all Buddhas;
the Celestial King Supreme Cloud Sound attained the liberation door of universally knowing the sequence of the formation and destruction of all past eons.
The Celestial King Victorious Light attained the liberation door of wisdom that awakens all sentient beings;
the Celestial King Wondrous Topknot attained the liberation door of emitting light that swiftly fills the void realms of the ten directions;
the Celestial King Joyful Wisdom attained the liberation door of the power of diligence that cannot be destroyed in any undertaking.
The Celestial King Flower-Light Topknot attained the liberation door of knowing the retributions received by all sentient beings according to their karma;
the Celestial King Universally Beholding the Ten Directions attained the liberation door of manifesting the inconceivable distinctions among the forms and types of sentient beings.
At that time, the Celestial King Skillful Transformation, empowered by the Buddha’s majestic authority, surveyed all the hosts of the Heaven of Skillful Transformation and spoke in verse:
“The nature of karma in the world is inconceivable; The Buddha has fully revealed it for the sake of the deluded masses.
He skillfully explains the true principle of causes and conditions: The diverse karmic actions of all sentient beings.”
Observing the Buddha in various ways, he is found to be non-existent; Seeking him throughout the ten directions, he cannot be apprehended.
The Dharma-body manifests yet lacks any substantial reality— This is what the one named Silent Sound of Dharma perceives.
The Buddha cultivated all practices throughout oceans of kalpas in order to extinguish the delusions of ignorance and darkness in the world;
therefore, he is pure and most brilliantly illuminating—this is what the Light of Power has realized in his mind.
Of all the wondrous sounds that exist in the world, none can compare to the voice of the Tathāgata;
with a single sound, the Buddha pervades the ten directions—thus enters the Lord of Adornment of this Liberation.
All the power of merit possessed by all beings in the world is not equal to even a single mark of the Tathāgata;
the merit of the Tathāgata is coextensive with empty space—this is what the deva Citta-prabhāsa beholds.

All the immeasurable eons throughout the three periods of time, with all their various signs of formation and decay—the Buddha can manifest them all within a single pore; this is what the Supreme Cloud-Sound fully understands.
The voids of the ten directions may be measured, But the measure of a single pore of the Buddha cannot be found;
Such unimpeded and inconceivable [wisdom] The Celestial King Wondrous Topknot has already realized.
In immeasurable kalpas of past lives, the Buddha fully cultivated the vast pāramitās;
through diligent practice and tireless perseverance, his joyful wisdom was able to know this dharma-gate.
The nature of karma and its causes and conditions are inconceivable; the Buddha has expounded them all for the sake of the world.
The nature of phenomena is fundamentally pure and free from all defilements; this is the entrance into the Radiant Flower.
You should observe a single pore of the Buddha, wherein all sentient beings are fully contained;
they neither come nor go—this is what King Universal Vision has realized.
Furthermore, the Celestial King Contentment attained the liberation door of the perfect wheel of teaching of all Buddhas appearing in the world;
the Celestial King Joyful Ocean Topknot attained the liberation door of the pure radiant body that pervades the realm of empty space;
and the Celestial King Banner of Supreme Virtue attained the liberation door of the ocean of pure vows that extinguishes the suffering of the world.
The Celestial King Śāntiprabha attained the liberation door of universally manifesting his body to preach the Dharma;
the Celestial King Sunetra attained the liberation door of universally purifying all realms of sentient beings;
the Celestial King Ratnaśikharacandra attained the liberation door of the inexhaustible treasury that constantly appears before the world through universal transformation.
The Celestial King Power of Valor and Courage attained the liberation door of revealing the realm of the perfect enlightenment of all Buddhas;
the Celestial King Sublime Vajra Light attained the liberation door of making the bodhicitta of all sentient beings firm and indestructible;
the Celestial King Constellation Banner attained the liberation door of the skillful means for approaching, observing, and taming sentient beings whenever all Buddhas appear in the world.
The Celestial King Sublime Adornment attained the liberation door of knowing the minds of all sentient beings in a single thought and manifesting in response to their capacities.
At that time, the Celestial King Contentment, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed all the hosts of the Heaven of Contentment and spoke in verse:
“The Tathāgata is vast and pervasive throughout the Dharma-realm, Equally impartial toward all sentient beings.”
Universally responding to the inclinations of all beings, he reveals the subtle gate, Causing them to enter the inconceivable, pure Dharma.
The Buddha’s body appears everywhere throughout the ten directions; Unattached and unimpeded, it cannot be grasped.
All varieties of forms and images are seen by the world; This is the realm entered by the goddess Priyamukha.
In the past, the Tathāgata cultivated all practices; His pure great vows were as deep as the ocean.
He has brought all Buddha-dharmas to fulfillment; Only one of supreme virtue can understand these skillful means.

The Dharma-body of the Tathāgata is inconceivable; like reflections manifesting forms throughout the entire Dharma-realm, it elucidates all phenomena everywhere—this is the liberation gate of the Heaven of Tranquil Light.
Sentient beings are entangled and shrouded by karma and delusion; their minds run wild with pride and negligence.
The Tathāgata preaches for them the Dharma of tranquility, and with his virtuous eyes he illuminates their hearts so that they rejoice.
The true guide of all worlds appears as a savior and a refuge;
he universally shows sentient beings the place of peace and bliss—into this, Peak Moon is able to deeply enter.
The realm of all Buddhas is inconceivable, pervading the entire dharma-realm;
having entered all dharmas and reached the other shore, the one of courageous wisdom beholds this and gives rise to joy.
If there are sentient beings capable of being transformed, who hear of the Buddha’s merits and proceed toward Bodhi,
causing them to abide in the ocean of blessings and remain eternally pure— Sublime Light is able to observe this.
To as many Buddha-lands as there are atoms in the oceans of worlds of the ten directions, they go to all those places where Buddhas reside;
there they gather, respectfully making offerings and listening to the Dharma—this is what is seen by the Banner of Adornment.

The ocean of sentient beings' minds is inconceivable; Without abiding, without movement, and without a place of reliance, The Buddha perceives them all clearly in a single thought-moment— This the Celestial King Sublime Adornment understands well.
Furthermore, the Heavenly King Timing attained the liberation door of inspiring the roots of goodness in all sentient beings so that they may forever be free from sorrow and affliction;
the Heavenly King Sublime Light attained the liberation door of universally entering all realms;
and the Heavenly King Banner of Inexhaustible Wisdom and Virtue attained the liberation door of the great compassion wheel that extinguishes all calamities.
The Celestial King Skillful Transformation and Dignity attained the liberation door of knowing the minds of all sentient beings throughout the three periods of time;
the Celestial King Great Radiance of Total Retention attained the liberation door of the light of *dhāraṇī* that recollects and maintains all dharmas without forgetfulness;
and the Celestial King Inconceivable Wisdom attained the liberation door of skillfully entering the inconceivable means regarding the intrinsic nature of all karma.
The Celestial King Nābhi-cakra attained the liberation door of skillful means for maturing sentient beings by turning the wheel of Dharma;
the Celestial King Arciṣmat attained the liberation door of universally observing sentient beings with vast eyes and proceeding to subdue them;
the Celestial King Prabhākara attained the liberation door of transcending all karmic obstacles and not following the deeds of Māra.
The Celestial King Universal Observer of Great Renown attained the liberation door of skillfully exhorting all the hosts of devas, causing them to receive and practice with pure minds.
At that time, the Celestial King Seasonal Division, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed all the hosts of Seasonal Division devas and spoke in verse:
“Throughout immeasurable and long eons, The Buddha has exhausted the ocean of worldly sorrow and affliction.”
He has widely opened the pure path free from dust, Forever illuminating the lamp of wisdom for all sentient beings.
The Dharma-body of the Tathāgata is exceedingly vast; Its boundaries cannot be found throughout the ten directions.
All skillful means are limitless and boundless, Accessible only to the wisdom of the Radiant and Wondrous Light Heaven.
Birth, old age, sickness, death, sorrow, and grief oppress the world without a moment’s rest;
the Great Teacher, out of compassion, vowed to eliminate them all, for his inexhaustible light of wisdom can bring full awakening.
The Buddha’s illusory-like wisdom is unimpeded; He fully understands all phenomena of the three periods of time.
Pervasively entering into the mental activities of sentient beings— This is the realm of the Skillful Transformation Heaven.
The limits of dhāraṇī cannot be found, And the great ocean of eloquence is inexhaustible;
Able to turn the pure and wondrous wheel of Dharma— This is the liberation of Great Light.
The nature of karma is vast and inexhaustible; Wisdom awakens and clearly reveals it.
All skillful means are inconceivable; Such is the realm entered by the Deva of Wisdom.
Turning the inconceivable, wondrous wheel of Dharma, Revealing the cultivation of the path to Bodhi,
Forever extinguishing the suffering of all sentient beings— This is the stage of skillful means at the hub of the wheel.

The true body of the Tathāgata is fundamentally non-dual; manifesting according to objects and assuming forms that fill the world, sentient beings each see it before them— this is the realm of the Yama Heaven.
If there are sentient beings who see the Buddha but once, he will surely cause them to purify and eliminate all karmic obstructions;
they shall leave behind all demonic activities without remainder and forever follow the path traversed by the King of Light-Illumination Heaven.
The entire assembly is as vast as the ocean, And within it, the Buddha is most majestic and radiant;
He universally rains down the rain of Dharma to nourish all beings— This is the liberation gate entered by the one named Renown.

Furthermore, the celestial king Śakrendra attained the liberation door of great joy through clearly perceiving the appearance of the Buddhas of the three periods of time, as well as the formation and destruction of all lands;
the celestial king Samantaghoṣa attained the liberation door of being able to cause the Buddha’s form-body to be supremely pure, vast, and beyond compare in the world;
and the celestial king Maitreyanetra-ratna-śikhin attained the liberation door of the clouds of compassion universally covering all.
The Celestial King named Jewel Light Banner Fame attained the liberation door of constantly seeing Buddhas manifesting various forms and majestic bodies before all world-protectors;
the Celestial King named Crest of Joyful Birth attained the liberation door of knowing from what meritorious karma the cities, towns, and palaces of all sentient beings arise;
and the Celestial King named Upright Mind attained the liberation door of revealing the deeds of all Buddhas in maturing sentient beings.
The Celestial King Exalted and Sublime Sound attained the liberation door of knowing the signs of transformation during all kalpas of the formation and destruction of the worlds;
the Celestial King Accomplished Mindfulness attained the liberation door of recollecting the future practices of Bodhisattvas for taming sentient beings;
and the Celestial King Pure Flower Radiance attained the liberation door of thoroughly knowing the causes of happiness for all devas.
The Celestial King Wisdom-Sun-Eye attained the liberation door of revealing to all celestial sons the roots of goodness for taking birth, which is utterly free from delusion and confusion;
the Celestial King Sovereign Radiance attained the liberation door of awakening all the celestial hosts so that they may forever sever various doubts.
At that time, Śakrendra, the King of Devas, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed all the hosts of the Trāyastriṃśa Heaven and spoke in verse:
“I contemplate all Buddhas of the three periods of time; All their realms are entirely equal.
Just as their lands are destroyed and formed, I behold them all through the Buddha’s majestic spiritual power.”
The Buddha’s body is vast, pervading the ten directions; Its wondrous form is peerless, benefiting all living beings.
Its radiance shines forth, reaching everywhere; This path is universally praised as that which can be perceived.

The Tathāgata’s ocean of great compassion and skillful means, cultivated through practice in past eons until it is utterly pure, guides and transforms sentient beings without limit; this the Heavenly King Ratnaśikhin has realized and understood.
As I recollect the ocean of merits of the Dharma King, supreme in the world and without equal, a vast heart of joy arises; this is the liberation of the Deva Jewel Light.
The Buddha knows the ocean of sentient beings’ wholesome karma, And how various superior causes give rise to great merit;
He causes all of these to manifest without exception— This is what the deity Priyamukha perceives.
The Buddhas appear throughout the ten directions, pervading all worlds;
observing the minds of sentient beings, they manifest taming—this is the path realized by King Samyaksmṛti.
The Tathāgata’s wisdom-body and vast eye perceive every atom within all worlds;
thus they pervade the ten directions—this is the liberation of the deva Meghasvara.
The bodhisattva practices of all the Buddha-sons are all manifested within a single pore of the Tathāgata;
just as they are infinite, so too are they fully present—this is clearly seen by King Saṃtāraṇa.
All the matters of peace and happiness in the world arise entirely from the Buddha;
the Tathāgata’s merit is supreme and peerless—this King of Flowers enters this realm of liberation.

If one recollects even a small virtue of the Tathāgata, or focuses the mind with single-minded devotion for even a single thought-moment, the terrors of all evil realms will be forever eliminated; the eye of wisdom can deeply awaken to this.
