With great supernormal powers within the dharma of quiescent extinction, Universally responding to the minds of all beings without exception,
Causing all doubts and delusions to be severed— This is what the King of Radiance has attained.

Furthermore, the Devaputra Sūrya (Sun) attained the liberation door of pure light universally illuminating all sentient beings of the ten directions throughout all future kalpas to constantly bring them benefit;
the Devaputra Arciṣmatī-nayana (Flame-Eye) attained the liberation door of awakening sentient beings through bodies that adapt to all their various types, leading them to enter the ocean of wisdom;

and the Devaputra Meruprabha-pramoda-dhvaja (Sumeru-Light-Joy-Standard) attained the liberation door of becoming a lord for all sentient beings, causing them to diligently cultivate boundless pure merits.
The Devaputra Pure Jewel Moon attained the liberation door of profound joy in the mind that cultivates all ascetic practices;
the Devaputra Valiant and Non-regressing attained the liberation door of unimpeded light that shines universally to benefit the vital spirits of all sentient beings;

the Devaputra Wondrous Flower Garland Radiance attained the liberation door of pure light that shines universally upon the bodies of sentient beings, causing them to give rise to an ocean of joyful faith and understanding.
The Devaputra Supreme Banner Light obtained the liberation door of universally illuminating all worlds with light to accomplish various kinds of sublime merits;
the Devaputra Jewel Topknot Universal Radiance obtained the liberation door of the ocean of great compassion manifesting infinite realms and various forms and colors;
the Devaputra Radiant Eye obtained the liberation door of purifying the eyes of all sentient beings so that they may see the treasury of the Dharma-realm.
The Devaputra Dhāraṇaśrī attained the liberation door of generating a pure, continuous mind that remains indestructible;

the Devaputra Samantagataraśmiprabha attained the liberation door of universally circulating the solar palace to illumine all sentient beings in the ten directions, causing them to accomplish their respective tasks.
At that time, the Sun Deva, empowered by the Buddha’s majestic authority, surveyed the entire assembly of sun devas and spoke in verse:
“The Tathāgata’s vast light of wisdom Universally illuminates all lands in the ten directions;
All sentient beings behold the Buddha, Who employs manifold skillful means for their subduing.”
The Tathāgata’s physical marks are boundless; He manifests his body according to the inclinations of beings.
Universally opening the ocean of wisdom for the world— Thus did Flame-Eye contemplate the Buddha.
The Buddha’s body is peerless and without compare; its radiance shines throughout the ten directions.
Surpassing all things, it is most supreme; such a Dharma gate is attained with joy.
For the benefit of the world, he practiced austerities, Wandering through the various realms of existence for immeasurable eons;
His radiance is all-pervading and pure like space— The Jewel Moon can understand this skillful means.
The Buddha proclaims wondrous sounds without obstruction, pervading all lands throughout the ten directions;
by nourishing all living beings with the flavor of the Dharma, he is courageous and able to know these skillful means.
Emitting inconceivable nets of radiant light, Universally purifying all sentient beings,
Causing them all to give rise to deep faith and understanding— This is the gate of entry for the devas of Flower-Garlands.
All the lights that exist in the world cannot match the light from a single pore of the Buddha;
such is the inconceivable radiance of the Buddha—this is the liberation of the Light of the Supreme Banner.
The Dharma of all Buddhas is thus: they all sit beneath the king of bodhi trees, causing those who have not entered the Way to abide in it; such is seen by the Radiance of the Jewel Topknot.

Sentient beings suffer from blindness, darkness, and ignorance; the Buddha, wishing to cause them to give birth to the pure eye, has therefore lit the lamp of wisdom, which Sunetra here observes with deep insight.

The Honored One, Sovereign of the Expedient Means of Liberation, Causes all who have once seen him and made an offering To practice the path until they reach its fruition; This is the power of the expedient means of the Virtuous Deity.
Within a single dharma-gate there are immeasurable gates; Thus they have been expounded for immeasurable thousands of kalpas.
The vast meaning of the dharma-gates thus proclaimed Is fully realized by the Universal Vehicle Radiance Deva.
Furthermore, the Devaputra Moon attained the liberation door of pure light universally illuminating the dharma-realm to gather and transform sentient beings;
the Devaputra Flower-King Topknot Radiant Light attained the liberation door of observing all realms of sentient beings to cause them to universally enter the boundless Dharma;
and the Devaputra Myriad Subtle Pure Light attained the liberation door of knowing the various objects of focus and the shifting movements within the ocean-like minds of all sentient beings.
The Celestial Son Peaceful Mind of the World attained the liberation door of bestowing inconceivable happiness upon all sentient beings, causing them to leap for joy and experience great rapture.

The Celestial Son Tree-King Eye-Light attained the liberation door of protecting the sprouts, stalks, and so forth of the seeds sown by farmers according to the seasons, ensuring their successful fruition.

The Celestial Son Manifestation of Pure Light attained the liberation door of using compassion to rescue and protect all sentient beings, enabling them to clearly perceive the experiences of both suffering and joy.
The Celestial Son Universal Traveler Immovable Light attained the liberation door of being able to uphold the pure moon that universally manifests throughout the ten directions;
the Celestial Son Sovereign King of Constellations attained the liberation door of revealing that all phenomena are like illusions, like space, signless, and without intrinsic nature;
and the Celestial Son Pure Awakening Moon attained the liberation door of universally initiating great karmic activities for the sake of all sentient beings.
The Celestial Son Mahāteja-prabhāsa attained the liberation door of universally severing all doubts and delusions.
At that time, the Moon Celestial Son, empowered by the Buddha’s spiritual authority, surveyed all the assemblies of devas within the lunar palaces and spoke in verse:
“The Buddha emits radiance throughout the world, Illuminating all lands in the ten directions.”
He manifests the inconceivable and vast Dharma, forever shattering the darkness of sentient beings' ignorance and delusion.
His realm is boundless and inexhaustible; throughout immeasurable kalpas, he constantly provides guidance.
With various forms of sovereign mastery, he transforms all living beings—thus did Huaji perceive the Buddha.
The ocean of sentient beings' minds differs from moment to moment; The Buddha’s wisdom, vast and expansive, knows them all.
He universally preaches the Dharma to bring them joy; This is the liberation of Wondrous Radiance.
Sentient beings lack noble peace and bliss; Sunk in the evil realms, they undergo all manner of suffering.
The Tathāgata reveals to them the gateway of the dharma-nature; By contemplating with peace and bliss, one sees thus.
The Tathāgata’s rare and great compassion, entering into all realms of existence for the benefit of sentient beings,
preaching the Dharma and exhorting them toward goodness so that they may achieve fulfillment— this is what the deva Mārīci understands.
The World-Honored One has revealed the radiance of the Dharma, Discerning the nature of all worldly karmas;
That the practices of good and evil are never lost or destroyed— Pure Light beholds this and gives rise to joy.
The Buddha is the support for all merit, Just as the great earth sustains palaces and dwellings;
He skillfully shows the path of peace and security that transcends sorrow, Unshakable, he is able to know these expedient means.

The great brilliance of the fire of wisdom pervades the Dharma-realm; manifesting countless forms equal in number to all sentient beings, it universally reveals the truth for the sake of all—this is the path realized by the Celestial King Nakṣatrarāja.
The Buddha is like space, devoid of self-nature; To benefit sentient beings, he manifests in the world.
His marks and embellishments are like reflected images— Thus does the Celestial King Pure Awakening perceive him.
The pores of the Buddha’s body universally radiate sounds, And clouds of Dharma cover the world without exception;
All who hear them cannot fail to give rise to joy— Thus did the Deva Light of Liberation realize.

Chapter One: The Array of Subtle Adornments of the Lords of the Three Times, Part Three.
Furthermore, the Gandharva King Dhṛtarāṣṭra attained the liberation door of skillful means that freely gathers all sentient beings;
the Gandharva King Vṛkṣaprabha attained the liberation door of universally beholding the adornments of all merits.
The Gandharva King Pure Eyes attained the liberation door of giving birth to a treasury of joy through the permanent severance of the sorrow and suffering of all sentient beings;
the Gandharva King Flower Crown attained the liberation door of permanently severing the delusions of false views in all sentient beings;

the Gandharva King Joyful Steps Universal Sound attained the liberation door of spreading widely like clouds to universally shade and nourish all sentient beings; the Gandharva King Delightful Moving Beautiful Eyes attained the liberation door of manifesting a vast, wondrous, and excellent body to cause all to obtain peace and happiness.
The Gandharva King Wondrous Sound Lion Banner attained the liberation door of universally scattering all jewels of great renown throughout the ten directions;
the Gandharva King Universally Radiating Jewel Light attained the liberation door of manifesting pure bodies that radiate light of universal great joy;
the Gandharva King Vajra Tree Flower Banner attained the liberation door of universally nourishing and flourishing all trees so that all who see them are filled with joy.

The Gandharva King Universal Manifestation of Adornments attained the liberation door of skillfully entering the realm of all Buddhas to bestow peace, happiness, and liberation upon all sentient beings.
At that time, the Gandharva King Sustaining the Nation, empowered by the Buddha’s spiritual authority, surveyed the entire assembly of gandharvas and spoke in verse:
“The realms of the Buddhas have immeasurable gates, Which no sentient beings are able to enter.”
The Sugata is pure like the nature of space, universally opening the right path for the world.
Within each and every pore of the Tathāgata, oceans of merit are completely filled;
he brings benefit and happiness to all the worlds—this is what King Druma-prabha is able to see.
The vast ocean of worldly sorrow and suffering, the Buddha can exhaust entirely without remainder;
the Tathāgata’s compassion and manifold skillful means—Netra has been able to understand this deeply.
The oceans of lands in the ten directions are boundless, yet the Buddha illuminates them all with the light of wisdom;
universally causing the washing away of all false and evil views—this is the gate entered by King Tree Light.
In the past, throughout immeasurable kalpas, the Buddha cultivated the practices of great compassion and skillful means;
he brought peace and solace to all worlds—a path that Puyin has been able to awaken to and enter.
The Buddha’s body is pure and all delight in beholding it; It can produce inexhaustible bliss for the world.
Liberation is accomplished through the sequential stages of cause and effect; With beautiful eyes, he skillfully reveals this here.
Sentient beings wander in confusion, their delusions and veils of ignorance being most firm and dense;
for them the Tathāgata has preached the vast Dharma, which the Lion-Banner King is able to expound.
The Tathāgata universally manifests a wondrous form-body, With infinite distinctions equal to all sentient beings;
Through various skillful means he illuminates the world, Universally radiating jewel-like light—thus it is seen.
The immeasurable gates of great wisdom and skillful means— The Buddha has universally expounded them for the sake of all living beings.
Entering the true practice of supreme enlightenment— This is well-observed by Vajradhvaja.
Within a single kṣaṇa, hundreds of thousands of kalpas— The Buddha’s power can manifest them all without moving;
Bestowing equal peace and happiness upon all beings— This is the liberation of the Array of Bliss.
Furthermore, the Kumbhāṇḍa King Vardhana attained the liberation door of the power to extinguish all enmity and harm;
the Kumbhāṇḍa King Nāgendra attained the liberation door of the ocean of gates for practicing boundless conduct;
the Kumbhāṇḍa King Vyūhadhvaja attained the liberation door of knowing the inclinations of the minds of all sentient beings.
The Kumbhāṇḍa King Beneficial Conduct attained the liberation door of universally accomplishing the activities of pure great radiance;
the Kumbhāṇḍa King Terrifying attained the liberation door of revealing the path of peace and fearlessness for all sentient beings;
the Kumbhāṇḍa King Sublime Adornment attained the liberation door of exhausting and drying up the ocean of craving and desire of all sentient beings.
The Kumbhāṇḍa King High Peak Wisdom attained the liberation door of the light-cloud that universally manifests in all realms of existence;
the Kumbhāṇḍa King Brave and Strong Arms attained the liberation door of universally emitting light to extinguish heavy obstructions as massive as mountains;
the Kumbhāṇḍa King Boundless Pure Flower Eye attained the liberation door of revealing the treasury of non-regressing great compassion.
The Kumbhāṇḍa King Vast Face attained the liberation door of universally manifesting bodies that flow and transform throughout all realms of existence.
At that time, the Kumbhāṇḍa King Increasing Power, sustained by the Buddha’s majestic authority, surveyed the entire assembly of Kumbhāṇḍas and spoke in verse:
“The World-Leader, who has perfected the power of patience, Has practiced for the sake of beings through immeasurable eons.”
Forever free from the delusions of worldly pride, his body is thus most majestic and pure.
In the past, the Buddha universally cultivated an ocean of all practices, teaching and transforming immeasurable multitudes throughout the ten directions;
through various skillful means he benefited all living beings—this gate of liberation has been attained by the Dragon King.
The Buddha, with his great wisdom, rescues sentient beings; there are none whose minds he does not clearly know.
Through various forms of mastery, he tames them; seeing this, Adorned Banner gives rise to joy.
Supernatural powers manifest like light and shadows; the Dharma wheel is truly like space.
Thus he dwells in the world for immeasurable eons—this is what the King of Beneficence has realized.
Sentient beings are perpetually shrouded and deluded by the cataracts of ignorance;
the Buddha’s light shines forth the path of peace and security, acting as their protector to eliminate suffering—he who can contemplate this dharma-gate is truly formidable.
Adrift and submerged in the ocean of desire, one encounters manifold sufferings; when the light of wisdom shines universally, they are extinguished without remainder.
Having eliminated suffering, he then preaches the Dharma—this is what the Wondrously Adorned has realized.
The Buddha’s body universally responds, appearing to all who see; Through various skillful means, he transforms all living beings.
His voice thunders like a clap of thunder, raining down the rain of Dharma; Into such a Dharma gate does Noble Wisdom enter.
Pure radiance does not arise in vain; when encountered, it surely causes heavy obscurations to dissolve.
It proclaims the boundless merits of the Buddha; the One with the Brave Arms can clarify this profound principle.
Desiring to bring peace and happiness to all sentient beings, He cultivated great compassion for immeasurable eons;
Through various skillful means, he eliminated all sufferings— This is what the Pure Flower beheld.
With sovereign and inconceivable supernormal powers, his body manifests universally throughout the ten directions;
yet amidst all things, there is neither coming nor going—this is what King Vipulaśrī understands in his heart.
Furthermore, the Naga King Virūpākṣa attained the liberation door of extinguishing all the burning sufferings of the nāga realm;
the Naga King Sāgara attained the liberation door of transforming his own nāga form in a single thought-moment to manifest the bodies of immeasurable sentient beings;
and the Naga King Meghasvaradhvaja attained the liberation door of proclaiming the ocean of the Buddha’s boundless names with pure sound throughout all realms of existence.
The Dragon King Jvālāmukha attained the liberation door of universally manifesting the distinctions in the establishment of infinite Buddha-worlds;
the Dragon King Jvala attained the liberation door of using the Tathāgata’s compassion to eliminate the coverings and entanglements of anger and ignorance in all sentient beings;
and the Dragon King Meghadhvaja attained the liberation door of revealing to all sentient beings the ocean of merit and great joy.
The Naga King Takṣaka attained the liberation door of extinguishing all fears through the sound of pure protection;
the Naga King Anantapada attained the liberation door of manifesting the physical bodies of all Buddhas and the sequence of their dwelling in kalpas;
the Naga King Viśuddhavarṇa-āśuga attained the liberation door of giving birth to an ocean of great love, joy, and delight for all sentient beings.
The Dragon King Universal Conduct Great Sound attained the liberation door of manifesting all-pervasive, equal, pleasing, and unobstructed sounds;
the Dragon King Free from Heat and Affliction attained the liberation door of extinguishing all suffering in the world with clouds of great compassion that universally cover it.
At that time, the Naga King Virūpākṣa, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed all the hosts of nāgas and spoke these verses:
“Behold how the Dharma of the Tathāgata is ever thus: It benefits all sentient beings without exception.
By the power of his great compassion and pity, He pulls out those who have fallen into the perilous paths.”
The various distinctions of all sentient beings Are all manifested upon a single hair-tip;
With spiritual powers and transformations filling the world— Thus does Sāgara perceive the Buddha.
By the power of his infinite supernormal faculties, the Buddha extensively proclaims his names, equal in number to all sentient beings;
he causes them all to hear according to their inclinations, such that they can awaken to and understand these cloud-like sounds.
The Buddha is able to cause the multitudes from immeasurable and boundless lands to enter a single pore;
the Tathāgata sits serenely within that assembly—this is what the dragon Kṣayamukha beholds.
The wrathful minds of all sentient beings, Enveloped by ignorance as deep as the ocean— The Tathāgata, out of compassion, eliminates them all; Yen-long beholds this and can see it clearly.
The power of the merit of all sentient beings is fully manifested within a single pore of the Buddha;
having been so manifested, they are led back to the great ocean of merit—this is what the High Cloud Banner contemplates.
From the pores of the Buddha’s body, rays of wisdom-light emanate; In every place these lights proclaim wondrous sounds.
Sentient beings who hear them are freed from sorrow and fear, And the Dragon Takṣaka awakens to this Path.
All Tathāgatas of the three periods of time, And the successive adornments of their lands and eons— All these appear within the Buddha’s body; Guangbu beholds this power of spiritual transformation.
I contemplate the Tathāgata’s past conduct, making offerings to oceans of all Buddhas;
in them all he increased his heart of joy—this is the entrance of the Swift Dragon.
The Buddha, through skillful means and voices adapted to various types, preaches the Dharma for the multitude to bring them joy;
his voice is pure and elegant, pleasing to all, and as it reaches everyone’s ears, their hearts rejoice and awaken.
Sentient beings, oppressed within the various realms of existence, are adrift on the currents of karma and delusion with no one to save them;
the Buddha, through his great compassion, brings them to liberation—this the great nāga Anāthapiṇḍada was able to realize.
Furthermore, the Yakṣa King Vaiśravaṇa attained the liberation door of rescuing and protecting evil sentient beings through boundless skillful means;
the Yakṣa King Svayambhūnirghoṣa attained the liberation door of universally observing sentient beings and rescuing and protecting them through skillful means;
and the Yakṣa King Saṃdhāraṇapraharaṇadhara attained the liberation door of being able to provide sustenance and benefit to all extremely weak and evil sentient beings.
The Yakṣa King Mahāprajñā attained the liberation door of extolling the ocean of all holy merits;
the Yakṣa King Jvālākṣa attained the liberation door of the great compassionate wisdom that universally observes all sentient beings;
the Yakṣa King Vajranetra attained the liberation door of benefiting and bringing peace and happiness to all sentient beings through various skillful means.
The Yakṣa King Courageous Arm attained the liberation door of universally entering into the meaning of all dharmas;
the Yakṣa King Brave Enemy of Great Armies attained the liberation door of protecting all sentient beings so that they abide in the Way without passing away in vain;
the Yakṣa King Abundant Wealth attained the liberation door of increasing the mass of merit for all sentient beings so that they constantly experience happiness.
The Yakṣa King Baladharaparvata attained the liberation door of the light of wisdom and power of the Buddhas arising from compliant mindfulness.
At that time, the Great Yakṣa King Bahudhāraṇī, sustained by the Buddha’s majestic power, surveyed the entire assembly of yakṣas and spoke in verse:
"The evils of sentient beings are deeply fearsome; For hundreds of thousands of eons they do not see a Buddha."
Wandering through birth and death and undergoing manifold sufferings— To save such beings as these, the Buddha appears in the world.
The Tathāgata protects all the worlds, Manifesting before the presence of every being;
He quiets the suffering of wandering in the perilous paths of saṃsāra— Into this Dharma gate has Ghoṣeśvara entered.
Sentient beings have heavy obstacles caused by evil karma; the Buddha reveals the wondrous principle to bring them understanding.
Like a bright lamp illuminating the world, this majestic Dharma enables one to see clearly.
In oceans of kalpas past, the Buddha cultivated all practices and praised all Buddhas of the ten directions;
thus he attained lofty and far-reaching renown—this is what the King of Wisdom understands.
Wisdom is like space, without limit; the Dharma-body is vast and inconceivable.
Therefore, it manifests throughout the ten directions—this the Flaming-Eyed One is able to observe.
Proclaiming wondrous sounds throughout all realms of existence, He teaches the Dharma to benefit all sentient beings;
Wherever his voice reaches, all sufferings are extinguished— Enter this Vajra-Eye of Skillful Means.
All meanings, profound and vast, the Tathāgata can expound in a single phrase;
such teachings and principles that equal the world are realized by the King of Valiant Wisdom.

All sentient beings dwell upon deviant paths; the Buddha reveals the inconceivable right path, universally enabling those in the world to become vessels of the Dharma—this the valiant Army-Conqueror can understand and realize.
Whatever meritorious deeds exist in the world, all arise from the illumination of the Buddha’s light;
the ocean of the Buddha’s wisdom is difficult to fathom—such is the liberation of abundant wealth.
Recalling incalculable eons of the past, the Buddha cultivated the ten powers therein until all those powers were brought to full perfection; this is what the King of the High Banner understands.
Furthermore, the Mahoraga King Good Wisdom attained the liberation door of using all supernatural powers and skillful means to cause sentient beings to accumulate merit;
the Mahoraga King Pure Resonance attained the liberation door of causing all sentient beings to eliminate afflictions and obtain coolness and joy;

the Mahoraga King Victorious Wisdom Adorned Topknot attained the liberation door of universally causing all sentient beings with wholesome or unwholesome thoughts and perceptions to enter the pure Dharma.
The Mahoraga King Subhāsanetrādhipati attained the liberation door of the equal sign of mastery over merit that is thoroughly realized and unattached to all things;
the Mahoraga King Pradīpadhvaja attained the liberation door of revealing the path to all sentient beings so that they may leave behind darkness and fear;
the Mahoraga King Varaprabhādhvaja attained the liberation door of generating joy by knowing the virtues of all Buddhas.
The Mahoraga King Siṃhakukṣi attained the liberation door of becoming a lord who protects and shelters all sentient beings through the power of valor;
the Mahoraga King Citravyūhaghoṣa attained the liberation door of causing all sentient beings to give rise to boundless joy and bliss according to their recollections;
the Mahoraga King Merukukṣi attained the liberation door of reaching the fulfillment of the other shore through unwavering certainty regarding all objects of focus.
The Mahoraga King Delightful Radiance attained the liberation door of revealing the path of equality to all sentient beings who are in a state of inequality.
At that time, the Mahoraga King Virtuous Wisdom and Majestic Light, empowered by the Buddha’s spiritual authority, surveyed the entire assembly of mahoragas and spoke in verse:
“Behold the Tathāgata’s nature, pure and stainless, Universally manifesting majestic light to benefit all classes of beings.”
He reveals the path of ambrosia to bring about coolness, so that all sufferings are forever extinguished and there is no further dependence.
All sentient beings dwell in the ocean of existence, bound and shrouded by their own evil karma and delusions;
he reveals to them the dharma of tranquility, which the majestic King of Dignified Sound (Vimalasvara) has well understood.
The Buddha’s wisdom is peerless and inconceivable; He knows the minds of sentient beings without exception.
For their sake, he proclaims the pure Dharma; Thus does Vyūḍhakeśa understand in his heart.
Immeasurable Buddhas appear in the world, universally serving as fields of merit for all sentient beings;
their ocean of blessings is vast and profound, difficult to fathom, yet Great King Wondrous Eye is able to see it all.
For all sentient beings afflicted by grief, fear, and suffering, The Buddha appears everywhere to provide protection;
Pervading the entire dharma-realm and empty space without exception— This is the sphere of activity of Dīpāṅkara.
The merits within a single pore of the Buddha, Even all the world together cannot fully comprehend;
Boundless and inexhaustible like space— Thus does the Great Radiant Banner perceive them.
The Tathāgata has thoroughly realized all dharmas; he illuminates their very nature with clarity.
Like Mount Sumeru, he is unshakable; O Lion-Shouldered One, you have entered this Dharma-gate.
In vast kalpas of the past, the Buddha accumulated an ocean of joy, deep and inexhaustible;
therefore, there is none who does not rejoice upon seeing him—this is the entryway of Dharmavyūharuta.
Thoroughly knowing that the dharma-realm is formless, The ocean of pāramitās is completely fulfilled;
With great light universally saving all sentient beings— Śailaśikhara knows this skillful means.
Behold the Tathāgata’s power of mastery, Manifesting throughout the ten directions without partiality;
All sentient beings are illuminated and awakened— This wondrous radiance can enter them skillfully.
Furthermore, the Kinnara King Radiance of Good Wisdom attained the liberation door of universally generating all karma of joy and bliss;
the Kinnara King Banner of Exquisite Flowers attained the liberation door of being able to generate supreme Dharma-joy and causing all beings to receive peace and happiness;
the Kinnara King Various Adornments attained the liberation door of the treasury of vast and pure faith-understanding that fulfills all merits.
The Kinnara King Manojña-ghoṣa attained the liberation door of constantly producing all manner of pleasing sounds that cause listeners to be freed from sorrow and fear;
the Kinnara King Ratnavṛkṣa-prabha attained the liberation door of establishing all sentient beings in great compassion so that they awaken to their objects of perception;
the Kinnara King Sarva-sukha-darśana attained the liberation door of manifesting bodies of every exquisite form.
The Kinnara King Supreme Light Adornment attained the liberation door of knowing the karma from which all supreme adornments and fruits arise;
the Kinnara King Subtle Flower Banner attained the liberation door of skillfully observing the retributions produced by the karma of all worlds;
the Kinnara King Earth-Shaking Power attained the liberation door of constantly initiating all activities that benefit sentient beings.
The Kinnara King Fierce Lord attained the liberation door of skillfully knowing the minds of all kinnaras and artfully guiding and governing them.
At that time, the Kinnara King Light of Good Wisdom, receiving the Buddha’s majestic power, surveyed the entire assembly of kinnaras and spoke in verse:
"All the matters of peace and happiness in the world, All arise from seeing the Buddha."
The Guide benefits all sentient beings, universally acting as a place of refuge and protection.
He gives rise to all forms of joy and happiness, which the world attains exhaustlessly.
He ensures that those who behold him do not do so in vain; this is what the Flower Banner has realized.
The ocean of the Buddha’s merits is inexhaustible; one cannot find its limit even by seeking it.
Its radiance shines universally throughout the ten directions; this is the liberation of King Adornment.
The Tathāgata’s great voice constantly flows forth, Revealing the true Dharma that brings freedom from sorrow;
All sentient beings who hear it are filled with joy, And are able to believe and accept such a roar.
I contemplate the Tathāgata’s power of mastery, Which arises entirely from practices cultivated in the past;
His great compassion rescues all beings and brings them to purity— This King of Jewel Trees is able to realize and enter this truth.
The Tathāgata is difficult to see or hear; sentient beings encounter him only once in billions of eons.
Adorned with all the primary marks in their entirety—this is what King Sukhāloka beholds.
Behold the Great Wisdom of the Tathāgata, which universally accords with the desires of the hearts of all living beings;
there is no path of omniscience that it does not proclaim—this most excellent adornment he is able to realize.
The ocean of karma is vast and inconceivable; from it arise all the suffering and happiness of sentient beings.
To reveal all such things as these is what the King of Flower Banners understands.
The supernatural powers of all Buddhas are uninterrupted; The great earth of the ten directions constantly trembles.
No sentient beings are able to know this, Yet this power of vast strength is ever clearly seen.
Abiding amidst the assembly, he manifests supernormal powers, emitting great radiance to awaken all beings and reveal the realm of all Tathāgatas; this is what the Fierce Lord is able to perceive.
Furthermore, the Garuḍa King Great Swift Power attained the liberation door of universally observing the realms of sentient beings with unattached and unobstructed eyes;
the Garuḍa King Indestructible Jewel Topknot attained the liberation door of universally abiding in the Dharma-realm to teach and transform sentient beings;
and the Garuḍa King Pure Swift Power attained the liberation door of the power of diligence that universally accomplishes the pāramitās.
The Garuḍa King Non-Retrogressive Mind Adornment attained the liberation door of entering the realm of the Tathāgata through the power of valor;
the Garuḍa King Great Ocean Abiding Sustaining Power attained the liberation door of entering the vast ocean of wisdom of the Buddha’s conduct;
the Garuḍa King Pure Light of Firm Dharma attained the liberation door of accomplishing the wisdom that distinguishes the infinite varieties of sentient beings.
The Garuḍa King Subhavyūha-cūḍa attained the liberation door of adorning the city of the Buddha-dharma;
the Garuḍa King Samantatīrthadarśana attained the liberation door of accomplishing indestructible power of equanimity;
the Garuḍa King Samantadarśanasāgara attained the liberation door of manifesting forms by knowing the bodies of all sentient beings.
The Garuḍa King Dragon-Sound Great Eye attained the liberation door of the wisdom that universally enters into the conduct of all sentient beings as they pass away and are reborn.
At that time, the Garuḍa King Great Swift Power, sustained by the Buddha’s majestic power, surveyed the entire assembly of Garuḍas and spoke in verse:
“The Buddha-eye is vast and without limit, Universally beholding all lands in the ten directions.”
The sentient beings therein are immeasurable; He manifests great supernormal powers to subdue them all.
The Buddha’s power of supernormal penetration is unimpeded; He sits everywhere beneath the Bodhi trees throughout the ten directions.
He expounds the Dharma like clouds that completely fill [the world]; Ratnaśikhin hears this and his mind does not resist.
In the past, the Buddha cultivated all practices, Universally purifying the vast pāramitās;
He made offerings to all Tathāgatas— This King Swift Wisdom has deep faith and understanding.
Within each and every pore of the Tathāgata, In a single thought-moment, infinite practices are universally manifested;
Such inconceivable realms of the Buddha— The adornments of non-retrogression are all clearly beheld.
The Buddha’s conduct is vast and inconceivable; No sentient beings can fathom it.
The ocean of merit and wisdom of the Guide— This is the sphere of activity of King Grasping.
The Tathāgata’s light of immeasurable wisdom Can extinguish the net of sentient beings’ ignorance and delusion;
He provides protection for all the worlds— This is what is upheld and proclaimed by Dṛḍhadharma.
The city of Dharma is vast and inexhaustible; its gates are manifold and beyond measure.
The Tathāgata, dwelling in the world, has opened them wide; this Wondrous Crown-Hair is able to clearly enter therein.
All Buddhas possess a single Dharma-body; True Suchness is equal and without discrimination.
The Buddha dwells eternally by this power, Which the King of Universal Swift Manifestation has fully expounded.
In the past, the Buddha gathered sentient beings from all realms of existence, universally radiating light throughout the world;
through various skillful means, he manifested subduing teachings—this supreme Dharma-gate was realized by Samudrareṇu.
The Buddha observes all lands, Which all abide depending upon the ocean of karma;
He rains down the rain of Dharma throughout them— Such is the power of the liberation "Dragon Sound."
Furthermore, the Asura King Rāhu attained the liberation door of manifesting as the sovereign lord of great assemblies;
the Asura King Vemacitrin attained the liberation door of manifesting immeasurable kalpas;
and the Asura King Skillful in Illusion attained the liberation door of extinguishing all suffering of sentient beings and causing them to be purified.
The Asura King Mahāparivāra attained the liberation door of adorning oneself through the cultivation of all ascetic practices;
the Asura King Bali attained the liberation door of shaking the boundless realms of the ten directions;
the Asura King Samantaprabha attained the liberation door of establishing all sentient beings through various skillful means.
The asura king Firm Practice of Sublime Adornment attained the liberation door of universally gathering indestructible roots of goodness to purify all defiled attachments;
the asura king Vast Cause of Wisdom attained the liberation door of being a master free from doubt through the power of great compassion;
the asura king Manifesting Supreme Virtue attained the liberation door of causing all to see the Buddha, to serve and make offerings, and to cultivate all roots of goodness.
The Asura King Supraśabdha attained the liberation door of the resolute practice of universal entry into all realms of existence with equanimity.
At that time, the Asura King Rāhu, sustained by the Buddha’s majestic power, surveyed the entire assembly of asuras and spoke in verse:
“Among all the vast assemblies throughout the ten directions, The Buddha is the most preeminent within them.
Its light shines everywhere, equal to space, appearing universally before all sentient beings.
In a single kṣaṇa, all Buddha-lands throughout hundreds of thousands of millions of kalpas are clearly manifested;
emitting light to transform beings without exception—thus Vimalakīrti deeply praised with joy.

The realm of the Tathāgata is without equal; through various Dharma gates, he constantly brings benefit, causing all the sufferings of sentient beings to be extinguished—this the King of Śambara is able to see.

Having practiced asceticism for immeasurable eons, benefiting sentient beings and purifying the world, the Sage’s wisdom was thereby universally perfected; thus did the Great Retinue King behold the Buddha.

With unimpeded and peerless great supernormal powers, he causes all lands throughout the ten directions to tremble universally, yet without causing sentient beings any alarm or fear; one of great power can clearly understand this.
The Buddha appears in the world to save sentient beings, revealing the path of omniscience to all;
he causes them all to abandon suffering and attain peace and happiness—this meaning has been extensively expounded by Samantaprabha.
All the oceans of merit existing in the world, the Buddha’s power can generate and cause them all to be pure;
the Buddha can reveal the place of liberation, and through firm practice and adornment, one enters this gate.

The Buddha’s body of great compassion is peerless; Moving everywhere without obstruction, it allows all to see, Appearing in the world like a reflected image; It is through wisdom that these merits can be proclaimed.
Rare and peerless are your great supernormal powers; you manifest bodies everywhere, filling the entire Dharma-realm.
Seated beneath each bodhi tree, you who possess this supreme virtue are able to proclaim this meaning.
The Tathāgata practiced throughout the three periods of time, traversing every cycle of rebirth in the various realms;
he has liberated sentient beings from suffering without exception—this is what King Wonderful Sound extols.
Furthermore, the Palace-Resident Day-God Manifestation attained the liberation door of universally entering all worlds;
the Day-God Initiating Wisdom Fragrance attained the liberation door of universally observing all sentient beings to benefit, gladden, and satisfy them;
the Day-God Delighting in Supreme Adornments attained the liberation door of being able to radiate the light of infinite, delightful, and pleasing dharmas.
The Daytime Spirit Sovereign of Wondrous Radiance of Flower Fragrance attained the liberation door of developing pure faith and understanding in boundless sentient beings;
the Daytime Spirit Sovereign of Universally Gathering Wondrous Medicines attained the liberation door of the power of universally radiant light through the accumulation of adornments;

the Daytime Spirit Sovereign of Joyful Eyes Delighting in Action attained the liberation door of universally awakening all sentient beings in suffering and joy so that they may all obtain the bliss of the Dharma.
The Day-Ruling Spirit Observing All Directions and Universally Manifesting attained the liberation door of bodies differentiated throughout the dharma realms of the ten directions;
the Day-Ruling Spirit Great Compassionate Power attained the liberation door of rescuing and protecting all sentient beings to bring them peace and happiness;
the Day-Ruling Spirit Radiance of Roots of Goodness attained the liberation door of the power of merit that universally generates joy and contentment.
The Daytime Spirit Sovereign of Exquisite Flower Garlands attained the liberation door of renown that is universally heard, whereby all sentient beings who see her obtain benefit.
At that time, the Daytime Spirit Sovereign Who Manifests Palaces, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of daytime spirits and spoke in verse:
"The Buddha's wisdom is like space, without end; Its radiance shines, pervading the ten directions."
They fully comprehend the mental activities of all sentient beings, penetrating every corner of the world;
they know the inclinations of the hearts of all beings and, accordingly, preach oceans of various dharmas.
These phrases and meanings are vast and each distinct, yet the Wisdom-Endowed Spirit is able to perceive them all.
The Buddha emits radiance that illuminates the world; those who see or hear it rejoice, for their merit is not in vain.
He reveals the profound, vast, and quiescent state; through this joy, the mind is adorned and attains awakening.
The Buddha rains down the Dharma rain in boundless measure, Causing those who behold it to experience great joy;
From this, the most excellent roots of goodness arise— Such is the wondrous light realized within the mind.

The power of universal entry into the Dharma-gates and the force of awakening—having cultivated and purified these throughout vast eons—all such acts are for the sake of gathering in sentient beings; this is what the Spirit Subtle Medicine understands.
Through various skillful means they transform all living beings; whether they see or hear them, all receive benefit.
They cause everyone to leap for joy with great delight—thus does the night deity Wondrous Eye behold.
The One Possessing the Ten Powers manifests throughout all worlds, Pervading the dharma-realm of the ten directions without exception;
Its essential nature is neither non-existent nor existent— This is the realm entered by the Spirit of Contemplating Directions.

Sentient beings wander through perilous difficulties; The Tathāgata, out of compassion, appears in the world, Causing all suffering to be utterly extinguished; This gate of liberation abides in the power of pity.
Sentient beings are shrouded in darkness, submerged in eternal night; The Buddha preaches the Dharma for them, bringing great illumination.
He causes all to attain bliss and eliminate all suffering; The deity Mahāsukhaprabha enters this gate.
The Tathāgata’s measure of merit is equal to space; All the various merits of the world arise from it.
Whatever he does is never in vain; Thus is the flower-garland of liberation attained.
Furthermore, the night goddess Samantaguṇaviśuddhaprabhā attained the liberation door of great heroic vigor through the joy of tranquil meditative concentration;
the night goddess Priyadarśanālokendrakṣāntimatī attained the liberation door of the marks of vast, pure, and delightful merit;
and the night goddess Lokapālajīvitābharaṇa attained the liberation door of universally manifesting throughout the world to discipline sentient beings.
The Night Goddess Silent Ocean Sound attained the liberation door of the accumulation of a vast mind of joy;
the Night Goddess Universal Manifestation of Auspiciousness attained the liberation door of profound, sovereign, and pleasing speech;
the Night Goddess Universal Emission of Tree Blossoms attained the liberation door of the treasury of vast joy fulfilled by radiance.
The Night Goddess Equal Protector and Nurturer attained the liberation door of awakening sentient beings and causing their roots of goodness to mature;
the Night Goddess Playful Joy attained the liberation door of protecting sentient beings with boundless compassion;
the Night Goddess Constantly Delighted Senses attained the liberation door of universally manifesting the adornments of great compassion.
The Night Goddess Manifesting Pure Merit attained the liberation door of universally causing all sentient beings to have their desires fulfilled.
At that time, the Night Goddess Universal Virtue Pure Light, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of night goddesses and spoke in verse:
“You should observe the conduct of the Buddha, Vast, tranquil, and possessing the characteristics of space.”
The ocean of desire is boundless, yet he purifies it all; free from defilement and majestic, he illuminates the ten directions.

All the worlds delight in beholding him; though he appears but once in an ocean of immeasurable eons, his great compassion regards all beings without exception—this gate of liberation is witnessed by Avalokiteśvara.
The Guide protects all worlds; sentient beings all see him before them.
He is able to purify all realms of existence; thus does the Protector of the World observe.
In the past, the Buddha cultivated an ocean of joy, vast, boundless, and unfathomable;
therefore, all who behold him rejoice—this is what Śāntasvara has realized.

The realm of the Tathāgata is immeasurable; Tranquil yet able to manifest throughout the ten directions, Universally causing the minds of all beings to be pure— Hearing this, the Night Goddess Śrī rejoices with exuberance.

Among sentient beings who possess no merit, the Buddha, adorned with great merit and most majestic brilliance, reveals to them the Dharma of detachment and quiescent extinction; the Universal Flower-Emanating Spirit awakens to this Path.
Manifesting great spiritual powers throughout the ten directions, All sentient beings are thoroughly tamed;
They cause all manner of forms and appearances to be seen— This is what the deity Hu-yu contemplates.
In every thought-moment of the past, the Tathāgata has completely purified the ocean of skillful means, compassion, and loving-kindness;
there is nowhere in the world that his protection does not reach—this is the liberation of the deity Puṇyasukha.
Sentient beings are constantly deluded, chaotic, and turbid; their minds are stubbornly poisonous and most fearsome.
Out of compassionate pity, the Tathāgata has appeared in the world; this deity who extinguishes enmity is now able to awaken to joy.
In the past, the Buddha practiced austerities for the sake of sentient beings, causing all their wishes and desires to be fulfilled;
thereby he perfected the marks of merit and virtue—this is the entryway of the deity Manifesting Blessings.
Furthermore, the World-Protecting Deity Pervading All Directions attained the liberation door of the power of universal protection;
the World-Protecting Deity Universally Manifesting Radiance attained the liberation door of the supernatural activity of accomplishing the transformation of all sentient beings;
the World-Protecting Deity Adorned with Luminous Conduct attained the liberation door of the great light that shatters all dark obstructions and gives rise to joy and bliss.
The Guardian Spirit of the Direction of Unobstructed Universal Travel attained the liberation door of universally manifesting in all places without laboring in vain;
the Guardian Spirit of the Direction of Permanently Severing Delusion attained the liberation door of manifesting names equal in number to all sentient beings to generate merit;
the Guardian Spirit of the Direction of Wandering Throughout the Pure Void attained the liberation door of constantly emitting wondrous sounds that cause all who hear them to rejoice.
The directional spirit Cloud Banner Great Sound Sovereign attained the liberation door of universally raining like a dragon to cause all sentient beings to rejoice and attain liberation;
the directional spirit Topknot Eyes Unconfused Sovereign attained the liberation door of the sovereign power to manifest that the karma of all sentient beings is without distinction;
the directional spirit Universal Observer of the World Sovereign attained the liberation door of observing the various karmas within all realms of rebirth.
The Sovereign Deity Who Roams Everywhere attained the liberation door of bringing all tasks to ultimate completion and generating joy in all sentient beings.
At that time, the Sovereign Deity Who Dwells Everywhere, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of sovereign deities who roam everywhere and spoke in verse:
“The Tathāgata, possessing sovereign mastery, appears in the world, To teach and transform all living beings.”
Universally revealing the Dharma gates to lead them to realization, Causing all to attain the unsurpassed wisdom.
His spiritual powers are immeasurable, equal to all sentient beings; According to their inclinations, he manifests various forms.
All who behold him receive liberation from suffering— This is the power of the liberation of the Spirit of Manifesting Light.
For the ocean of sentient beings obscured by darkness, the Buddha manifests the great radiance of the Dharma-torch;
its light shines everywhere so that nothing remains unseen—this is the liberation adorned by such practice.
Possessing all the various sounds of the world, he universally turns the wheel of Dharma such that none fail to understand;
those sentient beings who hear it have their afflictions extinguished—this is what the Spirit Pervasive Travel has realized.
All names that exist throughout all worlds arise as equal to the name of the Buddha;
he causes all sentient beings to leave behind delusion and confusion—this is the sphere of activity of the one who has severed ignorance.
If there are sentient beings who come before the Buddha, And hear the Tathāgata’s exquisite and wondrous voice,
There are none whose hearts do not give rise to great joy, As they travel throughout space and awaken to this Dharma.

In each and every instant, the Buddha universally rains down the boundless rain of the Great Dharma, causing the afflictions of all sentient beings to be extinguished; this is what the deity Meghadhvaja understands.
The oceans of all karmic actions in every world, the Buddha reveals them all equally and without distinction;
he causes all sentient beings everywhere to eliminate karma and delusion—this is what the goddess Keśinī understands.
The ground of omniscience is without limit; the various minds of all sentient beings, the Tathāgata perceives and understands them all clearly—this vast gateway, contemplate and enter it.
In the past, the Buddha cultivated all practices, Fully perfecting the immeasurable perfections;
With great compassion and pity, he benefits all sentient beings— This is the liberation of the Universal Wandering Spirit.
Furthermore, the space-ruling spirit Pure Light Shining Everywhere attained the liberation door of universally knowing the minds of all sentient beings in all realms of existence;
the space-ruling spirit Wandering Everywhere in the Profound and Vast attained the liberation door of universally entering the dharma-realm;
and the space-ruling spirit Producing Auspicious Winds attained the liberation door of thoroughly penetrating the bodily forms of infinite realms.
The space-ruling spirit Sovereign Abiding Free from Obstructions attained the liberation door of being able to eliminate the obstacles of karma and delusion for all sentient beings;
the space-ruling spirit Wondrous Topknot of Vast Steps attained the liberation door of universally observing and contemplating the ocean of vast practices;
the space-ruling spirit Unobstructed Radiance attained the liberation door of the light of great compassion universally rescuing and protecting all sentient beings from calamities and hardships.
The space-ruling spirit Unobstructed Supreme Power attained the liberation door of the power of merit for universally entering all things without attachment;
the space-ruling spirit Stainless Radiance attained the liberation door of purifying the minds of all sentient beings so they are free from all hindrances;
the space-ruling spirit Profound and Distant Sublime Sound attained the liberation door of the light of wisdom that universally perceives the ten directions.
The Space-Ruling Spirit named Light Pervading the Ten Directions attained the liberation door of universally manifesting throughout the world without moving from its original location.
At that time, the Space-Ruling Spirit Pure Light Universal Illumination, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed all the hosts of space-ruling spirits and spoke in verse:
“The Tathāgata’s vast eyes are as pure as empty space;”
Universally beholding all sentient beings, he understands them all with complete clarity.
The great radiance of the Buddha’s body shines throughout the ten directions;
appearing before all, he dwells everywhere, universally traversing and contemplating this Way.
The Buddha’s body is like space: Without arising, nothing to be grasped, Without attainment and without intrinsic nature— Thus it was seen by Śrīmat.
For immeasurable eons, the Tathāgata Has extensively expounded all the noble paths.
Universally extinguishing the obstructions of sentient beings, The Perfect Radiance awakened to this gate.
I observe the bodhisattva practices Accumulated by the Buddha in the past;
All were for the sake of bringing peace to the world— The Wondrous Topknot practiced within this realm.
All realms of sentient beings, wandering in the sea of birth and death— The Buddha emits the light that extinguishes suffering; the unimpeded one can see this.
A treasury of pure merit, capable of serving as a field of blessings for the world.
Awakening through wisdom accordingly, the deity Bala realized this here.
Sentient beings, shrouded by delusion, wander through perilous paths;
the Buddha emits a brilliant light for them, which the deity Vigatamala is able to realize.
With wisdom that knows no limit, he manifests throughout all lands;
his radiance illuminates the world—thus does Miaoyin behold the Buddha.
To deliver sentient beings, the Buddha practices throughout the ten directions.
"Thus, with such a great vow-mind, one can universally manifest and observe.
Furthermore, the wind-spirit Lord of Unobstructed Radiance attained the liberation door of universally entering the Buddha-dharma and all worlds;
the wind-spirit Universal Manifestation of Heroic Power attained the liberation door of making vast offerings to all Buddhas appearing in immeasurable lands.
The wind spirit Cloud Banner Whirlwind attained the liberation door of universally extinguishing the illnesses of all sentient beings with fragrant winds;

the wind spirit Pure Light Adornment attained the liberation door of universally generating the roots of goodness in all sentient beings and causing the mountains of heavy obstructions to be crushed and destroyed;
the wind spirit Power Able to Exhaust Water attained the liberation door of being able to shatter the boundless hosts of evil Māras.
The wind spirit Great Roaring Voice Everywhere attained the liberation door of eternally extinguishing all fears of sentient beings;
the wind spirit Tree-Tip Hanging Topknot attained the liberation door of entering the ocean of eloquence regarding the true reality of all phenomena;
the wind spirit Universal Unobstructed Conduct attained the liberation door of the treasury of skillful means for subduing all sentient beings.
The wind spirit Sovereign of Various Palaces attained the liberation door of entering the gate of tranquil meditative concentration to extinguish the darkness of most heavy ignorance;
the wind spirit Sovereign of Universal Radiance attained the liberation door of the unimpeded power to accord with the conduct of all sentient beings.
At that time, the Wind-Ruling Spirit Unobstructed Radiance, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed all the hosts of wind-ruling spirits and spoke in verse:
“The Dharma of all Buddhas is profoundly deep; Through unimpeded skillful means, they can universally enter it.
All that appears constantly in the world Is signless, formless, and without reflection.”
Observe how the Tathāgata in the past, in a single thought-moment, made offerings to boundless Buddhas;
this divine being Samantadarśin is able to fully comprehend such heroic practices for awakening.
The Tathāgata, the inconceivable savior of the world, employs every skillful means without fail;
he causes all sentient beings to be free from all suffering— this is the liberation of the deity Meghadhvaja.
Sentient beings lacking merit undergo manifold sufferings, Constantly deluded and obscured by heavy canopies and dense barriers;
May all be led to attain liberation— This is what the deity Pure Light understands.
The Tathāgata’s vast and great supernormal powers have utterly destroyed all hosts of Māra;
his courageous might and majestic authority can perceive all the skillful means for subduing them.
The Buddha emits wondrous sounds from his pores, And those sounds pervade the entire world;
They cause all suffering and fear to cease— This is what the deity Samantaghoṣa understands.
Throughout all oceans of lands, for inconceivable eons, the Buddha constantly expounds this wondrous eloquence of the Tathāgata’s stage; the deity Śikharajāta is able to comprehend it.
The Buddha, through all gates of skillful means, enters them all with wisdom without obstruction;
his realm is boundless and peerless—this is the liberation of the Spirit of Universal Conduct.
The realm of the Tathāgata is without limit; through various skillful means, he causes all to see it.
Yet his body is tranquil and free from all marks—this is the liberation door of the various palace deities.
The Tathāgata cultivated all practices throughout oceans of eons, And has brought all powers to complete fulfillment;
He can accord with worldly dharmas to respond to sentient beings— This is what the Spirit Universal Illumination perceives.
The Avataṃsaka Sūtra of the Buddha, Volume Three;
The Avataṃsaka Sūtra of the Buddha, Volume Four.
Translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Śikṣānanda of Khotan by Imperial Decree.
The Fourth Part of the First Chapter, "The Sublime Array of the World Rulers.
Furthermore, the Fire-Ruling Spirit named Universal Radiance Flame-Treasury attained the liberation door of completely eliminating all darkness in the world;

the Fire-Ruling Spirit named Universal Gathering Light Banner attained the liberation door of being able to pacify the suffering of the drifting heat and afflictions of all sentient beings; the Fire-Ruling Spirit named Great Light Universal Illumination attained the liberation door of the treasury of immovable power of merit and great compassion.
The Fire God Sovereign of Myriad Wondrous Palaces attained the liberation door of manifesting the boundless power of the Tathāgata’s spiritual penetrations;
the Fire God Sovereign of Exhaustless Radiant Topknots attained the liberation door of illuminating the boundless realm of empty space with light;
the Fire God Sovereign of Various Flaming Eyes attained the liberation door of the tranquil light adorned by various merits.
The Fire-God Sovereign of the Palace of the Ten Directions, like Mount Sumeru, attained the liberation door of being able to extinguish the blazing sufferings of all realms of existence in the world;
the Fire-God Sovereign of Majestic Light and Mastery attained the liberation door of freely awakening all in the world;
the Fire-God Sovereign Who Illuminates the Ten Directions attained the liberation door of forever shattering all foolish attachments and views.
The Fire-Ruling Spirit Thunder-Sound Lightning-Light attained the liberation door of the great thunderous roar that accomplishes all powers of aspiration.
At that time, the Fire-Ruling Spirit Universal Radiance Flame-Treasury, sustained by the Buddha’s spiritual power, surveyed the entire assembly of fire-ruling spirits and spoke in verse:
“Behold the Tathāgata’s power of diligence, Vast across billions of eons, inconceivable.”
Appearing in the world for the benefit of sentient beings, he causes all darkness and obstructions to be extinguished.

When sentient beings, out of ignorance, give rise to various views, and their afflictions flow like rivers or blaze like fire, the Guide employs skillful means to eliminate them entirely; Samantāloka-dhvaja attained awakening here.
Merit is like space, without end; one cannot find its limit even by seeking it.
This Buddha’s great compassion is beyond motion; its light shines forth, awakening those who enter it, so that their hearts give rise to joy.
I contemplate the conduct of the Tathāgata, which spans an ocean of kalpas without limit;
such a manifestation of supernormal powers is understood by the deities of the various wondrous palaces.
Cultivated for inconceivable billions of eons, its limits cannot be known;
manifesting the true reality of dharmas to bring joy—this is what the deity Infinite Light perceives.
All the vast assemblies throughout the ten directions, All now gaze upon the Buddha with reverence;
The tranquil radiance illuminates the world— This is what the goddess Subhūṣitā can perceive.
The Muni appears throughout all worlds, seated within every palace, universally raining down the boundless and vast Dharma; this is the realm of the deities of the ten directions.
The wisdom of all Buddhas is most profound; Masters of the Dharma, they appear in the world, Able to fully elucidate the principle of reality; Awakened by their majestic radiance, my heart rejoices.
All views are shrouded by the darkness of ignorance, And sentient beings wander in delusion through the cycle of existence;
The Buddha has opened and revealed the gateway of the wondrous Dharma— This illuminating deity Fangshen is able to awaken to and enter it.

The gates of aspiration are vast and inconceivable; having purified the powers and means through cultivation, all that was intended by their former vows now manifests—this is what the spirit Vajra-Resounding Sound understands.
Furthermore, the water spirit Samantotthitameghadhvaja attained the liberation door of compassion that equally benefits all sentient beings;
the water spirit Sāgarataraṅgaghoṣa attained the liberation door of the adornment of boundless dharmas;
the water spirit Rūpavarṇamaṇicūḍa attained the liberation door of universally gathering those to be transformed through skillful means by observing their needs.
The water-ruling spirit Skillful in Whirlpools attained the liberation door of universally expounding the profound realms of all Buddhas;
the water-ruling spirit Undefiled Fragrant Accumulation attained the liberation door of universally manifesting pure great radiance;
the water-ruling spirit Light-Sound of the Bridge of Merit attained the liberation door of the signless and natureless pure dharma-realm.
The water spirit Sovereign of Contentment attained the liberation door of the inexhaustible ocean of great compassion;
the water spirit Pure Joy and Virtuous Sound attained the liberation door of being a treasury of great joy within the assemblies of bodhisattvas at the site of enlightenment;
the water spirit Universal Manifestation of Majestic Light attained the liberation door of universal manifestation through the power of unimpeded and vast merit.
The water-ruling spirit Roar Pervading the Ocean attained the liberation door of observing all sentient beings and initiating skillful means for subduing them that are as vast as space.
At that time, the water-ruling spirit Cloud Banner Universally Arising, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of water-ruling spirits and spoke in verse:
“Pure gates of compassion, as numerous as the atoms of a world-system, Together produce a single wondrous mark of the Tathāgata.
Not one of these marks is otherwise; therefore, those who behold them never tire of doing so.
When the World-Honored One practiced in the past, he went before all Tathāgatas and cultivated every kind of purification without weariness;
thus did he enter through the clouds of skillful means and their sounds.
The Buddha, throughout all the ten directions, is tranquil and unmoving, with neither coming nor going;
yet he causes all sentient beings to behold him through his responsive transformations—this is what the Cūḍāmaṇi knows.
The realm of the Tathāgata is boundless and immeasurable; All sentient beings cannot comprehend it.
He proclaims wondrous sounds throughout the ten directions; This is the sphere of activity of the Spirit of Skillful Revolution.
The World-Honored One’s radiance is inexhaustible, Pervading the dharma-realm in an inconceivable way;
He preaches the Dharma and transforms beings to deliver them— This is what the spirit Pure Fragrance beholds.
The Tathāgata is pure and equal to space, Without marks and without form, pervading the ten directions;
Yet he causes the entire assembly to see him— This is the skillful observation of the spirit Puṇyaprabha.
In the past, the Buddha cultivated the gateway of great compassion; his mind was vast and pervasive, equal to all sentient beings.
Therefore, he appears in the world like a cloud; this liberation-gate is fully understood through such knowledge.
In all the lands throughout the ten directions, The Tathāgata is seen seated upon his throne;
He clearly awakens to great Bodhi— Such is the entry of this Joyful Sound.
The Tathāgata’s conduct is without obstruction, He travels everywhere to all lands in the ten directions;
Manifesting great supernormal powers in every place, He has already awakened through the universal display of his majestic light.
Cultivating boundless practices of skillful means, They fill the realms of sentient beings entirely;
The wondrous application of their supernormal powers never pauses, And they are able to enter this roar that pervades the ocean.

Furthermore, the ocean-dwelling spirit Lord of the Appearance of Jewel Light attained the liberation door of adorning the body with a sea of various jewels through the merit of bestowing gifts upon all sentient beings with an impartial mind;
the ocean-dwelling spirit Indestructible Vajra Banner attained the liberation door of skillfully protecting the roots of goodness of all sentient beings;
and the ocean-dwelling spirit Untainted by Dust attained the liberation door of being able to dry up the sea of afflictions of all sentient beings.
The ocean-ruling spirit Constantly Abiding Amidst Waves attained the liberation door of enabling all sentient beings to leave the evil realms;
the ocean-ruling spirit Auspicious Jewel Moon attained the liberation door of universally extinguishing the great darkness of ignorance;
the ocean-ruling spirit Exquisite Flower Dragon Topknot attained the liberation door of extinguishing the suffering of all destinies and bestowing peace and happiness.
The ocean-dwelling spirit Universal Sustainer of Light and Flavor attained the liberation door of purifying the nature of all sentient beings' delusions regarding various views;
the ocean-dwelling spirit Jewel Flame Flower Radiance attained the liberation door of giving birth to the bodhicitta of all jewel-like spiritual lineages;
the ocean-dwelling spirit Vajra Wondrous Topknot attained the liberation door of the ocean of merit of the immovable mind.
The ocean-dwelling sea spirit named Sound of the Ocean Tide and Thunder attained the liberation door of the samādhi gate of universally entering the dharma-realm.
At that time, the ocean-dwelling sea spirit named Appearance of Jewel Light, empowered by the Buddha’s majestic authority, surveyed all the hosts of ocean-dwelling sea spirits and spoke these verses:
"In inconceivable oceans of great kalpas, Making offerings to all Tathāgatas..."
Universally bestowing merit upon all living beings, Therefore his dignified majesty is most peerless.
Appearing throughout all worlds, He knows the faculties and desires of all sentient beings;
Universally proclaiming the great ocean of the Dharma, This is what the Steadfast Banner has joyfully realized.

The Great Teachers of all worlds send down the great rain of the Dharma-clouds, unfathomable; it dries up the boundless oceans of suffering—this is the gateway to the Dharma for those free from defilement.
All sentient beings are shrouded by afflictions, Cycling through various realms and undergoing manifold sufferings;
To reveal for them the realm of the Tathāgata, The Spirit of the Universal Water Palace enters this gate.
Throughout an inconceivable ocean of kalpas, the Buddha cultivated all practices without end;
forever severing the net of delusion and confusion for sentient beings, the Jewel Moon is able to enter into this clearly.
The Buddha beholds sentient beings constantly in terror, transmigrating within the great ocean of birth and death;
he reveals to them the unsurpassed path of the Tathāgata, and Longji awakens to this understanding and gives rise to joy.
The realm of all Buddhas is inconceivable; The dharma-realm and empty space share the same mark of equality.
Able to purify the net of sentient beings' delusions and confusion, One who upholds and savors this [teaching] can proclaim it thus.
The Buddha-eye is pure and inconceivable, encompassing all realms of existence;
it universally reveals the various wondrous paths to all sentient beings—this is what the mind of Flower-Light has realized.
The vast and countless armies of Māra were utterly destroyed in a single kṣaṇa;
his mind was unshakable and unfathomable—this is the skillful means of Vajramukuṭa.
Throughout the ten directions they proclaim wondrous sounds, And those sounds pervade the entire Dharma-realm;
This is the realm of the Tathāgata’s samādhi, The sphere of activity of the deity Ocean Tide Sound.
Furthermore, the River Spirit named Universal Emission of Swift Currents attained the liberation door of universally raining down the boundless rain of Dharma;

the River Spirit named Universal Purification of Springs and Streams attained the liberation door of universally manifesting before all sentient beings to cause them to forever leave afflictions behind;

the River Spirit named Dust-Free Pure Eye attained the liberation door of universally cleansing the dust and grime of the delusions of all sentient beings through the skillful means of great compassion.
The River Spirit Sovereign Roaring Throughout the Ten Directions attained the liberation door of constantly producing sounds that benefit all sentient beings;
the River Spirit Sovereign Universally Protecting Sentient Beings attained the liberation door of constantly giving rise to a compassion free from affliction and harm toward all conscious beings;
the River Spirit Sovereign Heatless Pure Light attained the liberation door of universally manifesting all roots of goodness that bring coolness.
The River Spirit Universal Joy-Producer attained the liberation door of perfecting the practice of giving so that all sentient beings may forever be free from stinginess and attachment;
the River Spirit Vast Virtue Victorious Banner attained the liberation door of acting as a field of merit for the joy of all;
the River Spirit Light Illuminating All Worlds attained the liberation door of enabling all defiled sentient beings to become pure and those with the poison of anger to find joy.
The River Goddess Sāgaraprabha attained the liberation door of being able to cause all sentient beings to enter the ocean of liberation and constantly experience the joy of perfect fulfillment.
At that time, the River Goddess Samantataraṅgavega, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of river goddesses and spoke these verses:
“The Tathāgata, in the past, for the sake of sentient beings, Cultivated boundless practices within the ocean of Dharma.”
Just as a torrential rain clears away the heat of a sweltering summer, universally extinguishing the feverish afflictions of sentient beings;
so too did the Buddha, through immeasurable eons difficult to describe, purify the world with the radiance of his vows,
causing those whose faculties were mature to awaken to the Way— this is what the divine mind of Pujie has realized.

With great compassion and skillful means, he is equal toward all sentient beings; appearing before them all, he constantly transforms and guides them, universally causing them to purify the defilements of affliction—seeing this with pure eyes, I am filled with deep joy.
The Buddha unfolds the wondrous sound so that all may hear; Sentient beings cherish it and their hearts rejoice.
He causes them all to wash away immeasurable suffering; This is the liberation of the deity Samantaghoṣa.
In the past, the Buddha cultivated the practices for enlightenment for the sake of benefiting sentient beings throughout immeasurable eons;
therefore, his radiance pervades the world, and the protective deities, mindful of this, give rise to joy.
In the past, the Buddha practiced austerities for the sake of sentient beings, employing various skillful means to bring them to maturity;
having universally purified the ocean of merit and eliminated all sufferings, Anavatapta beholds this and his heart rejoices.
The gate of giving is vast and inexhaustible, Benefiting all sentient beings without exception;
It enables those who behold it to be free from stinginess and attachment— This is what the deity Sampraharṣaṇī has realized.
The Buddha practiced true skillful means in the past, Accomplishing an ocean of boundless merit;
He causes all who behold him to rejoice— This is what the spirit Victorious Banner has realized with a joyful heart.
All sentient beings with defilements are thoroughly purified; toward all enemies and harm, he gives rise to equanimous compassion.
Thus he attains a light that fills the void of space, and the river deities of the entire world behold it with joy.

The Buddha is a field of merit and an ocean of virtue; He enables all beings to leave behind every evil, And even brings them to the fulfillment of great enlightenment— This is the liberation of the spirit-sea Radiance.

Furthermore, the Crop-Sustaining Spirit Gentle and Exquisite Flavor attained the liberation door of bestowing the flavor of the Dharma upon all sentient beings to cause them to achieve the Buddha-body;
the Crop-Sustaining Spirit Timely Flower Pure Light attained the liberation door of enabling all sentient beings to experience vast joy and bliss;
and the Crop-Sustaining Spirit Vigorous Strength and Valor attained the liberation door of purifying all realms through the gate of all-perfect dharmas.
The Crop-Master Spirit Increasing Vital Energy attained the liberation door of witnessing the Buddha’s immeasurable power of great compassion and miraculous transformations;
the Crop-Master Spirit Producing Universal Roots and Fruits attained the liberation door of universally manifesting the Buddha-field of merit so that seeds sown are never lost or destroyed;
the Crop-Master Spirit Wondrously Adorned Circular Topknot attained the liberation door of universally causing the flowers of pure faith to bloom in all sentient beings.

The field-protecting deity Moistening Pure Flowers attained the liberation door of great compassion and pity that rescues all sentient beings and causes the ocean of their merit and virtue to increase;
the field-protecting deity Accomplishing Sublime Fragrance attained the liberation door of extensively revealing and teaching all methods of practice;

the field-protecting deity Loved by All Who Behold attained the liberation door of enabling all sentient beings throughout the dharma-realm to abandon indolence, sorrow, affliction, and other evils, becoming universally pure.

The Crop-Protecting Spirit Radiance Free from Defilement attained the liberation door of observing the roots of goodness of all sentient beings and teaching the Dharma according to their needs, causing the entire assembly to rejoice, be satisfied, and attain liberation.
At that time, the Crop-Master Spirit named Gentle Supreme Flavor, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of Crop-Master Spirits and spoke these verses:
“The Tathāgata is an unsurpassed ocean of merit; Like a universally manifesting bright lamp, he illuminates the world.
He rescues and protects all sentient beings, Bestowing peace and happiness upon them all without exception.”
The virtues of the World-Honored One are boundless; For all sentient beings who hear them, it is not in vain.
They cause all to leave suffering behind and always rejoice; This is the entryway of the Flower of the Proper Time.
The Sugata’s powers are all perfected; adorned with merit, he appears in the world.
All sentient beings are fully tamed—this Dharma, through its heroic power, can be clearly realized.
In the past, the Buddha cultivated the ocean of great compassion; his mind, in every thought-moment, was equal to the world.
Therefore, his supernormal powers are boundless, and he can perceive and augment vital energy.
The Buddha is ever present throughout the world, And no skillful means go to waste;
He completely purifies all the delusions and afflictions of sentient beings— This is the liberation of Universal Birth Deity.
The Buddha is the great ocean of wisdom in the world; He radiates pure light that reaches everywhere, From which vast faith and understanding are all born; Thus can Adorned Topknot clearly enter.
The Tathāgata observes the world and gives rise to a heart of compassion;
appearing for the benefit of sentient beings, he reveals to them the most supreme path of tranquility and joy—this is the liberation of the deity Pure Flower.
The pure conduct practiced by the Sugata was fully proclaimed beneath the Bodhi tree;
such teachings pervading the ten directions are heard and received by this goddess of exquisite fragrance.
The Buddha, throughout all worlds, causes all beings to leave sorrow behind and give rise to great joy;
he thoroughly purifies all their faculties and desires, so that this delightful deity may awaken and enter [the truth].

When the Tathāgata appears in the world, he universally observes the inclinations of the minds of sentient beings and brings them to maturity through various skillful means; this is the liberation door of the spirit Pure Light.
Furthermore, the medicinal goddess Śrīpati attained the liberation door of universally observing the minds of all sentient beings and diligently gathering them in;
the medicinal goddess Candanavana attained the liberation door of gathering sentient beings through radiance so that those who see it do not pass by in vain;
the medicinal goddess Virajaprabhā attained the liberation door of being able to extinguish the afflictions of all sentient beings through pure skillful means.
The medicinal goddess Renowned Everywhere attained the liberation door of being able to increase the boundless ocean of roots of goodness through great renown;
the medicinal goddess Light Manifesting from Pores attained the liberation door of swiftly proceeding to the realms of all illnesses with the banner of great compassion;
