the medicinal goddess Purifying Darkness attained the liberation door of healing all sentient beings who are blind and ignorant, causing their eye of wisdom to become pure.
The medicinal spirit Universal Roar Master attained the liberation door of being able to manifest the Buddha’s voice to explain the distinct meanings of all dharmas;

the medicinal spirit Sunlight-Overpowering Banner Master attained the liberation door of acting as a spiritual friend to all sentient beings, causing all who see them to give rise to roots of goodness;

the medicinal spirit Clearly Seeing the Ten Directions attained the liberation door of the treasury of pure great compassion, which enables one to use skillful means to inspire faith and understanding.
The medicinal deity Universal Radiance of Majestic Power attained the liberation door of using skillful means to cause sentient beings to recollect the Buddha and eliminate all illnesses.
At that time, the medicinal deity Auspiciousness, empowered by the Buddha’s spiritual authority, surveyed the entire assembly of medicinal deities and spoke in verse:
“The wisdom of the Tathāgata is inconceivable; It fully knows the minds of all sentient beings.”
Able to employ various powers of skillful means, He extinguishes the immeasurable suffering of the deluded multitudes.
The Great Hero’s skillful artistry is difficult to fathom; Whatever he does never goes in vain.
He ensures that the sufferings of sentient beings are extinguished— The deity of the sandalwood grove can realize this.

Observe that the teachings of all Buddhas are thus: having diligently practiced throughout immeasurable eons in the past, they remain unattached to any state of existence; this is the gateway entered by the Light Free from Dust.
A Buddha is difficult to encounter even in hundreds of thousands of kalpas;
if one should behold him or hear his name, it will surely bring benefit and never pass in vain—this is what the divine Being of Universal Renown understands.
From each and every pore of the Tathāgata, he emits radiant light that extinguishes all afflictions;
he causes the defilements of the world to be utterly exhausted—this is the gate entered by the deity Prabhākara.
All sentient beings are blinded by ignorance; their delusions, karma, and manifold sufferings are immeasurable.
The Buddha completely eliminates these and opens the light of wisdom; thus, he is able to perceive and see through the destruction of darkness.
The single voice of the Tathāgata is immeasurable, Able to open the ocean of all dharma-gates;
All sentient beings who hear it understand it completely— This is the liberation of the Great Sound.
Behold the Buddha’s wisdom, inconceivable, Manifesting everywhere across all realms to save all beings;
It enables all who see it to follow its transformation— This Banner of the Sun-Obstructing One has deeply realized this.
The Tathāgata’s ocean of great compassion and skillful means appears for the benefit of the world;
he extensively opens the right path and reveals it to all sentient beings—this the deity Fangjian understands thoroughly.
The Tathāgata universally radiates great light, Which illuminates all throughout the ten directions;
Causing merit to arise according to mindfulness of the Buddha— This is the liberation door of "Emanating Majestic Light."
Furthermore, the forest-ruling spirit Flower-Spreading-Cloud-Like obtained the liberation door of the vast and boundless treasury of the ocean of wisdom;
the forest-ruling spirit Stem-Erecting-Radiance-Emitting obtained the liberation door of the vast cultivation and purification of universal purity;
the forest-ruling spirit Sprout-Blossoming-Glory obtained the liberation door of increasing the sprouts of various pure faiths.
The forest-ruling spirit Auspicious Pure Leaf attained the liberation door of the accumulation of all pure merit-adornments;
the forest-ruling spirit Draped Flame Treasury attained the liberation door of the universal gate of pure wisdom that constantly surveys the entire dharma-realm;
the forest-ruling spirit Sublime Adornment Light attained the liberation door of universally knowing the ocean of the conduct of all sentient beings and spreading clouds of Dharma.
The forest spirit Pleasing Thunder Sound attained the liberation door of enduring all unpleasant sounds while manifesting pure tones;
the forest spirit Universal Fragrance Light attained the liberation door of universally manifesting throughout the ten directions the spheres of vast conduct practiced in the past;
the forest spirit Exquisite Light Reflected Radiance attained the liberation door of benefiting the world through all dharmas of merit.

The forest deity named Flower-Fruit-Light-Taste-Master attained the liberation door of the treasury of adorned merit, which enables all to see the appearance of Buddhas in the world and to always remember them with reverence without forgetting.
At that time, the forest-ruling spirit Flower-Cloud-Like, empowered by the Buddha’s majestic authority, surveyed all the hosts of forest-ruling spirits and spoke in verse:
“The Buddha of old cultivated the practices for enlightenment; His merit and wisdom were both fully perfected.
All powers are completely possessed; He emits great radiance, appearing in the world.”
The gate of compassion is immeasurable and equal to all sentient beings; the Tathāgata purified it universally in the past.
Therefore, he is able to benefit the world—this is what the deity Netrodbhava understands.

If there are sentient beings who see the Buddha even once, he will surely cause them to enter the ocean of profound faith and universally reveal the path of all Tathāgatas; this is the liberation of the deity Subhagarbha.
The myriad merits gathered within a single hair could not be fully proclaimed even throughout oceans of eons;
the skillful means of all Buddhas are inconceivable, yet Pure Leaf is able to clarify this profound meaning.
I recall that in the past, the Tathāgata made offerings to infinite Buddhas as numerous as the atoms of a world-system;
at the abode of each Buddha, his wisdom gradually became clearer—this is what the spirit Jvālāgarbha understands.
The ocean of all sentient beings' various activities, the World-Honored One fully knows in a single thought;
such vast and unimpeded wisdom, the deity Subhavyūha is able to awaken to and enter.
Constantly emitting the Tathāgata’s tranquil and wondrous voice, universally generating peerless and great joy,
causing all to awaken according to their understanding and inclinations— this is the Dharma practiced by Thunder Sound.
The Tathāgata manifests great supernormal powers, pervading all lands throughout the ten directions;
he causes all that was practiced in the past by the Buddha to be seen—this is the gateway entered by Universal Fragrance Light.
Sentient beings are deceitful and do not cultivate virtue; deluded and submerged, they drift through the cycle of birth and death.
To illuminate for them the path of manifold wisdom—this is what the deity Sublime Light perceives.
For the sake of sentient beings hindered by karmic obstructions, the Buddha appears only after the passage of billions of eons;
yet for others, he is constantly visible at every thought-moment—this is what the spirit Rasmi-vigata-saṃtāpa observes.
Furthermore, the mountain spirit Jewel Peak Blooming Flower attained the liberation door of entering the light of great tranquil concentration;

the mountain spirit Flower Forest Wondrous Topknot attained the liberation door of cultivating and gathering roots of goodness through kindness and compassion to mature inconceivable numbers of sentient beings;
the mountain spirit High Banner Universal Illumination attained the liberation door of observing the inclinations of the minds of all sentient beings to purify their faculties.
The mountain spirit Dust-Free Jewel Topknot attained the liberation door of tireless and diligent vigor throughout oceans of boundless eons;
the mountain spirit Light Illumining the Ten Directions attained the liberation door of universally awakening through the light of boundless merit;
the mountain spirit Great Power Radiance attained the liberation door of being able to mature oneself and further causing sentient beings to abandon delusion and ignorance.
The mountain spirit Sovereign of Universal Majestic Radiance attained the liberation door of uprooting all suffering so that none remains;
the mountain spirit Sovereign of Subtle and Secret Light Orbs attained the liberation door of manifesting the light of the teaching to reveal the merits of all Tathāgatas;
the mountain spirit Sovereign of Universal Vision attained the liberation door of causing all sentient beings to increase their roots of goodness even within dreams.
The mountain spirit Vajra-dṛḍha-locana attained the liberation door of manifesting an ocean of boundless great meanings.
At that time, the mountain spirit Puṣpa-vicitra-bhūmi, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of mountain spirits and spoke these verses:
“Having cultivated supreme practices without limit, You have now attained immeasurable supernormal powers.”
The Dharma gates are widely opened, as numerous as atoms, Causing all sentient beings to deeply awaken and rejoice.
Adorned with myriad marks, his body pervades the world; The light from every pore is utterly pure.
With great compassion and skillful means, he reveals all things— This gate was realized by Huālín Miàojì.
The Buddha’s body appears everywhere without limit, filling all worlds throughout the ten directions;
its faculties are pure and adorned, bringing joy to all who behold it—one who can realize this is able to enter the high banner of the Dharma.
Diligently practicing through kalpas without weariness, unstained by worldly dharmas like empty space,
employing various skillful means to transform all beings— one who awakens to this dharma gate is named Ratnaśikhin.

Sentient beings, blind and in darkness, enter perilous paths; The Buddha, out of compassion for them, spreads forth his illuminating light, Causing the entire world universally to awaken from sleep; Through this majestic radiance, my mind awakens and joy arises.
In the past, throughout all realms of existence, they practiced extensively, making offerings to Buddhas as numerous as the atoms of lands;
causing sentient beings to see them and give rise to great vows—this ground of great power can clearly enter.

Beholding all sentient beings wandering in suffering, Constantly entangled and shrouded by all karmic obstructions, He utterly extinguishes them with the light of wisdom; This is the liberation of the Universal Victorious Deity.
From each and every pore issues a wondrous sound, Praising all Buddhas according to the minds of sentient beings;
It pervades the ten directions throughout immeasurable eons— This is the entrance of the light-wheel.
The Buddha appears everywhere throughout the ten directions, Expounding the wondrous Dharma through various skillful means;
He extensively benefits the ocean of all beings' practices— This is what the deity Pratyakṣadarśin has realized.
The Dharma gates are like the ocean, boundless and immeasurable; With a single voice he explains them so that all may understand.
He expounds them throughout all kalpas without exhaustion— Enter this skillful means, O Vajra Eye.
Furthermore, the earth-ruling spirit Universal Virtue Pure Flower attained the liberation door of universally observing all sentient beings with every thought through a mind of compassion;
the earth-ruling spirit Adorned with Firm Merit attained the liberation door of universally manifesting the power of the merit of all sentient beings;
and the earth-ruling spirit Adorned with Exquisite Flowers attained the liberation door of universally entering all dharmas to give rise to the adornments of all buddha-fields.
The Earth-Ruling Spirit Universal Scattering of Various Jewels attained the liberation door of practicing various samādhis to cause sentient beings to eliminate hindrances and defilements;
the Earth-Ruling Spirit Pure Eye Observing Time attained the liberation door of causing all sentient beings to always sport in joy;
the Earth-Ruling Spirit Golden Wondrous Eye attained the liberation door of manifesting all pure bodies to subdue sentient beings.
The earth goddess Fragrant Hair Emitting Light attained the liberation door of the great power of knowing the ocean of all Buddhas' merits;
the earth goddess Tranquil Sound Pleasing to the Mind attained the liberation door of universally sustaining the ocean of the speech and sounds of all sentient beings;
the earth goddess Wondrous Flower Swirling Topknot attained the liberation door of the stainless nature that fills all Buddha-fields.
The earth-ruling goddess Vajra-Universal-Sustainer attained the liberation door of the universal manifestation sustained by the wheel of the Dharma of all Buddhas.
At that time, the earth-ruling goddess Samanta-Guṇa-Viśuddha-Kusuma, empowered by the Buddha’s majestic authority, surveyed the entire assembly of earth-ruling goddesses and spoke these verses:
“In the Tathāgata’s past, in every single thought-moment, The gates of great compassion were unspeakable in number;”
Having thus practiced without end, he has attained a firm and indestructible body.
All the multitudes of merit belonging to the sentient beings and bodhisattvas of the three periods of time appear entirely within the pores of the Tathāgata;
having seen this "Array of Merit," they give rise to joy.
The vast and quiescent samādhi, Unborn, undying, without coming or going,
Adorns and purifies buddha-fields to manifest to sentient beings— This is the liberation of the Tree Flower Spirit.
In the past, the Buddha cultivated all practices in order to cause sentient beings to eliminate heavy obstructions;
seeing this liberation, the Earth-Ruling Goddess who Scatters All Jewels everywhere gave rise to joy.
The realm of the Tathāgata is boundless, appearing universally throughout the world in every thought-moment;
when the Earth-Ruling Spirit Pure Eyes beheld this, her heart was filled with joy at the Buddha’s deeds.
With wondrous voices infinite and inconceivable, Universally extinguishing the afflictions of all sentient beings,
The golden-eyed deity was able to realize and understand, Beholding the Buddha’s boundless and supreme merits.
All forms and shapes are manifested through transformation, filling the dharma-realm of the ten directions;
from fragrant hairs they emit light, constantly beholding the Buddha, thus universally transforming all sentient beings.
His wondrous voice pervades the ten directions, preaching for the sake of the multitudes throughout immeasurable eons;
the Earth Deity Manojñā, having understood it with her mind, heard it from the Buddha and felt profound reverence and joy.
From the pores of the Buddha’s body, clouds of fragrant flames emerge, pervading the world according to the minds of sentient beings;
all who behold them are brought to maturity—this is the realm perceived by Puṣpadāma.
Firm and indestructible like a vajra, Unshakable beyond Mount Sumeru,
The Buddha’s body abides thus in the world, Universally supporting all who behold it and giving rise to joy.
Furthermore, the City-Ruling Spirit Jewel-Peak Radiance attained the liberation door of benefiting sentient beings through skillful means;
the City-Ruling Spirit Exquisite Adornment Palace attained the liberation door of knowing the faculties of sentient beings to teach and mature them;
the City-Ruling Spirit Pure Joy Jewel attained the liberation door of constant joy that causes all sentient beings to receive various merits and virtues.
The City-Ruling Spirit Free from Sorrow and Pure attained the liberation door of the treasury of great compassion that rescues all from fear;
the City-Ruling Spirit Flower-Lamp Flame-Eye attained the liberation door of universally manifesting great wisdom;
the City-Ruling Spirit Flame-Banner Clearly Manifest attained the liberation door of universally manifesting through skillful means.
The City-Ruling Spirit Abundant Merit and Majestic Radiance attained the liberation door of universally observing all sentient beings and causing them to cultivate a vast ocean of merit;
the City-Ruling Spirit Pure Radiant Body attained the liberation door of awakening all ignorant and dark sentient beings;
the City-Ruling Spirit Fragrant Banner Adornment attained the liberation door of observing the Tathāgata’s sovereign power pervading the world to discipline sentient beings.
The City-Ruling Spirit Jewel-Peak Radiant Eye attained the liberation door of being able to shatter the mountains of obstructions of all sentient beings with great radiance.
At that time, the City-Ruling Spirit Jewel-Peak Radiance, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of city-ruling spirits and spoke in verse:
“The Guide is thus inconceivable; His radiance shines universally throughout the ten directions.”
Sentient beings see the Buddha before them, Teaching and ripening countless numbers.
The various faculties of all beings differ, And the Buddha knows them all without exception.
O City-Ruling Spirit of the Wondrously Adorned Palace, Entering this Dharma-door, your heart is filled with joy.
The Tathāgata practiced for immeasurable eons, Protecting and upholding the teachings of all past Buddhas;
His mind constantly served them with joy— The deity of the City of Wondrous Jewels has awakened to this gate.

The Tathāgata has long since been able to dispel all the fears of all sentient beings, yet he constantly gives rise to loving-kindness and compassion toward them; this is why the spirit Viśokā’s mind awakens to joy.
The Buddha’s wisdom is vast and boundless, Like space, it cannot be measured;
The deity of Puṣpākṣa City, realizing this with joy, Is able to study the Tathāgata’s wondrous insight.
The Tathāgata’s physical marks and so forth are equal to those of all sentient beings; according to their inclinations and desires, he causes them all to see him.
When the Flame Banner clearly appears, the mind is able to awaken; by practicing these skillful means, one gives rise to joy.
The Tathāgata, having cultivated an ocean of myriad merits in the past— pure, vast, and without limit—
the light from the Banner of Merit gate observes this and, through full realization, rejoices with a joyful heart.
Sentient beings are deluded within the various realms of existence, Like those born blind in this world who see nothing at all;
The Buddha arises in the world for their benefit— The deity Pure Light enters through this gate.
The Tathāgata’s sovereignty is boundless, pervading the world like a cloud;
even manifesting in dreams to bring beings to subdual—this is what Gandhaketurāja beholds.
Sentient beings are shrouded in the darkness of ignorance like the blind;
entangled and covered by various hindrances and obscurations, the Buddha’s light shines through them, causing them all to open wide—this is the entry of Jewel Peak.
Furthermore, the sanctuary deity Pure Adorned Banner attained the liberation door of the power of vows to manifest vast adornments for making offerings to the Buddhas;
the sanctuary deity Sumeru Jewel Light attained the liberation door of manifesting before all sentient beings to accomplish vast practices for enlightenment;

the sanctuary deity Thunder Sound Banner attained the liberation door of causing all sentient beings, according to their hearts' inclinations, to see the Buddha in their dreams and preach the Dharma to them.
The Dharma-protector of the site named Rain of Flowers Wondrous Eye attained the liberation door of being able to rain down all manner of difficult-to-renounce precious ornaments;

the Dharma-protector of the site named Pure Flame Form attained the liberation door of being able to manifest wondrously adorned sites of enlightenment, extensively transforming sentient beings and bringing them to maturity;
the Dharma-protector of the site named Flower Garland Hanging Topknot attained the liberation door of preaching the Dharma according to faculties to give rise to right mindfulness.
The presiding deity of the enlightenment site named Rain of Jewels Adornment attained the liberation door of being able to universally rain down boundless teachings of joy through eloquence;
the presiding deity of the enlightenment site named Valiant Fragrant Eye attained the liberation door of extensively praising the merits of all Buddhas;
the presiding deity of the enlightenment site named Diamond-Colored Cloud attained the liberation door of manifesting the adornment of enlightenment sites with trees of boundless forms and colors.
The Dharma-realm deity Lotus Radiance attained the liberation door of remaining tranquil and unmoving beneath the Bodhi tree while pervading the ten directions;
the Dharma-realm deity Sublime Light Illumination attained the liberation door of manifesting the various powers of the Tathāgata.
At that time, the goddess of the path-mansion named Pure Adorned Banner, empowered by the Buddha’s spiritual authority, surveyed the entire assembly of path-mansion deities and spoke in verse:

“I recall how, in the past, when the Tathāgata was practicing his cultivation over immeasurable eons, he made offerings to all the Buddhas who appeared; therefore, he has attained great merit as vast as space.”
In the past, the Buddha practiced inexhaustible giving, equal in measure to the atoms within immeasurable lands;
Bodhivibhūṣaṇa, illuminated by the light of Mount Sumeru, recalled the Sugata and rejoiced in his heart.
The Tathāgata’s physical marks are inexhaustible; His transformations circulate through all lands, Constantly manifesting even within dreams; Seeing this, Leidong gives rise to joy.
In the past, throughout immeasurable eons, you practiced the conduct of relinquishment; you were able to give away what is most difficult to give, such as eyes as vast as the ocean.
You practiced such relinquishment for the sake of sentient beings; O Divyalocana, may you awaken to this joy.
Infinite clouds of jewel-flames with various forms appear throughout the world at the site of enlightenment;
the pure deity of the bodhimaṇḍa, seeing the Buddha’s sovereign power, gives rise to joy.
The ocean of sentient beings' conduct is boundless; the Buddha universally encompasses them, raining down the Dharma rain.
According to their faculties and dispositions, he dispels their doubts and delusions; hearing this, Puṣpamālā attained awakening and his heart rejoiced.
The distinctions of the meanings of immeasurable Dharma-gates— The ocean of eloquence can enter them all;
The deity of the site who rains down precious ornaments Constantly maintains this state in every thought-moment of the mind.
Throughout all unspeakable lands, he exhaustively praised the Buddha with every word and expression in the world;
thus he attained the great merit of renown, which the courageous Divyacakṣus is able to recollect.
Trees of infinite forms and colors appear everywhere beneath the King of Bodhi Trees;
Vajra-Cloud of Variegated Radiance awakens to this gate, Constantly contemplating the Tree of the Path and giving rise to joy.
The limits of the ten directions cannot be found, and the wisdom of the Buddha seated at the site of enlightenment is likewise so;
with pure faith that walks upon the light of lotus flowers, one enters this liberation and gives rise to profound joy.

From the entire site of enlightenment, wondrous sounds emerge, praising the Buddha’s inconceivable power of purity and the accomplishment of all causal practices; the spirit Sublime Light is able to hear and receive them.
Furthermore, the footstep-following spirit Jewel Seal attained the liberation door of universally raining down various jewels to give rise to vast and great joy;
the footstep-following spirit Lotus Light attained the liberation door of manifesting the Buddha’s body seated upon lotus thrones of every color and radiance, causing all who see it to rejoice;
the footstep-following spirit Supreme Flower Topknot attained the liberation door of establishing the assembly sites and *bodhimaṇḍas* of all Tathāgatas within each and every thought-moment.
The footstep-following spirit Samantadarśanapāda attained the liberation door of lifting the feet and taking steps to fully subdue and liberate infinite sentient beings;

the footstep-following spirit Ratnaratnadhvajapāda attained the liberation door of manifesting various lotus-net radiances in every thought-moment, universally raining down all manner of jewels and producing sublime sounds;
the footstep-following spirit Rucitavicitraghoṣa attained the liberation door of giving rise to an ocean of boundless joy.
The earth-dwelling spirit Candanadrumanirbhāsa attained the liberation door of universally awakening all assemblies at sites of enlightenment with fragrant winds;
the earth-dwelling spirit Padmaprabha attained the liberation door of emitting light from every pore to proclaim the subtle and wondrous sound of the Dharma;
the earth-dwelling spirit Sūkṣmaprabha attained the liberation door of his body universally producing various nets of light that shine everywhere.
The footstep-following spirit named Accumulating Exquisite Flowers attained the liberation door of awakening all sentient beings and causing them to give rise to an ocean of roots of goodness.
At that time, the footstep-following spirit Jewel Seal, empowered by the Buddha’s spiritual authority, surveyed the entire assembly of footstep-following spirits and spoke in verse:
"The Buddha practiced for immeasurable eons, Making offerings to all Tathāgatas."
The mind is ever joyful and never weary; the gate of joy is profound and vast like the ocean.
In every thought-moment, inconceivable spiritual powers manifest, producing lotus flowers of various fragrances;
upon them sits the Buddha, traveling everywhere, as the spirit Red-Colored Light beholds all.

Such is the nature of all Buddhas, the Tathāgatas: throughout the vast assemblies pervading the ten directions, they universally manifest inconceivable supernormal powers, which the supreme goddess Puṣpa clearly beholds.

Throughout all places in the lands of the ten directions, wherever they lift their feet or set them down, they are able to bring all sentient beings to fulfillment; this delights the mind of the deity Sudarśana.
Manifesting bodies as numerous as all living beings, each of these bodies fills the entire Dharma-realm;
emitting pure light and raining down various jewels—thus does the liberation of Star Banner enter.
The realm of the Tathāgata is boundless, universally raining down the rain of Dharma to fill all;
the assembly beholds the Buddha and gives rise to joy—this is what is seen by this wondrous voice.
The Buddha’s voice is equal in measure to space; all sounds are contained within it.
It pervades everywhere to discipline sentient beings, and thus the candana tree is able to hear and receive it.
From every pore emerge transformed sounds, proclaiming the names of all Buddhas of the three periods of time;
those who hear these sounds are filled with joy—thus does the deity Padmaprabha perceive.
The Buddha’s bodily manifestations are inconceivable; at every step, his physical forms are like the ocean.
He causes all sentient beings to see them according to their own minds—this is what is attained through this wondrous radiance.
Manifesting great spiritual powers throughout the ten directions, causing all sentient beings to attain awakening;
having seen this Dharma, the Spirit of Myriad Wondrous Flowers gave rise in his heart to great joy.
Furthermore, the body-god of the Pure Joy Realm attained the liberation door of recollecting the ocean of the Buddha’s past vows;
the body-god of Light Illumining the Ten Directions attained the liberation door of radiating light that universally illuminates boundless worlds;
and the body-god of Oceanic Sound Subduing attained the liberation door of using a great voice to universally awaken all sentient beings, causing them to rejoice and be subdued.
The host of deities of the Body named Pure Flower Adorned Topknot attained the liberation door of a body like space that dwells everywhere;
the host of deities of the Body named Immeasurable Dignified Manner attained the liberation door of manifesting the realms of all Buddhas to all sentient beings;

the host of deities of the Body named Most Victorious Light Adornment attained the liberation door of causing all hungry and destitute sentient beings to have their physical strength and vitality fulfilled.
The host of body-spirits named Pure Radiant Fragrant Clouds attained the liberation door of removing the defilements of affliction from all sentient beings;
the host of body-spirits named Guardian Sustainers attained the liberation door of overturning the demonic activities of ignorance in all sentient beings;
the host of body-spirits named Universal Manifestation of Transformation Bodies attained the liberation door of universally displaying magnificent signs within the palaces of all world-rulers.
The Body-Host Deity Immovable Radiance attained the liberation door of universally gathering all sentient beings and causing them to give rise to pure roots of goodness.
At that time, the Body-Host Deity Pure Joy Realm, sustained by the Buddha’s majestic power, surveyed the entire assembly of body-host deities and spoke in verse:
"I recall that in kalpas as numerous as the atoms of Mount Sumeru, A Buddha named Wondrous Light appeared in the world."
Before that Tathāgata, the World-Honored One Resolved to make offerings to all Buddhas.
The body of the Tathāgata emitted a great radiance, And its light filled the entire Dharma-realm without exception.
Sentient beings who encountered it had their minds tamed; This was what the Spirit Illuminating the Directions beheld.
The Tathāgata’s voice resounds through the lands of the ten directions; all vocal expressions are perfectly complete.
Universally awakening all sentient beings without exception, those who hear this and are tamed rejoice in their hearts.
The Buddha’s body is pure and eternally quiescent; It universally manifests all colors yet remains free of all marks.
Thus it dwells pervasively throughout the world— This is the entryway of the goddess Viśuddhakusuma.
The Guide is thus inconceivable, appearing to all according to the minds of sentient beings;
whether sitting, walking, or standing at times, he reveals the gateways of awakening through his immeasurable modes of deportment.
A Buddha is difficult to encounter even in hundreds of thousands of kalpas;
appearing in the world, he brings benefit with sovereign power, causing all in the world to leave behind the suffering of poverty. Thus, Most Victorious Radiant Adornment enters this place.
Between each of the Tathāgata’s teeth, Clouds of fragrant light and flames are universally emitted, Extinguishing the delusions of all sentient beings;
Thus did the deity Cloud of Freedom from Defilement behold them.
Sentient beings, weighed down by the heavy obstacles of defilement and delusion, constantly wander along the paths of Māra;
the Tathāgata reveals the path of liberation, which, when guarded and upheld, enables them to enter into awakening.
I behold the Tathāgata’s power of mastery, His light spreading throughout the Dharma-realm, filling it entirely;
Dwelling within royal palaces to transform sentient beings— This is the realm of the Spirit of Universal Manifestation.
Sentient beings, deluded and possessed of manifold sufferings, Are constantly rescued and gathered by the Buddha within them;
He causes all to extinguish delusions and give rise to a joyful mind— This is what the Spirit Immovable Light beholds.
Furthermore, the Vajra-holder god Subhavarṇanārāyaṇa attained the liberation door of beholding the Tathāgata manifesting a body of infinite physical forms;
the Vajra-holder god Sūryamaṇḍalavegadhvaja attained the liberation door of each and every pore of the Buddha’s body appearing as a sun-disk, manifesting clouds of various radiances;
the Vajra-holder god Sumerukusumaprabha attained the liberation door of the great supernormal transformations of manifesting infinite bodies.
The Vajra-wielding Spirit Pure Cloud Sound attained the liberation door of infinite sounds that accord with all types of beings;
the Vajra-wielding Spirit Wondrous Arm Lord of Devas attained the liberation door of manifesting as the lord of all worlds to awaken sentient beings;
the Vajra-wielding Spirit Lovely Light attained the liberation door of universally revealing the distinctions of all Buddha-dharmas in their entirety without exception.
The Vajra-wielding Spirit Great Tree Thunder-Sound attained the liberation door of gathering all tree spirits through delightful and beautiful ornaments;
the Vajra-wielding Spirit Lion-King Radiance attained the liberation door of fully and clearly understanding the vast accumulations of the Tathāgata’s merit and adornments;

the Vajra-wielding Spirit Secret Flame Auspicious Eye attained the liberation door of universally observing the minds of beings in perilous and evil states and manifesting a majestic body for their sake.
The Vajra-holder Lotus Maṇi Topknot attained the liberation door of universally raining down all ornaments for Bodhisattvas as a maṇi topknot.
At that time, the Vajra-holder Wondrous Color Nārāyaṇa, receiving the Buddha’s majestic power, surveyed the entire assembly of Vajra-holders and spoke in verse:
“You should observe the Dharma King; Such is the nature of the Dharma King.”
The marks and signs are boundless, appearing everywhere throughout the world.
From every single pore of the Buddha’s body, inconceivable nets of light radiate,
like the pure orb of the sun, universally illuminating the lands of the ten directions.
The Tathāgata’s power of supernormal knowledge pervades the entire Dharma-realm;
before all sentient beings, he manifests inexhaustible bodies.
The sound of the Tathāgata’s preaching of the Dharma is heard throughout the ten directions by all who hear it.
According to the various types of sentient beings, he causes all their hearts to be satisfied.
All see the Honored Muni dwelling within the palace of the world,
universally expounding the Great Dharma for the sake of all living creatures.
Within the swirling depths of the ocean of Dharma,
all diverse meanings and various gates of skillful means are expounded without end.
With boundless great expedients, they universally respond to the lands of the ten directions.
Encountering the Buddha’s pure radiance, they see the body of the Tathāgata in its entirety.
Having made offerings to Buddhas as numerous as the atoms within billions of lands,
their merit is like space, and they are gazed upon by all.
With the equality of supernormal powers, they manifest in all lands;
seated peacefully upon the sublime site of enlightenment, they appear universally before all beings.
Clouds of flames illuminate everywhere, with various radiances perfectly complete.
The Dharma-realm has no place it does not reach; It reveals the sphere of action of the Buddhas.
*The Great Vaipulya Buddha Avataṃsaka Sūtra*, Scroll Four;
*The Great Vaipulya Buddha Avataṃsaka Sūtra*, Scroll Five.
Translated by the Tripitaka Master Śikṣānanda of Khotan by Imperial Decree.
Chapter One: The Sublime Adornment of the Five World Rulers, Part Five.
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Samantabhadra entered the ocean of skillful means of the inconceivable liberation gates and entered the ocean of the Tathāgata’s merits.
That is to say:
there is a gate of liberation called "Adorning and Purifying All Buddha-lands, Subduing Sentient Beings, and Causing Them to Attain Ultimate Deliverance."
There is a gate of liberation named "Universally Attaining the Realm of Perfected Merit Cultivated in the Presence of All Tathāgatas.
There is a gate of liberation named:

There is a gate of liberation called "Universally Manifesting Infinite Bodies as Numerous as the Dust Motes of the Dharma Realm," which establishes the ocean of great vows for all stages of bodhisattvas.
There is a gate of liberation called:
"Proclaiming the Inconceivable Number of Distinct Names Throughout All Lands.
There is a gate of liberation called:
Within every single atom, the infinite spheres of supernatural power of all bodhisattvas are fully manifested.
There is a gate of liberation called:
"Manifesting the events of the formation and destruction of kalpas throughout the three periods of time within a single thought-moment."
There is a gate of liberation named "Manifesting the Ocean of All Bodhisattvas’ Faculties, Each Entering Its Own Sphere.
There is a gate of liberation named:

There is a gate of liberation called "The Gate of Manifesting the Sequential Stages of All Bodhisattva Practices and Entering the Vast Expedient Means of Omniscience," by which one can, through the power of spiritual transformations, manifest various bodies that pervade the boundless Dharma-realm.

At that time, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Samantabhadra, by means of his own merit and further sustained by the majestic spiritual power of the Tathāgata, surveyed the entire ocean-like assembly and spoke these verses:
"The vast lands adorned by the Buddha, Equal in number to all atoms,
Are filled with pure sons of the Buddha, Who rain down the inconceivable, most wondrous Dharma."
Just as one sees the Buddha seated here in this assembly, so it is in all atoms;
the Buddha’s body neither goes nor comes, yet all lands appear clearly within it.
It reveals the practices cultivated by Bodhisattvas, The immeasurable skillful means for entering the stages,
And explains the inconceivable principle of reality, Causing all sons of the Buddha to enter the Dharma-realm.
He manifests transformation-buddhas as numerous as motes of dust, universally responding to the desires of all sentient beings;
entering the gates of skillful means within the profound dharma-realm, he expounds them all extensively and boundlessly.
The names of the Tathāgatas are equal to the world, pervading all lands throughout the ten directions;
through every skillful means, none pass in vain, as they subdue sentient beings so that all may be free from defilement.
Within every single atom, the Buddha manifests boundless great supernormal powers;
seated at every site of enlightenment, he can expound the bodhisattva practices of the Buddha’s past.
Throughout all vast eons of the three periods of time, the Buddha manifests them within every single thought-moment;
regarding all matters of formation and destruction therein, his inconceivable wisdom knows them all without exception.

The assembly of the Buddha’s disciples is vast and limitless; desiring to measure together the stages of all Buddhas— the Dharma-gates of the Buddhas are boundless, and to fully comprehend them is exceedingly difficult.
The Buddha is like space, free from discrimination; equal to the true Dharma-realm, he has no dependence.
Manifesting transformations that travel everywhere without exception, he sits at every site of enlightenment and attains perfect awakening.
The Buddha proclaims extensively with his wondrous voice, making all stages clearly understood;
appearing before each and every sentient being, he bestows upon them all the Dharma equal to that of the Tathāgata.

Furthermore, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Pure Virtue Sublime Light attained the liberation door of universally proceeding to the assemblies of bodhisattvas throughout the ten directions to adorn the sites of enlightenment.

The Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Universal Virtue Supreme Lamp Radiance attained the liberation door of manifesting, within a single thought-moment, the attainment of infinite perfect enlightenment to teach and mature inconceivable realms of sentient beings.
The Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Universal Light Lion Banner attained the liberation door of cultivating the bodhisattva’s adornments of merit to give birth to all buddha-lands.
The Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Universal Jewel Flame Subtle Light attained the liberation door of observing the realm of a Buddha’s supernormal powers without confusion;
the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Universal Sound Merit Ocean Banner attained the liberation door of manifesting the adornments of all Buddha-lands within a single assembly site;

and the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Universal Wisdom Light Illuminating the Tathāgata’s Realm attained the liberation door of following the Tathāgata to observe the treasury of the profound and vast Dharma-realm.
The Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Samantabodhimanojñasvara attained the liberation door of the treasury of offerings for attending upon and serving all Buddhas;
the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Samantaviśuddhākṣayapuṇyatejaprabha attained the liberation door of the vast empowerment that gives rise to all spiritual transformations;
the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Samantaratanacūḍapuṣpadhvaja attained the liberation door of universally entering the practices of all worlds to give rise to the boundless practices of a bodhisattva.
The Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Universal Mark Supreme Radiance attained the liberation door of being able to manifest all Buddha-realms within the signless realm of phenomena (*dharmadhātu*).
At that time, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Pure Virtue Sublime Light, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the ocean of liberation gates of all bodhisattvas and spoke these verses:
"All lands throughout the ten directions, In a single kṣaṇa, are entirely purified;
Turning the wheel of Dharma with sublime sounds, Pervading the world, peerless and unequaled."
The realm of the Tathāgata is boundless, In a single thought-moment, it completely fills the entire Dharma-realm.
Within every single atom, a site of enlightenment is established, Where all realize Bodhi and manifest spiritual transformations.
In the past, the World-Honored One cultivated all practices throughout hundreds of thousands of immeasurable kalpas;
all Buddha-fields were adorned by him, appearing unimpeded like space.
The Buddha’s supernormal powers are limitless, Pervading all infinite eons;
Even if he were to pass through immeasurable kalpas, Observing moment by moment, he never tires.
You should contemplate the realm of the Buddha’s supernormal powers: The lands of the ten directions are all adorned and purified;
Everything manifests here before you, In infinite varieties, differing from moment to moment.
Though one observes the Buddha for hundreds of thousands of immeasurable eons, one cannot find even the limit of a single hair;
the Tathāgata’s unimpeded gate of skillful means—this light shines universally upon inconceivable lands.
In ages past, when the Tathāgata dwelt in the world, he served an ocean-like multitude of boundless Buddhas;
therefore, all beings rush toward him like rivers, coming together to make offerings to the World-Honored One.
The Tathāgata appears throughout the ten directions; within every single atom are infinite lands, and the realms therein are all immeasurable, each abiding for boundless and inexhaustible eons.
In past kalpas, for the sake of sentient beings, The Buddha cultivated a boundless ocean of great compassion;
Following all sentient beings into the cycle of birth and death, He universally transformed the assemblies, causing them to become pure.
The Buddha abides in the treasury of the *tathatā* dharma-realm, Without marks, without form, and free from all defilements;
Sentient beings perceive his various bodies, And all their sufferings and hardships are utterly extinguished.

Furthermore, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Sāgaraprabha-mahāprabha attained the liberation door of skillful means for giving birth to the various stages and perfections of bodhisattvas, teaching and transforming sentient beings, and adorning and purifying all buddha-lands;
the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Meghasvarasāgaraprabhāvimalagarbha attained the liberation door of universally entering the various distinct locations within the dharma-realm in every thought-moment;
and the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Jñānasaṃbhavaratnaśikhin attained the liberation door of manifesting pure great merit before all sentient beings throughout inconceivable eons.

The Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Pure Light Sovereign King of Merit attained the liberation door of universally beholding the various adornments when all bodhisattvas of the ten directions first arrive at the site of enlightenment;

the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Lotus Topknot of Skillful Valor attained the liberation door of universally manifesting all Buddha-dharmas in accordance with the ocean of faculties and understandings of all sentient beings;
the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Sun Banner of Universal Wisdom Clouds attained the liberation door of accomplishing the Tathāgata’s wisdom and dwelling eternally throughout immeasurable eons.
The Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Mahā-vīrya-vajra-krodha attained the liberation door of the power of the seal that universally enters all boundless dharmas;

the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Gandhārcis-keṭu attained the liberation door of manifesting the initial cultivation of the bodhisattva path by all present Buddhas up until the fulfillment of their accumulation of wisdom;
the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Mahā-tejo-gambhīra-svara attained the liberation door of abiding in the ocean of all great vows of Vairocana.
The Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Great Radiance of Merit and Wisdom attained the liberation door of manifesting the Tathāgata’s profound realm that pervades the entire Dharma-realm.

At that time, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Ocean Moon Light Great Radiance, receiving the Buddha’s majestic power, surveyed the ocean of adornments of the entire assembly of Bodhisattvas and spoke these verses:
“The various pāramitās and the various stages, Vast and inconceivable, are all fully perfected.”
Infinite sentient beings are all tamed, and all Buddha-lands are purified and adorned.
Just as the Buddha transforms the realms of sentient beings, filling the lands of the ten directions,
he turns the wheel of Dharma within a single thought-moment, universally responding to the inclinations of all beings without exception.
Throughout immeasurable and vast eons, the Buddha universally appears before all sentient beings;
just as he extensively cultivated and purified his path in the past, he now reveals to them the ground of pure conduct.
I behold the ten directions without exception, and see all the Buddhas manifesting their supernatural powers;
they all sit at the site of enlightenment to achieve perfect awakening, surrounded by assemblies who hear the Dharma together.
The Buddha’s Dharma-body of vast and brilliant radiance Is able to manifest in the world through skillful means;
Universally according with the inclinations of sentient beings’ minds, It rains down the Dharma in accordance with their faculties.
The body of true suchness is equal and signless; The pure dharma-body is radiant light free from defilement.
With a wisdom-body of tranquil stillness and infinite extent, It universally responds throughout the ten directions to expound the Dharma.
The powers of the Dharma King are all pure; his wisdom is like space, without limit.
He reveals everything without omission or concealment, universally causing all sentient beings to awaken and enter therein.
Just as the Buddha cultivated and purified [his path] in the past, until he attained all-knowledge,
so now he emits light that pervades the entire Dharma-realm, within which everything is clearly manifested.
The Buddha manifests supernormal powers through his original vows, so that there is nowhere throughout the ten directions that is not illumined;
just as the Buddha cultivated his practices in the past, he expounds them all within this net of light.
The realms of the ten directions are inexhaustible, Incomparable, boundless, and each distinct;
The Buddha, by his unimpeded power, emits a great light, Making all lands clearly manifest.

At that time, from every single one of the ornaments adorning the Tathāgata’s lion throne—the various jewels, exquisite flowers, wheel-platforms, pedestals, steps, as well as all the doors and windows—there emerged bodhisattva-mahāsattvas as numerous as the atoms within a buddha-field. Their names were as follows:

The Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Sāgarabuddhivikrīḍitābhijña-rāja, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Garjitasvaranirghoṣa, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Sarvaratnavicitrakośagarbha, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Mahājñānasūryavikramamati, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Acintyaguṇaratnajñānamudrā, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Śatapadmanetra-keśarī, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Suvarṇajvālāparipūrṇaprabha, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Dharmadhātusvaraviśuddha, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Meghasvaraviśuddhacandra, and the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Suvikrāntatejodhvaja...
With these as their leaders, there appeared simultaneously as many bodhisattvas as there are atoms in numerous Buddha-fields.
Each of these bodhisattvas raised various clouds of offerings, namely: clouds of all kinds of mani-jewel flowers; clouds of exquisite fragrance from all lotuses;

clouds of the perfect radiance of all jewels; clouds of fragrant flames from boundless realms; clouds of light from sun-treasury mani-wheels; clouds of all pleasing musical sounds; clouds of the light-flames of all jewel-lamps with boundless colors and forms; clouds of flowers, fruits, and branches from trees of various jewels; clouds of inexhaustible mani-kings of pure jewel-light; and clouds of mani-kings of all ornaments...
Such clouds of offerings as these were as numerous as the atoms within a Buddha-world.
Each of those bodhisattvas produced such clouds of offerings, raining them down upon the oceans of assemblies at all places of enlightenment, in an unceasing succession.

Having manifested these clouds, they circumambulated the World-Honored One to the right for immeasurable hundreds of thousands of times; then, proceeding in their respective directions and not far from the Buddha, they transformed themselves into countless lion-thrones of various precious lotuses, upon each of which they sat cross-legged.

The conduct of these bodhisattvas is pure and vast as the ocean; they have attained the light of wisdom that illuminates the Dharma of universal gates and accord with all Buddhas, their conduct being unimpeded.
They are able to enter the ocean of all dharmas of eloquence, attain the inconceivable dharma-gate of liberation, and abide in the stage of the Tathāgata’s universal gates.
Having already attained all dharani-gates, they are fully capable of containing the entire ocean of dharmas, and they dwell well in the ground of the equalizing wisdom of the three periods of time.
Having attained profound faith, vast joy and bliss, and an infinite accumulation of merit that is utterly pure;
they observe the entire dharma-realm of empty space, and diligently make offerings to all Buddhas appearing in every land throughout the worlds of the ten directions.

At that time, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Sāgaramati-vaśavarti-abhijñārāja, empowered by the Buddha’s spiritual authority, surveyed the ocean-like assembly at the site of enlightenment and spoke these verses:
“The awakening of all Buddhas has been fully known; Like space, it is unimpeded and shines with clarity.
Its light pervades the infinite lands of the ten directions, And it dwells within this assembly, universally pure and adorned.”
The merits of the Tathāgata are immeasurable, filling the entirety of the dharma-realm in the ten directions;
seated universally beneath all the kings of trees, the great lords assemble like clouds.
The Buddha possesses such supernormal powers that, in a single thought-moment, he manifests infinite forms;
the realm of the Tathāgata is boundless, and each can perceive it according to their own liberation.
Throughout oceans of kalpas in the past, the Tathāgata diligently practiced within all realms of existence;
through various skillful means he transformed sentient beings, causing them to receive and practice all Buddha-dharmas.
Vairocana, endowed with all majestic marks and signs, sits upon the lion throne of the Lotus Treasury;
the entire assembly is pure and dwells in tranquility, gazing up at him in unison.
The treasury of maṇi jewels radiates brilliant light, universally emitting boundless clouds of fragrant flames;
immeasurable flower garlands hang down together, and upon such a seat sits the Tathāgata.
The auspicious gate is adorned with various ornaments, Constantly emitting clouds of lamp-light and jewel-flames;
Vast and blazing, there is nowhere it does not illuminate, As the Muni stands upon it, increasing its sublime beauty.

With windows of various exquisite mani-jewels, adorned with hanging lotuses of wondrous gems, constantly emitting sublime sounds that delight all who hear them; the Buddha sits upon it, appearing exceptionally radiant.
A half-moon shaped seat is supported by jewel wheels; its vajra pedestal is radiant with blazing colors.
Bodhisattvas with topknots constantly surround it, and the Buddha shines most brilliantly therein.
Various transformations fill the ten directions, Proclaiming the vast vows of the Tathāgata;
All reflected images appear therein, And thus the Buddha sits serenely upon this seat.

At that time, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Thunder-Sound-Resounding-Everywhere, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the ocean-like assemblies at the site of enlightenment and spoke these verses:
“The World-Honored One formerly accumulated practices for enlightenment, Making offerings to immeasurable Buddhas throughout the ten directions.
Sustained by the majestic power of the Sugata, Within the Tathāgata’s seat, there is nothing not seen.”
The wish-fulfilling king of fragrant-flame mani-jewels adorns the lion throne with exquisite flowers;
all manner of ornaments manifest therein, clearly visible to the entire assembly.
The Buddha’s seat universally manifests signs of adornment; in every thought-moment, its forms and types differ.
According to the diverse understandings of sentient beings, each perceives the Buddha seated upon it.

Jewel branches hang down, draped with nets of lotuses; from the blossoming flowers emerge all the bodhisattvas, each uttering subtle and pleasing sounds to praise the Tathāgata seated upon his throne.
The measure of the Buddha’s merit is like space; from it all adornments arise.
The matters of adornment within each and every stage are such that no sentient beings can fully comprehend them.
The ground is of vajra, indestructible, vast, pure, and perfectly level;
nets of mani-jewels hang suspended in the air, pervading everywhere beneath the Bodhi tree.

That ground is boundless, its colors and forms exquisite; powdered pure gold is strewn upon it, with famous flowers and various jewels scattered everywhere, all of them radiant and illuminating the Tathāgata’s seat.
The earth deities rejoice and leap for joy, manifesting ceaselessly in every instant;
they universally raise clouds of all manner of adornments, remaining forever before the Buddha in reverent gazing.
The vast jewel lamps blaze most intensely, their fragrant flames and flowing light never ceasing;
manifesting various differences according to the occasion, the earth deities offer this as an act of worship.
Within all the lands of the ten directions, whatever adornments exist upon those grounds, none fail to appear here in this place of practice;
it is through the Buddha’s majestic spiritual power that this is so.
At that time, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Jewel-Light-Tuft, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the ocean-like assembly at the site of enlightenment and spoke these verses:
“When the World-Honored One practiced the path in the past, He beheld all Buddha-lands as perfectly complete;
The inexhaustible realms thus perceived Are all manifested within this site of enlightenment.”
The World-Honored One, with his vast and great supernormal powers, radiates light that rains down mani-jewels everywhere;
such treasuries of jewels are scattered across the site of enlightenment, so that the ground all around is completely adorned and magnificent.

Through the power of the Tathāgata’s merit and supernormal faculties, The ground and the Bodhi tree are universally adorned with exquisite maṇi jewels; They emit light and sound in succession, expounding the Dharma.
Immeasurable jewel lamps rain down from the sky, Adorned with the intermingling of various jewel-kings;
All emit subtle and wondrous sounds of the Dharma— Such are the manifestations of the earth deities.
Upon the jeweled ground, clouds of wondrous light appear everywhere; Jewel torches blaze with brilliance like flashing lightning.
Jewel nets are spread far and wide to cover it above, And jewel branches are interspersed as beautiful adornments.
All of you, look upon this ground, adorned with various kinds of wondrous jewels;
it reveals the ocean of karmas of all sentient beings, causing them to realize the true nature of phenomena.
Throughout the ten directions, all the Buddhas, And every perfected Bodhi tree,
Are without exception manifest within the site of enlightenment, Proclaiming the pure Dharma of the Tathāgatas.
According to the inclinations of the minds of all sentient beings, that ground universally produces sublime sounds;
as is appropriate for what should be expounded from the Buddha’s seat, every single Dharma gate is fully proclaimed.
That land constantly emits wondrous fragrant light, and within that light pure sounds are universally proclaimed;
if there are sentient beings capable of receiving the Dharma, they all hear it and their afflictions are extinguished.
Each and every adornment is perfectly complete; even in billions of kalpas, none could describe them all.
The Tathāgata’s spiritual power reaches everywhere; therefore, this ground is entirely adorned and pure.

At that time, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Great Wisdom Sun’s Valiant Intelligence, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the ocean-like assemblies at the site of enlightenment and spoke in verse:
“The World-Honored One sits serenely in the Dharma Hall, Radiantly illuminating the midst of the palace.
According to the inclinations of the minds of all sentient beings, His body appears universally throughout the lands of the ten directions.”
The Tathāgata’s palace is inconceivable, adorned with a treasury of maṇi jewels;
all its ornaments radiate light, and the Buddha seated within is exceptionally resplendent.
Columns of mani-jewels in various colors, with bells of pure gold spread like clouds;
jeweled staircases arranged in rows on all four sides, and gates opening wide in every direction.
Canopies adorned with exquisite flowers, silks, and brocades; Branches of jeweled trees interlaced in grand decoration;
Maṇi necklaces hang down on all four sides; Within this, the Ocean of Wisdom sits in profound stillness.
With nets of mani-jewels and banners of exquisite fragrance, Lamps of blazing light spread out like clouds;
Covered with various kinds of ornaments, The Transcendent One, possessed of perfect knowledge, sits here.
Throughout the ten directions, clouds of transformations appear everywhere;
these clouds proclaim the Dharma throughout the world, taming all sentient beings—all such manifestations arise from the Buddha’s palace.
Jewels form trees that put forth wondrous flowers, peerless throughout the ten directions;
the adornments of the lands of the three periods of time all manifest their reflections therein.
In every place there are clusters of mani jewels, Their blazing flames of infinite varieties;
Windows and doors open in alternating directions according to the quarters, The architecture is adorned with extreme splendor and beauty.
The Tathāgata’s palace is inconceivable, pure and radiant, endowed with manifold marks;
all palaces appear within it, and in each one sits a Tathāgata.
The palace of the Tathāgata is boundless, And the Self-Awakened One dwells within it;
Of all the assemblies in the ten directions, There are none who do not gather here toward the Buddha.

At that time, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Inconceivable Merit Jewel Wisdom Seal, receiving the Buddha’s majestic power, surveyed the ocean-like assemblies at the site of enlightenment and spoke in verse:
“The Buddha of old cultivated an ocean of manifold merits, As numerous as the atoms within all buddha-lands.
Born from the power of his spiritual penetrations and vows, The site of enlightenment is pure and adorned, free from all defilement.”
The king of wish-fulfilling jewels forms its roots, and diamond-maṇi gems constitute its trunk;
a precious net is spread far and wide to cover it above, while wondrous fragrances swirl about it in harmony.
The tree branches were adorned with every kind of jewel, Its trunk of mani-gems rose up in competition;
Branches and twigs spread densely like heavy clouds, Beneath which the Buddha sat at the site of enlightenment.
The site of enlightenment is vast and inconceivable; its trees completely cover it all around.
Dense leaves and profuse blossoms reflect one another, and within the flowers, mani fruits are fully formed.
From every branch, wondrous light radiates forth; its light shines everywhere throughout the site of enlightenment.
Pure, blazing, and inexhaustible, it is seen thus through the power of the Buddha’s vows.

A treasury of maṇi jewels forms its flowers; casting shadows and radiating brilliance like variegated clouds, their fragrance hangs from the trees everywhere, universally adorning the site of enlightenment.
Behold the site of enlightenment of the Sugata, where lotuses and jeweled nets are both pure;
wheels of radiant flames manifest from here, and the sounds of bells and chimes resound amidst the clouds.
Within all lands throughout the ten directions, All trees adorned with exquisite forms appear within the Bodhi tree;
Beneath it, the Buddha is free from all defilements.
The bodhimanda is vast, accomplished through merit; Tree branches rain down jewels, eternally inexhaustible.
From within the jewels appear various bodhisattvas, All of whom go to the ten directions to serve and honor the Buddhas.
The realm of all Buddhas is inconceivable; it causes all these trees to produce musical sounds.
Just as they previously gathered the path to enlightenment, the assembly hears these sounds and all behold [the truth].
At that time, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Hundred-Eyed Lotus-Crest, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire ocean-like assembly at the site of enlightenment and spoke these verses:
“From every mani-jewel, wondrous sounds emerge, Proclaiming the names of all Buddhas of the three periods of time.
The immeasurable deeds of supernatural power of those Buddhas Are all clearly perceived within this site of enlightenment.”
Multitudes of flowers bloom in competition like spread-out tassels; Clouds of light flow and spread throughout the ten directions.
The deity of the Bodhi tree holds them toward the Buddha, Gazing up with single-minded devotion as an offering.
The flames of mani-jewels all form banners; from within these banners, a brilliant and wondrous fragrance is emitted.
This fragrance universally perfumes all beings, and for this reason, that place is entirely adorned and pure.

Lotus flowers hang down, radiating golden light; from that light emanates a cloud of the Buddha’s wondrous voice, universally shading all lands throughout the ten directions and forever quelling the heat of sentient beings’ afflictions.
By the sovereign power of the King of Bodhi Trees, It constantly emits a light of supreme purity;
The assemblies in the ten directions are boundless, And there are none who do not appear as reflections within the site of enlightenment.

The radiant flames of his jewel-branches are like bright lamps; their light emits sounds that proclaim great vows, fully recounting all that the Buddha practiced in his past lives throughout the various realms of existence.
The deities beneath the trees, as numerous as the atoms of all lands, all together rely upon this site of enlightenment;
each, before the Bodhi tree of a Tathāgata, proclaims the gates of liberation in every thought-moment.
The various practices the World-Honored One cultivated in the past, And the offerings made to all the Tathāgatas—
His original cultivation and his renown Are all clearly manifested within this mani jewel.
From the entire site of enlightenment, wondrous sounds emerge; those sounds are vast and pervade the ten directions.
If there are sentient beings capable of receiving the Dharma, there are none whom they do not subdue and bring to purity.
In the past, the Tathāgata universally cultivated and purified all manner of infinite adornments;
at every single bodhi tree throughout the ten directions, there are countless varieties of such adornments.
At that time, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Golden Flame Perfect Radiance, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the ocean-like assembly at the site of enlightenment and spoke these verses:
“When the Buddha formerly practiced the conduct for awakening, He attained clear understanding regarding all spheres of experience;
Regarding what is possible and what is impossible, he was pure and free from doubt— This is the Tathāgata’s first power of knowledge.”
Just as in the past you equally contemplated the nature of all phenomena, such that the entire ocean of karma was clearly penetrated,
so now, within this net of light, you may universally expound it throughout the ten directions.
Having cultivated great skillful means throughout past kalpas, He transformed and guided beings according to their faculties;
Universally purifying the minds of all in the assembly, The Buddha was thus able to achieve the power of knowledge regarding the faculties.
Just as sentient beings differ in their understanding, and their desires, inclinations, and practices each vary,
the Buddha is able to teach the Dharma to them according to what is appropriate for each, through the power of his wisdom.
Throughout all the oceans of lands in the ten directions, and within every realm of sentient beings, the Buddha’s wisdom is equal to space; it can manifest entirely within a single pore.
The Buddha knows all modes of conduct everywhere; in a single thought-moment, he exhaustively perceives the three periods of time without exception.
Regarding the lands, kalpas, sentient beings, and times throughout the ten directions, he is able to reveal them all so that they are clearly understood.
The power of dhyāna and liberation is boundless, and so too are the skillful means of samādhi;
the Buddha manifests these to inspire joy, universally cleansing away the darkness of afflictions.
The Buddha’s unimpeded wisdom encompasses the three periods of time; in a single instant, it all appears within a single pore.
The Buddha-lands, the lands of the realms, and all sentient beings—all that is manifested arises through the power of recollective mindfulness.
The Buddha-eye is as vast as space, Universally perceiving the entire dharma-realm without exception;
Within the stage of non-obstruction, its peerless function— That immeasurable eye, the Buddhas can expound.
All sentient beings are possessed of various fetters, Along with all their latent tendencies and habitual propensities;
When the Tathāgata appears throughout the world, He causes them all to be extinguished through skillful means.
At that time, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Universal Sound of the Dharma Realm, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the ocean-like assembly at the site of enlightenment and spoke these verses:
“The Buddha’s majestic spiritual power pervades the ten directions; He manifests vast displays without discrimination.
The perfections of the practices for Great Enlightenment— All those fulfilled in the past, he causes them all to be seen.”
In the past, you gave rise to great compassion for sentient beings and practiced the perfection of giving;
by virtue of this, your body is most sublime and wondrous, capable of bringing joy to all who behold it.
In the past, throughout an ocean of boundless great kalpas, you cultivated the perfection of pure ethical discipline;
therefore, you have attained a pure body that pervades the ten directions, universally extinguishing all the heavy sufferings of the world.
In the past, you practiced the purity of patience; with faith and understanding of reality, you were free from discrimination.
Therefore, all your physical marks are perfectly complete, universally emitting light that illuminates the ten directions.
Having diligently practiced through oceans of past kalpas, You are able to turn away the deep and heavy obstacles of sentient beings;
Therefore, you can manifest emanated bodies throughout the ten directions, Appearing in their entirety beneath the King of Bodhi Trees.
The Buddha has practiced for immeasurable eons; The great ocean of his meditative concentration is universally pure.
Therefore, those who behold him feel profound joy, And the defilements of their afflictive hindrances are entirely extinguished.
The Tathāgata, having cultivated an ocean of various practices in the past and fully perfected the Prajñāpāramitā,
therefore radiates light that illuminates everywhere, utterly destroying all the darkness of ignorance.
Through various skillful means they transform sentient beings, Causing all their practices and cultivations to reach fulfillment;
They travel everywhere throughout the ten directions, Without ceasing for even a single boundless kalpa.
In the past, the Buddha practiced for an ocean of great eons, Purifying all his vows and the perfections;
Therefore, he has appeared throughout all worlds, To rescue sentient beings until the end of the future.
The Buddha, having extensively cultivated and refined all the powers of the Dharma and the perfections over immeasurable eons,
is thus able to accomplish spontaneous power, manifesting universally throughout the lands of the ten directions.
In the past, the Buddha cultivated the wisdom of the universal gate; The nature of all-knowledge is like space.
Therefore, he has attained unimpeded power, Radiating light that universally illumines the lands of the ten directions.
At that time, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Cloud-Sound Pure Moon, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the ocean-like assembly at the site of enlightenment and spoke these verses:
“The realm of supernormal powers is equal to space; All sentient beings throughout the ten directions behold it.
The ground accomplished through past cultivation Is fully explained within the mani fruit.”
Having purely cultivated for immeasurable eons, One enters the First Ground of Supreme Joy;
Giving birth to the vast wisdom of the Dharma-realm, One universally beholds the infinite Buddhas of the ten directions.
Within all dharmas, they abide on the Ground Free from Defilement;
maintaining pure precepts for as many beings as there are, they have extensively practiced throughout many kalpas, making offerings to oceans of boundless Buddhas.
The Ground of Radiance, where merit is accumulated, The treasury of śamatha and firm endurance, And the vast Cloud of Dharma have all been heard; Thus it is taught within the *Maṇi-phala*.
The ground of peerless wisdom, brilliant as a flaming ocean, Thoroughly understanding all realms, they give rise to compassion;
With bodies equal to all lands, They expound and clarify everything governed by the Buddhas.
The gates of the Universal Treasury and other stages are difficult to surpass; movement and stillness accord with one another without contradiction.
The realms of the Buddha-dharma are entirely equal; as the Buddha has purified them, so can they all be explained.
Having extensively practiced on the ground of the ocean of wisdom, they have thoroughly mastered all dharma-gates;
manifesting throughout lands as vast as space, they proclaim this Dharma-sound from within the trees.
A body of empty space pervading the entire Dharma-realm, A lamp of wisdom that universally illumines all sentient beings,
With all skillful means utterly pure— May you fully expound that which was practiced in the distant past.
Adorned by all vows and practices, the infinite oceans of lands are all purified;
unable to be moved by any conceptual discrimination—this is proclaimed as the ground of no-grounds.
With the power of supernatural faculties in immeasurable realms, And the power of light that skillfully enters the teachings—
This is the Ground of Pure Good Intelligence, In which all practices throughout oceans of eons are fully revealed.
The tenth stage, the Vast Cloud of Dharma, contains all things and pervades space;
the realm of all Buddhas is proclaimed within its sound, and this sound is the Buddha’s majestic spiritual power.
At that time, the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Suvīryaprabhāketu, empowered by the Buddha’s majestic spiritual authority, surveyed the ten directions and spoke these verses:
"Immeasurable sentient beings within this assembly, With various inclinations and pure minds,
Are all able to awaken to and enter the Tathāgata’s wisdom, Thoroughly comprehending all realms of adornment."
Each has given rise to pure vows and cultivated all practices; All have made offerings to immeasurable Buddhas in the past.
They are able to see the Tathāgata’s true essence, As well as all his miraculous transformations.
Some are able to see the Buddha’s Dharma-body, Incomparable, unimpeded, and universally pervasive;
All the infinite natures of phenomena Enter entirely into that body without exception.
Some behold the Buddha’s wondrous form-body, With boundless marks and signs blazing with light;
According to the differing understandings of sentient beings, He manifests various transformations throughout the ten directions.
Some see the body of unimpeded wisdom, equal throughout the three times like space;
it universally accords with the inclinations and joys of sentient beings, causing them all to perceive its various distinctions.
Some are able to comprehend the Buddha’s voice, which pervades all lands throughout the ten directions;
according to what each sentient being should understand, he produces speech and sound without obstruction.
Some see the Tathāgata’s manifold rays, Shining in various ways throughout the world;
Others, within the Buddha’s radiance, Further behold the Buddhas manifesting supernormal powers.
Some behold the Buddha’s ocean-like cloud of light, Emanating blazing radiance from every pore;
He manifests the path of his past cultivation, Causing them to give rise to deep faith and enter the Buddha’s wisdom.
Sometimes they see the Buddha’s marks adorned with merit, and they see from where this merit arises;
the oceans of past practices of the perfections are all clearly seen within the Buddha’s marks.
The Tathāgata’s merit is immeasurable, Pervading the Dharma-realm without limit;
As well as his various spheres of supernormal power— It is through the Buddha’s power that these can be proclaimed.
At that time, by the spiritual power of the Buddha, the entire ground of the Flower Treasury Adorned World-Ocean shook in six ways and eighteen manners.
That is to say:
shaking, shaking everywhere, shaking universally;
rising, rising everywhere, rising universally;
It surged, surged everywhere, and surged universally;
it quaked, quaked everywhere, and quaked universally;
it roared, roared everywhere, and roared universally.
They struck, struck all around, and struck everywhere.
Each of these lords of worlds manifested inconceivable clouds of offerings, raining them down upon the ocean-like assembly at the Tathāgata’s site of enlightenment.

That is to say: clouds of all kinds of fragrant flowers and ornaments; clouds of all kinds of exquisite mani-jewel decorations; clouds of nets of jewel-flame flowers; clouds of infinite varieties of circular halos of mani-jewels; clouds of treasuries of all-colored precious pearls; clouds of all kinds of precious sandalwood incense; clouds of all kinds of precious parasols; clouds of mani-kings with pure and wondrous sounds; clouds of sun-light mani-jewel necklaces and wheels; clouds of treasuries of all precious radiances; clouds of all various distinct ornaments...
Such clouds of offerings as these were immeasurable and inconceivable in number.
Each of these lords of worlds manifested such clouds of offerings, raining them down upon the ocean-like assembly at the Tathāgata’s site of enlightenment, pervading it all without exception.
In this world-system, each and every lord of the world gave rise to a heart of joy and made such offerings;
likewise, all the lords of the worlds throughout the entire Flower Treasury Adorned World-Ocean did the same.
In all those worlds, there were Tathāgatas seated at their sites of enlightenment;

each world-ruler had their own faith and understanding, their own objects of focus, their own gateways of samādhi-convenience, their own cultivation of the factors conducive to enlightenment, their own accomplishments, their own joys, their own entries, their own awakenings to the various dharma-gates, their own entries into the realm of the Tathāgata’s spiritual powers, their own entries into the realm of the Tathāgata’s strengths, and their own entries into the gates of the Tathāgata’s liberation.
Just as it is in this Flower Treasury World-Ocean, so it is throughout all world-oceans in the ten directions, as far as the limits of the Dharma-realm and the realm of empty space.
The Flower Ornament Sutra of the Buddha’s Great Vaipulya, Scroll Five;
The Flower Ornament Sutra of the Buddha’s Great Vaipulya, Scroll Six.
Translated by the Tripitaka Master Śikṣānanda of Khotan, by Imperial Command.
Chapter Two: The Manifestation of Signs by the Tathāgata At that time, all the bodhisattvas and the lords of the world thought to themselves:
"What is this ground of the Buddhas?"
What is the realm of all Buddhas?
What is the empowerment of all Buddhas?
What is the conduct of all Buddhas?
What are the powers of the Buddhas?
What are the fearlessnesses of the Buddhas?
What are the samādhis of the Buddhas?
What are the supernormal powers of the Buddhas?
What is the sovereign mastery of the Buddhas?
What is the inability of others to grasp the Buddhas?
What is the eye of all Buddhas?
What is the ear of all Buddhas?
What is the nose of all Buddhas?
What is the tongue of all Buddhas?
What is the body of all Buddhas?
What is the mind of all Buddhas?
What is the bodily radiance of the Buddhas? What is the light of the Buddhas?
What is the voice of the Buddhas?
What is this wisdom of all Buddhas?
We only pray that the World-Honored One, out of compassion for us, will reveal and expound it!

Furthermore, all Buddhas throughout the oceans of worlds in the ten directions each teach the bodhisattvas the ocean of worlds, the ocean of sentient beings, the ocean of the establishment of the dharma-realm, the ocean of Buddhas, the ocean of the Buddhas' perfections, the ocean of the Buddhas' liberations, the ocean of the Buddhas' transformations, the ocean of the Buddhas' discourses, the ocean of the Buddhas' names, and the ocean of the Buddhas' lifespans; as well as the ocean of the vows of all bodhisattvas, the ocean of the bodhisattvas' resolute advances, the ocean of the bodhisattvas' aids to the path, the ocean of the bodhisattvas' vehicles, the ocean of the bodhisattvas' practices, the ocean of the bodhisattvas' renunciations, the ocean of the bodhisattvas' supernormal powers, the ocean of the bodhisattvas' perfections, the ocean of the bodhisattvas' stages, and the ocean of the bodhisattvas' wisdom.
“May the Buddha, the World-Honored One, likewise speak for us in this way!
