At that time, by the spiritual power of all the bodhisattvas, a voice spontaneously issued from within the clouds of all the offering implements and spoke these verses:
“Having fulfilled your practice through immeasurable eons, You attained perfect enlightenment beneath the Bodhi tree.”
To deliver sentient beings, you manifest bodies everywhere, Like clouds filling all realms throughout the future.
You cause every doubt of sentient beings to be severed, And lead them all to give rise to vast faith and understanding.
You universally eliminate boundless suffering, Causing all to realize the peace and bliss of the Buddhas.
Bodhisattvas, as numerous as the atoms of countless lands, have all come together to this assembly to gaze upon you;
may you, according to their respective inclinations, expound the sublime Dharma and dispel their doubts!
How does one fully comprehend the stages of the Buddhas?
How does one observe the realm of the Tathāgatas?
The empowerment of the Buddhas is boundless; I pray that you reveal this Dharma so that it may be purified!
What is this sphere of the Buddha’s activity, Which one can clearly enter through wisdom?
The Buddha’s power is pure, vast, and boundless; For the sake of all bodhisattvas, you should reveal it!
What are the vast and great samādhis?
How does one purify the dharmas of fearlessness?
Your supernormal powers and functions are immeasurable; I pray you will explain them according to the inclinations of sentient beings!
The Buddhas, Kings of Dharma, are like sovereign lords; their conduct is autonomous and cannot be restrained.
For the sake of benefiting all others, they shall now expound the vast and sublime Dharma.
How is it that the Buddha-eye is immeasurable?
So too are the ears, nose, tongue, and body.
And how is it that the mind is immeasurable?
I pray that you will show us how to know these skillful means!
Just as there are oceans of lands and oceans of sentient beings, And oceans of all established realms within the Dharma-realm,
As well as the boundless oceans of Buddhas— I pray that you will fully expound them for the sake of all the Buddha-sons!
Forever emerging from the ocean of inconceivable multitudes of liberations, Universally entering the ocean of skillful means for liberation—
May you proclaim within this site of enlightenment All the oceans of dharma-gates!

At that time, the World-Honored One, knowing the thoughts in the minds of the bodhisattvas, emitted from the space between his teeth as many rays of light as there are motes of dust in a buddha-field.

They were as follows: the light called "Universally Illuminating with Various Jewel Flowers"; the light called "Adorning the Dharma Realm with the Emanation of Various Sounds"; the light called "Hanging Down Subtle and Wondrous Clouds"; the light called "The Buddhas of the Ten Directions Sitting at the Site of Enlightenment and Manifesting Spiritual Transformations"; the light called "Cloud Canopies of All Jewel Flames"; the light called "Unobstructed Light Filling the Dharma Realm"; the light called "Universally Adorning All Buddha-Fields"; the light called "Erecting Pure Vajra-Jewel Banners on High"; the light called "Universally Adorning the Bodhisattva Assemblies and Sites of Enlightenment"; and the light called "Exalting the Names of All Buddhas with Wondrous Sounds."...

In this manner, there were as many such [rays] as atoms in a buddha-field; each, in turn, had as many light rays as atoms in a buddha-field as its retinue. These rays all possessed the colors of various wonderful jewels and universally illuminated world-oceans, numbering as many as the atoms in ten billion buddha-fields in each of the ten directions.
The assemblies of bodhisattvas in those oceans of worlds each beheld this Flower Treasury Adorned Ocean of Worlds within that radiance.
By the spiritual power of the Buddha, that light spoke these verses before all those assemblies of bodhisattvas:
"Through oceans of practice over immeasurable eons, They have made offerings to oceans of Buddhas in the ten directions."
Having transformed and delivered the ocean of all sentient beings, He has now become the Wondrously Awakened Honored One of Universal Radiance.
From within his pores, clouds of emanations emerge, Their light universally illuminating the ten directions.
All those who are ready for transformation are awakened; They are led toward Bodhi, pure and unimpeded.
In the past, the Buddha traveled through all realms of existence, Teaching and maturing all living beings;
With unimpeded and boundless supernormal powers, He enabled them all to attain liberation in a single thought-moment.
The Bodhi tree of wondrous mani jewels is adorned with every kind of exquisite ornament;
beneath it the Buddha attained perfect enlightenment, emitting a great radiance that shines everywhere with majestic brilliance.
A great sound thunders and roars throughout the ten directions, universally proclaiming the Dharma of quiescent extinction;
according to the inclinations of the minds of all sentient beings, he employs various skillful means to bring them to understanding.
In past lives you perfected all the perfections, as numerous as the atoms within a thousand lands;
you have fully accomplished all the powers—ye should go together to behold and pay homage to him.
Buddha-sons from lands as numerous as atoms in the ten directions, all gathering together with great joy;
having already rained down various clouds as offerings, they now stand before the Buddha, gazing up at him with single-minded devotion.
The Tathāgata’s single voice is immeasurable, Able to expound the profound and vast ocean of the sūtras;
It rains down the wondrous Dharma everywhere according to the minds of all beings— One should go to behold that Honored One among Two-Legged Beings.
The vows of all Buddhas of the three periods of time were all proclaimed beneath the Bodhi tree;
they manifest completely within a single kṣaṇa. You should quickly go to the place where the Tathāgata dwells.
Vairocana’s ocean of great wisdom radiates light from his countenance such that nothing remains unseen;
now, awaiting the assembly, he is about to proclaim his voice—go and behold him, and hear what he says.

At that time, all the assemblies throughout the oceans of worlds in the ten directions, having been awakened by the Buddha’s light, each came together to the presence of the Tathāgata Vairocana to attend upon and make offerings to him.
That is to say:
to the east of this Flower Bank Adorned World-Ocean, there is another world-ocean named Pure Light Lotus Adornment.
Within that world-system, there is a land named Vajragarbha Maṇi-garland;
the Buddha there is named Dharma-water Awakened Boundless Space King.

Within that ocean-like assembly of the Tathāgata, there was a bodhisattva mahāsattva named Padmadhvaja-vyavalokita-saddharma, who, together with as many bodhisattvas as there are atoms in an ocean of worlds, came to where the Buddha was. Each manifested ten kinds of clouds of bodhisattva physical forms, which filled all of space without dispersing or vanishing.

Furthermore, they manifested ten kinds of clouds of light from all-jeweled lotuses raining down; ten kinds of clouds of Sumeru jewel peaks; ten kinds of clouds of solar disc radiance; ten kinds of clouds of jewel-flower necklaces; ten kinds of clouds of all musical instruments; ten kinds of clouds of powdered-incense trees; ten kinds of clouds of various forms of ointment incense and burning incense; and ten kinds of clouds of all fragrant trees. Such clouds of offerings, as numerous as the atoms within an ocean of worlds, completely filled the void without dispersing or ceasing.
Having manifested these clouds, they prostrated before the Buddha as an act of worship.
Then, in the eastern direction, each manifested various lion thrones of the treasury of flower-radiance, and upon those thrones, they sat cross-legged.
To the south of this Flower Treasury World-Ocean, there is another world-ocean named Adorned Treasury of the Radiance of All Jewel Moons.
Within that world-system, there is a land named:
In the realm of Infinite Light, Perfectly Adorned,
there is a Buddha named King Sumeru of Universal Wisdom Radiance and Virtue.
Within the ocean-like assembly of that Tathāgata, there is a bodhisattva mahāsattva named:

The Bodhisattva Samantāvabhāsa-dharmasāgara-mati, together with as many bodhisattvas as there are atoms in a world-ocean, came to where the Buddha was. Each manifested ten kinds of clouds of *maṇi*-kings, treasuries of light adorned with all ornaments, which filled the entirety of space without dispersing or ceasing;
they further manifested ten kinds of clouds of *maṇi*-kings that rained down all precious ornaments and universally illumined everything;
they further manifested ten kinds of clouds of *maṇi*-kings with blazing jewel-flames that proclaimed the names of the Buddhas; they further manifested ten...
They manifested clouds of mani-kings proclaiming all Buddha-dharmas; they further manifested ten kinds of clouds of mani-kings with various exquisite trees adorning the site of enlightenment;
they further manifested ten kinds of clouds of mani-kings whose precious light shines everywhere, manifesting many transformation Buddhas;
they further manifested ten kinds of mani-kings whose images universally appear as adornments for all sites of enlightenment.
Clouds of mani-jewel kings manifesting ten kinds of secret flaming lamps that proclaim the realm of all Buddhas;
clouds of mani-jewel kings manifesting ten kinds of inconceivable images of Buddha-lands and palaces;

clouds of mani-jewel kings manifesting ten kinds of universal manifestations of the bodies of Buddhas of the three periods of time... such as these, as numerous as the atoms within an ocean of worlds.
Clouds of mani-jewel kings, as numerous as motes of dust, completely filled the void without dispersing or extinguishing.
Having manifested these clouds, they paid homage to the Buddha as an offering.
Then, in the southern direction, each manifested a lion throne consisting of a treasury of Jambūnada gold and Indranīla-blue jewels; upon these thrones, they sat cross-legged.
To the west of this Flower Treasury World-Ocean, there is another world-ocean named Lovely Jewel Radiance.
Within that world-system, there is a land named:
Born with supreme and exquisite requisites for sustaining the body,
the Buddha’s name is Jewel Adornment of Fragrant Flame Merit.
Within the ocean-like assembly of that Tathāgata, there is a bodhisattva mahāsattva named:

Moonlight Fragrance Flame Universal Adornment, together with as many bodhisattvas as there are atoms in an ocean of worlds, came to where the Buddha was; each manifested ten kinds of clouds of exquisite pavilions made of all manner of precious fragrances and flowers, which filled the void without dispersing or vanishing.

Furthermore, clouds of ten kinds of pavilions made of kings of various jewels, manifesting boundless forms and colors, appeared; clouds of ten kinds of pavilions with fragrant flames from jewel lamps appeared; clouds of ten kinds of pavilions made entirely of pearls appeared; clouds of ten kinds of pavilions made entirely of jewel flowers appeared; clouds of ten kinds of pavilions adorned with precious necklaces appeared; clouds of ten kinds of pavilions that universally manifest all adornments as treasuries of light throughout the ten directions appeared; clouds of ten kinds of pavilions interspersed with various powdered jewels for adornment appeared; clouds of ten kinds of pavilions pervading all adornments throughout the ten directions appeared; and clouds of ten kinds of pavilions with flowered gates and networks of bells appeared... such clouds of pavilions, as numerous as the atoms within an ocean of worlds, completely filled the void without dispersing or ceasing to exist.
Having manifested these clouds, they paid homage to the Buddha as an act of offering.
Then, in the western direction, each manifested a lion throne made of great treasures with leaves of pure gold; upon those thrones, they sat cross-legged.
To the north of this Flower Bank World-Ocean, there is another world-ocean named Vaidūrya Lotus Light Perfect Treasury.
Within that world-system, there is a land named:
Adorned with *utpala* flowers, the Buddha there is named King of the Sound of the Banner of Universal Wisdom.
Within the ocean-like assembly of that Tathāgata, there is a bodhisattva mahāsattva named:

The Bodhisattva Lion’s Vigorous Stride Radiance, together with as many bodhisattvas as there are atoms in an ocean of worlds, came to where the Buddha was; each manifested ten kinds of clouds of exquisite trees made of all-fragrant mani-jewels, which filled all of space without dispersing or fading.

Furthermore, there appeared ten kinds of clouds of trees adorned with secret leaves and exquisite fragrances; ten kinds of clouds of trees adorned with manifested forms of all boundless colors and shapes; ten kinds of clouds of trees adorned with all flowers spread everywhere; ten kinds of clouds of trees adorned with the perfect light of all jewel flames; ten kinds of clouds of trees adorned with the manifestation of the bodies of Bodhisattvas smelling of all sandalwood incense; ten kinds of clouds of trees adorned with the inconceivable arrays of former sites of enlightenment; ten kinds of clouds of trees like the radiance of the sun, containing treasuries of various precious garments; and ten kinds of clouds of trees that universally emit all pleasing sounds... such clouds of trees, as numerous as the atoms within an ocean of worlds, completely filled the void without dispersing or vanishing.
Having manifested these clouds, they paid homage to the Buddha as an offering.
Then, in the northern direction, each manifested a lion throne of the lotus-treasury of mani-lamps; upon those thrones, they sat cross-legged.
To the northeast of this Flower Treasury World-Ocean, there is another world-ocean named Jāmbūnada-Golden-Lapis-Lazuli-Colored-Banner.
Within that world-system, there is a land named:
Adorned with various jewels, the Buddha there is named Fearless Lamp of All Dharmas.
Within that ocean-like assembly of the Tathāgata, there is a bodhisattva mahāsattva named:

The Buddha Supreme Radiant Lamp of Inexhaustible Merit-Treasury, accompanied by as many bodhisattvas as there are atoms in an ocean of worlds, came to where the Buddha was. Each manifested ten kinds of clouds of lion thrones within jewel-lotus treasuries of boundless colors and forms, which filled all of space without dispersing or ceasing;
they further manifested ten kinds of clouds of lion thrones from the luminous treasury of king-maṇi jewels;

they further manifested ten kinds of clouds of lion thrones adorned with various ornaments of every kind of embellishment; and they further manifested ten kinds of clouds of garlands made of various jewels.
There appeared clouds of lion thrones from the treasury of lamp-flames; furthermore, there appeared ten kinds of clouds of lion thrones raining down precious necklaces everywhere;
furthermore, there appeared ten kinds of clouds of lion thrones from the treasury of all fragrant flowers and precious necklaces;
furthermore, there appeared ten kinds of clouds of lion thrones from the treasury of mani-kings that manifest the adornments of the seats of all Buddhas.
Furthermore, there appeared ten kinds of clouds of lion thrones adorned with windows, portals, steps, and various necklaces;
furthermore, there appeared ten kinds of clouds of lion thrones containing the treasuries of branches and stems of all kinds of mani-jewel trees;
furthermore, there appeared ten kinds of clouds of lion thrones adorned with precious incense and the treasury of solar radiance... such as these.
Clouds of lion thrones, as numerous as the atoms within oceans of worlds, completely filled the void without dispersing or vanishing.
Having manifested these clouds, they paid homage to the Buddha as an act of offering.
Immediately, in the northeast, each manifested a lion throne of jewel-lotus mani-light banners; upon these thrones, they sat cross-legged.
To the southeast of this Flower Treasury World-Ocean, there is another world-ocean named Golden Adornment Lapis Lazuli Light Universally Shining.
Within that world-system, there is a land named:
In the land of Pure Fragrant Radiance, there is a Buddha named King of Universal Joy and Profound Faith.
Within the ocean-like assembly of that Tathāgata, there is a Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva named:

The Bodhisattva Wisdom Lamp Universal Radiance, together with as many bodhisattvas as there are atoms in an ocean of worlds, came to where the Buddha was. Each manifested ten kinds of clouds of *sarvārthasiddha-maṇi* canopies, which filled all of space without dispersing or vanishing;

they further manifested ten kinds of clouds of *indranīla* jewel canopies adorned with all flowers, ten kinds of clouds of canopies made of all fragrant *maṇi* jewels, ten kinds of clouds of canopies of jewel-flame lamps, and furthermore, ten...
He manifested clouds of mani-jewel king canopies that display the Buddha’s supernatural powers and preach the Dharma;
he further manifested ten kinds of mani-jewel canopy clouds that manifest the colors and forms of all garments and ornaments;

he further manifested ten kinds of canopy clouds of radiant clusters of all precious flowers; he further manifested ten kinds of canopy clouds with the sounds of jewel nets and bells; and he further manifested...
Ten kinds of mani-jewels formed pedestals, while lotus flowers formed nets and canopies as clouds;
furthermore, ten kinds of canopies manifesting the forms and colors of all inconceivable ornaments appeared as clouds...
such clouds of various precious canopies, as numerous as the atoms within an ocean of worlds, completely filled the void without dispersing or perishing.
Having manifested these clouds, they paid homage to the Buddha as an act of offering.
Then, in the southeast, each manifested a lion throne within a precious lotus treasury, and upon those thrones, they sat cross-legged.
To the southwest of this Flower Treasury World-Ocean, there is another world-ocean named Sunlight Shining Everywhere.
Within that world-system, there is a land named:
In the ocean-like assembly of that Tathāgata, Lion Sun Radiance,
whose name is Universal Wisdom Radiant Sound, there is a bodhisattva mahāsattva named:

Samantakusumaprabhājvālācūḍa, together with bodhisattvas as numerous as the atoms in an ocean of worlds, came to where the Buddha was. Each manifested ten kinds of clouds of exquisite, wondrously adorned jewel canopies, which filled all of space without dispersing or fading;

they further manifested ten kinds of clouds of flower canopies adorned with light, ten kinds of clouds of pearl-treasury canopies of boundless colors, and ten kinds of mani-kings that emitted the sounds of the compassion of all bodhisattvas.
Clouds of canopies appeared, further manifesting ten kinds of clouds of canopies of wreaths of flames of various exquisite jewels;
further manifesting ten kinds of clouds of canopies of hanging nets and bells adorned with exquisite jewels; further manifesting ten kinds of clouds of canopies adorned with branches of *maṇi* trees;
further manifesting ten kinds of clouds of canopies of *maṇi*-kings that universally illuminate like sunlight; further manifesting ten kinds...

There were clouds of all kinds of ointments, incense, and canopies; furthermore, ten kinds of sandalwood-treasury canopy-clouds appeared, and ten kinds of vast, universally radiant, adorned canopy-clouds belonging to the Buddha-realm appeared...
such clouds of various precious canopies, as numerous as the atoms within an ocean of worlds, completely filled the void without dispersing or perishing.
Having manifested these clouds, they prostrated before the Buddha as an act of worship.
Then, in the southwest, each manifested a lion throne adorned with a treasury of light-flames of sapphire-blue jewels, and upon those thrones, they sat cross-legged.
To the northwest of this Flower Treasury World-Ocean, there is another world-ocean named Jewel Radiance.
Within that world-system, there is a land named:
Adorned with various fragrances, the Buddha there is named Infinite Ocean of Merit Radiance.
Within that ocean-like assembly of that Tathāgata, there is a bodhisattva mahāsattva named:

The King of Inexhaustible Light Maṇi, together with as many bodhisattvas as there are atoms in an ocean of worlds, came to where the Buddha was. Each manifested ten kinds of clouds of light, perfect with all jewels, which filled the entirety of space without dispersing or ceasing;
they further manifested ten kinds of clouds of light, perfect with the flames of all jewels; they further manifested ten kinds of clouds of light, perfect with all exquisite flowers;
they further manifested ten kinds of clouds of light, perfect with all emanated Buddhas; and furthermore—
They manifested ten kinds of clouds of perfect light from the Buddha-lands of the ten directions;

they further manifested ten kinds of clouds of perfect light from jewel-trees with the thunderous sound of the Buddhas' realms; they further manifested ten kinds of clouds of perfect light from all kinds of lapis lazuli and mani-kings;
they further manifested ten kinds of clouds of perfect light that, within a single thought-moment, display the forms of infinite sentient beings.
Furthermore, clouds of light appeared, manifesting ten kinds of perfect clouds of light that emanate the sounds of the great vows of all Tathāgatas;
furthermore, clouds of light appeared, manifesting ten kinds of perfect clouds of light of the mani-kings that transform the voices of all sentient beings...
such clouds of perfect light, as numerous as the atoms in an ocean of worlds, completely pervaded space without...
They dispersed and vanished.
Having manifested these clouds, they prostrated before the Buddha as an offering.
Then, from the northwest, each manifested a lion throne of inexhaustible radiance and majestic virtue; upon those thrones, they sat cross-legged.
Below this Flower Treasury World-Ocean, there is another world-ocean named Lotus Fragrance Sublime Virtue Treasury.
Within that world-system, there is a land named:
In the land of Jewel Lion Radiance, the Buddha’s name is Dharma Realm Radiance.
Within the ocean-like assembly of that Tathāgata, there is a bodhisattva mahāsattva named:

The Bodhisattva Dharmadhātu-jvālā-prabhā, together with as many bodhisattvas as there are atoms in an ocean of worlds, came to where the Buddha was; each manifested ten kinds of clouds of light from the treasury of all maṇi jewels, which filled the void of space without dispersing or fading.

Furthermore, they manifested ten kinds of clouds of light of all fragrances; ten kinds of clouds of light of all jewel-flames; ten kinds of clouds of light emitting the sounds of all Buddhas preaching the Dharma; ten kinds of clouds of light manifesting the adornments of all Buddha-lands; ten kinds of clouds of light of all exquisite flower-pavilions; ten kinds of clouds of light manifesting the deeds of all Buddhas transforming sentient beings throughout all kalpas; ten kinds of clouds of light of all inexhaustible jewel-pollen; and ten kinds of clouds of light of all adorned seats... such clouds of light, as numerous as the atoms within an ocean of worlds, completely pervaded space without dispersing or vanishing.
Having manifested these clouds, they paid homage to the Buddha as an act of offering.
Then, from below, each transformed themselves into a lion throne within a lotus treasury of jewel-flame lamps; upon these thrones, they sat cross-legged.
Above this Flower Bank World-Ocean, there is another world-ocean named Mani-Jewel Radiant Adornment.
Within that world-system, there is a land named:
In the wondrous light of signlessness,
there is a Buddha named King of Unobstructed Merit Light.
Within the ocean-like assembly of that Tathāgata, there is a Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva named:

With unimpeded power, diligence, and wisdom, he came to the place where the Buddha was together with bodhisattvas as numerous as the atoms in an ocean of worlds; each manifested ten kinds of clouds of jewel-light flames of infinite color-forms, which filled all of space without dispersing or extinguishing.

Furthermore, they manifested ten kinds of clouds of light-flames from mani-jewel nets; ten kinds of clouds of light-flames from the adornments of all vast Buddha-lands; ten kinds of clouds of light-flames from all exquisite fragrances; ten kinds of clouds of light-flames from all manner of ornaments; ten kinds of clouds of light-flames from the transformations of all Buddhas; ten kinds of clouds of light-flames from the flowers of various wondrous trees; ten kinds of clouds of light-flames from all vajras; ten kinds of clouds of light-flames from mani-jewels proclaiming the boundless practices of Bodhisattvas; and ten kinds of clouds of light-flames from all pearl lamps... such clouds of light-flames, as numerous as the atoms within an ocean of worlds, pervaded the entirety of space without dispersing or ceasing.
Having manifested these clouds, they paid homage to the Buddha as an act of worship.
Then, from above, each manifested a lion throne made of lotus-treasury flowers that radiated light and proclaimed the Buddha’s voice; upon these thrones, they sat cross-legged.

In this way, within world-oceans numbering as many as the atoms in ten billion buddha-fields, there were bodhisattva-mahāsattvas numbering as many as the atoms in ten billion buddha-fields; each was surrounded by a retinue of bodhisattvas numbering as many as the atoms in a world-ocean, and they all came together for this assembly.
Each of these bodhisattvas manifested clouds of various offerings, as numerous as the atoms within an ocean of worlds, all of which pervaded space without dispersing or ceasing.
Having manifested these clouds, they paid homage to the Buddha as an act of worship.
Then, according to the directions from which they had come, each miraculously created a lion throne adorned with various jewels; upon these thrones, they sat cross-legged.
Once they were thus seated, from every single pore of the bodies of those bodhisattvas, there appeared ten world-ocean-microdust numbers of multicolored lights composed of all kinds of jewels;
within each light, there appeared ten world-ocean-microdust numbers of bodhisattvas, all seated upon lion thrones within lotus treasuries.
These bodhisattvas are all able to enter everywhere into every atom within the ocean of all established realms of the entire dharma-realm;
within each and every atom, there are vast lands as numerous as the atoms in ten buddha-worlds;
and within each and every land, there are the Buddhas, the World-Honored Ones, of the three periods of time.
These Bodhisattvas are all able to go everywhere to approach, attend upon, and make offerings;
in every thought-moment, through the mastery of dreams, they manifest Dharma-gates to awaken sentient beings as numerous as the atoms within oceans of worlds;
in every thought-moment, by manifesting the Dharma-gate of the death and birth of all devas, they awaken sentient beings as numerous as the atoms within oceans of worlds.
In every thought-moment, by means of the dharma-gate that expounds all bodhisattva practices, they awaken world-ocean-microdust numbers of sentient beings;

in every thought-moment, by means of the dharma-gate of the spiritual transformations of praising the Buddha’s merits that universally shake all lands, they awaken world-ocean-microdust numbers of sentient beings;

in every thought-moment, by means of the dharma-gate that displays the ocean of all great vows through the adornment and purification of all buddha-lands, they awaken world-ocean-microdust numbers of sentient beings.
In every thought-moment, by means of the dharma-door of the Buddha’s voice using speech that universally gathers all sentient beings, they awaken world-ocean-microdust numbers of sentient beings;
in every thought-moment, by means of the dharma-door of raining down clouds of all Buddha-dharmas, they awaken world-ocean-microdust numbers of sentient beings;

in every thought-moment, by means of the dharma-door of manifesting spiritual transformations that illuminate the lands of the ten directions with light pervading the entire dharma-realm, they awaken world-ocean-microdust numbers of sentient beings.

In every thought-moment, by means of the dharma-gate of the power of liberation of all Tathāgatas that universally manifests Buddha-bodies to pervade the entire Dharma-realm, he awakens sentient beings as numerous as the atoms within oceans of worlds;

in every thought-moment, by means of the dharma-gate of Samantabhadra Bodhisattva’s establishment of oceans of assemblies and sites of enlightenment, he awakens sentient beings as numerous as the atoms within oceans of worlds.
In this manner, throughout the entire dharma-realm, according to the minds of sentient beings, they cause all to attain awakening.

In every thought-moment, within each and every land, they cause as many sentient beings as there are atoms in Mount Sumeru who have fallen into the evil realms to be forever freed from their suffering;
and they cause as many sentient beings as there are atoms in Mount Sumeru who abide in false determination to enter the stage of right determination.
May each cause sentient beings as numerous as the atoms within Mount Sumeru to be born in the heavens according to their inclinations;
may each cause sentient beings as numerous as the atoms within Mount Sumeru to dwell securely in the stages of śrāvakas and pratyekabuddhas;
and may each cause sentient beings as numerous as the atoms within Mount Sumeru to serve spiritual friends and fulfill all meritorious practices.
May each cause as many sentient beings as there are atoms in Mount Sumeru to resolve upon unexcelled bodhicitta;
may each cause as many sentient beings as there are atoms in Mount Sumeru to advance toward the stage of non-retrogression of a bodhisattva;
may each cause as many sentient beings as there are atoms in Mount Sumeru to attain the pure eye of wisdom and perceive all dharmas of equality as seen by the Tathāgata.

May each cause as many sentient beings as there are atoms in Mount Sumeru to dwell securely within the ocean of all powers and vows, purifying Buddha-lands through the skillful means of inexhaustible wisdom;
may each cause as many sentient beings as there are atoms in Mount Sumeru to all attain dwelling in the vast ocean of Vairocana’s vows and be born into the family of the Tathāgata.
At that time, from within the radiance of all the bodhisattvas, voices simultaneously issued forth, speaking these verses:
"From within all the radiances emerge wondrous sounds, Pervading all lands throughout the ten directions.
They proclaim the various merits of the Buddha’s sons, Able to enter the sublime path to enlightenment."
Practicing through oceans of eons without weariness, Causing suffering sentient beings to attain liberation,
With a mind free from inferiority or fatigue— The Buddha’s heirs skillfully enter these expedient means.
Throughout oceans of kalpas, they cultivate skillful means, Immeasurable, boundless, and without exception;
They enter into every dharma-gate, Yet always proclaim that their nature is quiescent extinction.
All the vows of the Buddhas of the three periods of time, I shall cultivate and fulfill them all;
thereby benefiting all sentient beings, I make this my own practice of pure karma.
Within the assemblies of all Buddhas throughout the ten directions, there is nowhere they do not go;
by means of the ocean of their profound wisdom, they enter the Tathāgata’s dharma of quiescent extinction.
Each and every ray of light is boundless, Entering entirely into inconceivable lands;
The pure eye of wisdom can see them all— Such is the sphere of activity of these bodhisattvas.

The Bodhisattva can abide upon the tip of a single hair, Causing all lands throughout the ten directions to tremble, Yet without causing sentient beings to harbor any thought of fear; This is the stage of their pure skillful means.
Within each and every atom are immeasurable bodies, Furthermore manifesting various adorned lands;
In a single thought, they vanish and appear, allowing all to see— Those who have attained the adornment of unimpeded intent.
All kalpas throughout the three periods of time can be manifested within a single kṣaṇa;
knowing that the body is like an illusion, devoid of essence or characteristics, they realize and testify to the unimpeded nature of dharmatā.
They are able to enter all the supreme practices of Samantabhadra, And all sentient beings delight in seeing them;
The sons of the Buddha who can abide in this Dharma-gate Let out a great roar amidst all the radiance.

At that time, the World-Honored One, desiring to enable the entire assembly of bodhisattvas to attain the supernatural power of the Tathāgata’s boundless realm, emitted a ray of light from between his eyebrows.
This light was named "The Radiance of the Wisdom of All Bodhisattvas," which universally illumines the treasuries of the ten directions.
Its appearance was like a cloud of jewel-colored lamps, illuminating all Buddha-fields throughout the ten directions, causing all those lands and their sentient beings to be clearly revealed.
Furthermore, they cause all networks of worlds to tremble universally, and within each atom, they manifest countless Buddhas.

According to the differing inclinations and natures of sentient beings, they universally rain down clouds of the wondrous Dharma-wheels of all Buddhas of the three periods of time, revealing the ocean of the Tathāgata’s pāramitās;
they also rain down immeasurable clouds of renunciation, causing all sentient beings to forever cross over birth and death.
Furthermore, clouds of the great vows of all Buddhas rained down, manifesting the assemblies at the sites of enlightenment of Samantabhadra Bodhisattva throughout the worlds of the ten directions.
Having performed these deeds, they circumambulated the Buddha to the right and entered through the soles of his feet.
At that time, a great lotus flower suddenly appeared before the Buddha.
This flower possessed ten kinds of adornments, such that no other lotus could equal it.
That is to say:
various jewels were interspersed to form its stalk;
the sovereign mani-jewel was used as its bulbous base.
The petals are formed from the various jewels of the dharma-realm;
the filaments are made of fragrant maṇi-gems;
and the pedestal is adorned and polished with Jāmbūnada gold.
A wondrous net covers it above, its radiance and color pure and clear;
within a single thought-moment, it manifests the infinite spiritual transformations of all Buddhas and is universally able to give rise to all sounds.
The king of mani-jewels manifests the body of the Buddha;
within its sounds, it is able to universally expound all the practices and vows cultivated by bodhisattvas.
Once this flower has arisen, in a single thought-moment, from within the white tuft of hair between the Tathāgata’s eyebrows, there appears a bodhisattva mahāsattva named:

Sarvadharma-viśiṣṭa-ghoṣā emerged simultaneously with a multitude of bodhisattvas as numerous as the atoms within an ocean of worlds; they circumambulated the Tathāgata to the right for immeasurable circuits, and having prostrated at the Buddha’s feet, [they stood before him].
At that time, the Bodhisattva Jyotirghoṣa sat upon the lotus pedestal, while the assembly of bodhisattvas sat upon the lotus filaments, each dwelling there in successive order.
The Bodhisattva Sarvadharmanirghoṣa, having realized the profound realm of reality (dharmadhātu), gave rise to great joy;
he entered the sphere of the Buddha’s conduct, his wisdom being without obstruction;
he entered the unfathomable ocean of the Buddha’s Dharma-body and proceeded to the abodes of all Tathāgatas in all lands.
From all the pores of his body, he manifested spiritual powers, and in every thought-moment, he universally contemplated the entire dharma-realm.

All Buddhas of the ten directions collectively bestowed their power upon him, enabling him to dwell securely in all samādhis until the end of all future kalpas, constantly beholding the bodies of the Buddhas—the boundless oceans of merit within the dharma-realm—extending even to all samādhis, liberations, and transformations of spiritual powers.
Then, within that assembly, sustained by the Buddha’s majestic spiritual power, he surveyed the ten directions and spoke in verse:
“The Buddha-body pervades the entire Dharma-realm, Appearing universally before all sentient beings;
Responding to conditions and fulfilling requests without exception, Yet it eternally abides upon this seat of enlightenment.”
Within each and every pore of the Tathāgata, Buddhas as numerous as the atoms of all lands sit,
Surrounded by assemblies of bodhisattvas, Proclaiming the sublime practices of Samantabhadra.
The Tathāgata, seated upon the Bodhi throne, manifests oceans of many lands within a single pore;
every single pore manifests in this same way, thus pervading the entire Dharma-realm.
Within each and every land they are all established, pervading every single buddha-field;
bodhisattvas from the ten directions gather like clouds, none of whom fail to come to the site of enlightenment.

As numerous as the atoms within all buddha-lands, oceans of Bodhisattvas of Merit and Radiance are universally present within the assemblies of the Tathāgatas, pervading the entire realm of phenomena.
Within every atom of the dharma-realm and all its lands, he appears amidst all assemblies;
such a realm of wisdom for manifesting emanated bodies is established through the conduct of Samantabhadra.
Within the assemblies of all Buddhas, the Bodhisattvas of Supreme Wisdom sit together in unison;
each listens to the Dharma with joy, practicing it everywhere throughout immeasurable eons.
Having entered the vast vows of Samantabhadra, each gives birth to all Buddha-dharmas;
within the ocean of Vairocana’s Dharma, through practice, they realize the stage of the Tathāgata.
Awakened by Samantabhadra Bodhisattva, all Tathāgatas likewise praise and rejoice;
having attained the great supernormal powers of all Buddhas, they circulate throughout the Dharma-realm without exception.
In numbers equal to the atoms of all lands, He constantly manifests clouds of bodies that completely fill them;
Universally emitting great rays of light for the sake of sentient beings, Each raining down the rain of Dharma according to their inclinations.
At that time, there was another bodhisattva mahāsattva in the assembly named Lotus Flower Light Wisdom King Who Observes All Supreme Dharmas.
Empowered by the Buddha’s majestic spiritual authority, he surveyed the ten directions and spoke in verse:
“The Tathāgata’s profoundly deep wisdom Universally enters the dharma-realm.”
Able to turn in accordance with the three periods of time, acting as a luminous guide for the world;
all Buddhas share the same Dharma-body, without dependence and without distinction,
yet according to the inclinations of sentient beings, they cause them to perceive the physical forms of the Buddhas.
Endowed with all-knowledge, universally cognizant of all phenomena,
throughout all lands, there is nothing in which he does not appear.
The Buddha’s body and its radiance, as well as his physical marks, are inconceivable.
For those sentient beings who possess faith and joy, he causes them all to see him according to their needs.
Upon the body of a single Buddha, he manifests as immeasurable Buddhas;
with a thunderous voice that pervades all lands, he expounds the Dharma as profound as the ocean.
From within each and every pore, nets of light pervade the ten directions,
proclaiming the Buddha’s wondrous voice to harmonize those who are difficult to tame.
From within the Tathāgata’s radiance, there constantly issues forth a profound and sublime sound.
I praise the ocean of the Buddha’s merits and the practices of the bodhisattvas.
The Buddha turns the wheel of the sublime Dharma, which is immeasurable and boundless;
the teachings he proclaims are peerless, beyond the fathom of those with shallow wisdom.
Throughout all worlds, he manifests his body and attains perfect enlightenment;
each displays miraculous transformations, filling the entire dharma-realm.
From each and every body of the Tathāgata, he manifests Buddhas equal in number to all sentient beings.
"In all lands of subtle atoms, you universally manifest the power of spiritual transformations.
At that time, there was another Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva in the assembly named Dharmaprīti-jñānāloka.
Empowered by the Buddha’s majestic spirit, he surveyed the ten directions and spoke in verse:
“The Buddha-body is constantly manifest, filling the entire dharma-realm;
it perpetually produces a vast sound that universally resounds throughout the lands of the ten directions.
The Tathāgata manifests his body everywhere, pervading and entering all worlds.”
In accordance with the inclinations and desires of sentient beings, he manifests his supernormal powers.
Following the minds of sentient beings, the Buddha appears universally before them;
all that sentient beings perceive is the Buddha’s supernatural power.
The radiance is boundless, and the teaching of the Dharma is likewise immeasurable;
the sons of the Buddha, according to their wisdom, are able to enter it and observe it.
The Buddha-body is without birth, yet it can manifest birth.
The nature of phenomena is like space, and within it all Buddhas abide.
Without abiding and without departing, they are seen everywhere;
their radiance is all-pervading, and their fame is heard afar.
Without substance and without abode, Nor can any arising be found;
Without marks and without form, All that appears is like a shadow.
The Buddha, according to the minds of sentient beings, Rises as a great cloud of Dharma.
Through various gates of skillful means, he reveals and awakens beings to bring them under discipline.
In all worlds, one sees the Buddha seated at the site of enlightenment,
surrounded by a great assembly, illuminating the lands of the ten directions.
"The bodies of all Buddhas possess inexhaustible marks;
though their manifestations are immeasurable, their physical forms are ultimately never exhausted.
At that time, there was another Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva in the assembly named:
The Bodhisattva Universal Radiance of Fragrant Flame Wisdom, empowered by the Buddha’s majestic spiritual authority, surveyed the ten directions and spoke in verse:
“The bodhisattvas in this assembly Have entered the inconceivable stages of the Buddha;
Each and every one of them is able to see The spiritual powers of all Buddhas.”
The body of wisdom can universally enter the atoms of all lands;
seeing one's own body therein, one perceives all Buddhas everywhere.
Like reflections appearing in myriad lands, so it is in the presence of all Tathāgatas.
Within all of those places, he manifests all manner of miraculous deeds.
Having purified and clarified all the practices and vows of Samantabhadra,
he is able to universally behold the spiritual transformations of the Buddhas in all lands.
The body abides in all places, and all are entirely equal;
when wisdom can act in this way, one enters the realm of the Buddha.
Having already realized the wisdom of the Tathāgata, one illuminates the Dharma-realm with equanimity.
Universally entering the pores of the Buddha, Into all oceans of lands;
In all buddha-fields, They everywhere manifest supernormal powers,
Displaying various bodies And various names.
In a single moment, they can universally manifest all supernatural transformations—
attaining perfect enlightenment at the site of awakening and turning the wondrous wheel of Dharma.
Throughout all vast lands, for inconceivable billions of eons, they remain thus.
Within the samādhi of a bodhisattva, In a single thought-moment,
they can manifest all of them. All buddha-lands, and each and every bodhisattva therein,
Universally enter the body of the Buddha, Boundless and inexhaustible.
At that time, there was another bodhisattva mahāsattva in the assembly named Lion’s Vigorous Speed Wisdom Radiance.
Empowered by the Buddha’s majestic spiritual authority, he surveyed the ten directions and spoke in verse:
“Vairocana Buddha, Able to turn the true wheel of Dharma...”
Throughout all lands in the Dharma-realm, they pervade everywhere like clouds.
Within all the great oceans of worlds throughout the ten directions,
by the power of the Buddha’s spiritual penetrations and vows, the Wheel of Dharma is turned in every place.
In all the buddha-lands, amidst vast assemblies,
His names differ according to each place, As he expounds the wondrous Dharma in accordance with needs.
The Tathāgata’s great majestic power Is accomplished through the vows of Samantabhadra.
Throughout all lands, the wondrous voice reaches everywhere.
The Buddha’s body is equal in extent to the atoms of all realms; he universally rains down the rain of Dharma, unborn and without distinction, manifesting throughout all worlds.
Throughout countless billions of eons, within all the lands as numerous as atoms,
the deeds performed in the past are fully proclaimed by his wondrous voice.
His net of light pervades everywhere throughout the lands of the ten directions, as numerous as atoms.
Within the light there are Buddhas everywhere, universally transforming all living beings.
The Buddha-bodies are without distinction, filling the entire Dharma-realm;
they enable the manifestation of form-bodies to skillfully subdue others according to their capacities.
In all lands throughout the three periods of time,
All the various teachers with their diverse names— He speaks for them so that they may all be seen.
All Tathāgatas of the past, future, and present,
"The sublime Wheel of Dharma that has been turned, all in this assembly shall hear.
At that time, there was another bodhisattva-mahāsattva in the great multitude named Dharmasāgaraprajñāguṇagarbha.
Relying on the Buddha’s majestic spiritual power, he surveyed the ten directions and spoke in verse:
"All these sons of the Buddhas in this assembly have skillfully cultivated all forms of wisdom;
these individuals are now able to enter such gates of expedient means.
Within each and every land, they universally proclaim their vast and sublime voices."
They proclaim the sphere of the Buddha’s conduct, heard throughout the lands of the ten directions;
within each and every thought-moment, they universally contemplate all phenomena,
abiding securely on the stage of True Suchness and thoroughly comprehending the ocean of all dharmas.
Within each and every Buddha-body, for inconceivable billions of kalpas,
they cultivate the pāramitās and adorn and purify buddha-lands.
Within each and every atom, they are able to realize all dharmas.
Thus, being unimpeded, they travel throughout the lands of the ten directions.
To each and every buddha-field, they go without exception;
beholding the supernatural powers of the Buddhas, they enter the sphere of the Buddhas' activity.
The vast voices of all Buddhas, throughout the entire Dharma-realm, are heard without exception;
Bodhisattvas are able to understand them and skillfully enter the ocean of sounds.
Throughout oceans of eons they proclaim wondrous voices, yet those voices are equal and without distinction.
One whose wisdom encompasses the three periods of time enters that stage of Sound;
regarding all sounds of sentient beings as well as the sovereign voice of the Buddha,
having attained the wisdom of sound, they are able to comprehend them all.
"Attaining stage after stage, dwelling within the stages of power,
having practiced diligently for billions of eons— the Dharma thus obtained is as follows.
At that time, there was another Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva in the assembly named:
The Lamp of Wisdom, Universally Radiant, receiving the Buddha’s majestic spiritual power, surveyed the ten directions and spoke in verse:
"All Tathāgatas are far removed from all marks;
if one can know this Dharma, one shall see the Teacher of the World."
Within the samādhis of the bodhisattvas, the light of wisdom is universally clear and bright;
they are able to know the sovereign nature of all Buddhas.
Seeing the true body of the Buddha, they then awaken to the most profound Dharma.
Universally observing the dharma-realm, they assume bodies according to their vows.
Born from an ocean of merit, they dwell securely on the ground of wisdom;
observing all phenomena, they practice the most supreme path.
Within all Buddha-fields, at the abodes of all Tathāgatas,
thus pervading the entire Dharma-realm, one perceives the true essence everywhere.
Throughout the vast lands of the ten directions, one diligently practices for billions of eons.
Able to roam through the ocean of all dharmas of right and universal knowledge,
The single, firm, and dense body is seen within every atom;
Without birth and without marks, it manifests universally in all lands.
In accordance with the minds of all sentient beings, he manifests universally before them;
through various means of taming, he swiftly causes them to turn toward the Buddha-way.
By the majestic spiritual power of the Buddha, he causes the various bodhisattvas to appear.
Sustained by the power of the Buddha, one universally beholds all Tathāgatas;
all the Teachers of the Multitudes, with their immeasurable majestic spiritual powers,
awaken all Bodhisattvas, pervading the entire Dharma-realm.
At that time, there was another bodhisattva mahāsattva in the assembly named Universal Wisdom of the Flower Flame Topknot.
Empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, he surveyed the ten directions and spoke in verse:
“In all lands throughout the universe, He universally proclaims subtle and wondrous sounds.”
Praising the Buddha’s merits, they fill the entire Dharma-realm.
The Buddha takes the Dharma as his body, pure as empty space;
through the various forms and colors he manifests, he causes all beings to enter into this Dharma.
If there is deep faith and joy, And one is sustained by the Buddha’s grace,
Know that such a person Is able to give birth to the Buddha’s wisdom.
Those with little wisdom Cannot understand this Dharma.
Only those with the pure eye of wisdom can see this;
through the Buddha’s majestic spiritual power, they observe all phenomena,
clearly perceiving them at the moments of entering, abiding, and emerging.
Within all dharmas, there are boundless Dharma-gates;
Having accomplished all-knowledge, they enter the deep ocean of Dharma.
Abiding securely in Buddha-lands, they manifest everywhere.
There is no going and no coming; such is the nature of all Buddha-dharmas.
Within the ocean of all sentient beings, the Buddha-body appears like a reflection;
according to their differing understandings, they thus perceive the Teacher.
From within every single pore, Each manifests spiritual powers;
Those who have purified themselves through the practice of Samantabhadra’s vows Are able to behold them.
With each and every body, the Buddha Turns the wheel of Dharma in every place.
“The Dharma-realm is all-pervasive, beyond the reach of thought or speculation.
At that time, there was another bodhisattva-mahāsattva in the assembly named Inexhaustible Light of Majestic Virtue and Wisdom.
Relying on the Buddha’s majestic spiritual power, he surveyed the ten directions and spoke in verse:
“In each and every Buddha-field, sitting at the site of enlightenment in every place,
surrounded by the assembled multitudes, he utterly subdues the armies of Māra.
From the Buddha’s body he emits radiance that fills the ten directions.”
Manifesting in accordance with what is appropriate, The forms and appearances are not of a single kind.
Within each and every atom, Radiant light completely fills them all,
Universally revealing the lands of the ten directions, Each distinct and diverse in its variety.
In the oceans of lands throughout the ten directions,
All the various and infinite realms Are entirely level and pure, Composed of indranīla jewels.
Some lie face down, some dwell horizontally, And some resemble lotus buds in full bloom.
Whether circular or square, in all manner of diverse forms,
they traverse the various lands of the Dharma-realm without obstruction,
constantly turning the sublime Wheel of Dharma amidst all assemblies.
The Buddha’s body is inconceivable; all lands are contained within it.
In every such place, he guides the world by expounding the true Dharma.
The wondrous wheel of Dharma that he turns is, in its very nature, without distinction.
Relying upon the single principle of reality, he expounds the characteristics of all phenomena.
With his perfect voice, the Buddha elucidates the true principle;
according to the differences in their understanding, he manifests inexhaustible Dharma-gates.
"In all lands, one sees the Buddha seated at the site of enlightenment;
the Buddha’s body appears like a reflection, for its arising and ceasing cannot be apprehended.
At that time, among the assembly, there was another bodhisattva-mahāsattva named:
The Wisdom of Universal Radiance of the Dharma Realm, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the ten directions and spoke in verse:
“The subtle and wondrous body of the Tathāgata, Its physical marks are inconceivable;
Those who behold it give rise to joy, And with reverence, they believe and delight in the Dharma.”
Within every mark of the Buddha’s body, All infinite Buddhas appear;
They enter universally into the realms of the ten directions, Into each and every atom.
In the oceans of lands throughout the ten directions, Are infinite and boundless Buddhas.
In every single thought-moment, each one manifests spiritual powers.
The Bodhisattvas of great wisdom, having deeply entered the ocean of Dharma,
are able to understand these skillful means through the empowerment of the Buddha’s power.
If there are those who have already established themselves in the various practices and vows of Samantabhadra,
they shall see all those buddha-fields and the spiritual powers of all Buddhas.
If a person possesses faith and understanding, as well as great vows, [they shall likewise behold them].
Possessing profound wisdom, they have thoroughly penetrated all phenomena.
They are able to observe each and every aspect of the Buddhas' bodies;
with form and sound presenting no obstruction, they fully comprehend all objective realms.
Able to dwell within the wisdom-practice of the bodies of all Buddhas,
they swiftly enter the stage of the Tathāgatas and universally encompass the entire Dharma-realm.
Within as many Buddha-fields as there are atoms in a world-system, such are the lands they pervade.
Within a single thought-moment, they can cause all lands, And all matters of supernatural power,
To appear within every single atom; Such is the power of the Bodhisattvas.
At that time, there was another bodhisattva mahāsattva in the assembly named Unobstructed Wisdom of Diligent Power.
Empowered by the Buddha’s majestic spiritual authority, he surveyed the ten directions and spoke in verse:
“The Buddha utters a single wondrous sound, Which is heard throughout the lands of the ten directions.”
All sounds are fully possessed, and the rain of Dharma pervades everywhere.
Within the ocean of all speech and all voices according to kind,
throughout all Buddha-fields, the pure wheel of Dharma is turned.
In all lands throughout the universe, All behold the Buddha’s miraculous transformations;
They hear the sound of the Buddha preaching the Dharma, And having heard it, they advance toward Bodhi.
Within every single atom Of all lands throughout the Dharma-realm,
By the power of the Tathāgata’s liberation, he manifests his body everywhere;
the Dharma-body is like space, unimpeded and without distinction,
yet its forms and appearances manifest as various signs, like reflections.
The reflection has no location; like space, it lacks intrinsic nature.
Those of vast wisdom thoroughly realize its equality.
The Buddha-body cannot be grasped; it is without birth and without arising or activity.
Appearing universally before all beings according to their needs, they are as impartial as space.
All Buddhas throughout the ten directions enter entirely into a single pore;
each manifests their own supernatural powers, which the eye of wisdom can perceive.
Vairocana Buddha, through the power of his vows, pervades the entire Dharma realm;
within all lands, he eternally turns the unsurpassed wheel.
Within a single hair-pore he manifests spiritual transformations, which all Buddhas proclaim in unison.
"Even after passing through immeasurable eons, one cannot reach its limit.

Thus, within the site of enlightenment (bodhimaṇḍa) of this four-continent world system, by the Buddha’s spiritual power, there gathered from each of the ten directions assemblies of bodhisattvas as numerous as the atoms in a billion world-oceans;
it should be known that this is likewise the case in every single site of enlightenment within every four-continent world system across all world-oceans.
The Avataṃsaka Sūtra of the Buddha, Volume Six;
The Avataṃsaka Sūtra of the Buddha, Volume Seven.
Translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Śikṣānanda of Khotan by Imperial Decree.
Chapter Three: The Samādhi of Samantabhadra.
At that time, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Samantabhadra sat upon a lion throne within the Lotus Treasury before the Tathāgata; empowered by the Buddha’s spiritual authority, he entered into samādhi.
This samādhi is named:
"The Body-Treasury of Vairocana, the Tathāgata of All Buddhas," which universally enters into the equality of all Buddhas and is able to manifest all images within the Dharma-realm;
it is vast and unimpeded, identical to empty space.
The whirlpools of the ocean of the Dharma-realm, there is none into which they do not enter;
they give birth to all dharmas of samādhi and are universally able to encompass the Dharma-realms of the ten directions;
the oceans of the light of wisdom of all Buddhas of the three periods of time are all born from this, and all the oceans of established realms throughout the ten directions can be manifested therein.
It encompasses all the powers of the Buddhas and the liberations of the wisdom of all Bodhisattvas; it enables all atoms within every land to universally contain the boundless Dharma-realm;
it accomplishes the ocean of all Buddha-merits and manifests the great ocean of the Tathāgatas' vows;
and it circulates and protects all the wheels of Dharma of all Buddhas, ensuring they never cease.
Just as in this world-system, the Bodhisattva Samantabhadra entered this samādhi before the World-Honored One;

so too, throughout the entire dharma-realm and the realm of empty space—in all ten directions and three periods of time—within every subtle and unobstructed, vast and luminous land seen by the Buddha-eye, reached by the Buddha’s power, and manifested by the Buddha-body, and within every atom of these lands, there are Buddha-fields as numerous as the atoms of an ocean of worlds; in each of these fields, there are Buddhas as numerous as the atoms of an ocean of worlds; and before each of those Buddhas, there are Bodhisattvas Samantabhadra as numerous as the atoms of an ocean of worlds, all of whom likewise enter this Samādhi of the Tathāgata Vairocana’s Treasury Body.
At that time, before each and every Samantabhadra Bodhisattva, all the Buddhas of the ten directions appeared.
Those Tathāgatas praised them with one voice, saying:
"Excellent! Excellent!"
Excellent! Son of good family,
you are able to enter this Bodhisattva samādhi of the Body-Treasury of Vairocana Tathāgata, which encompasses all Buddhas.
O Son of the Buddha!

This is because all Buddhas of the ten directions collectively empower you, by virtue of the power of Vairocana Tathāgata’s original vows, and also by virtue of the power of your own cultivation of the practices and vows of all Buddhas.
That is to say:
because they are able to turn all the wheels of the Dharma of the Buddhas;
and because they reveal and manifest the ocean of wisdom of all Tathāgatas.
Because it universally illumines all oceans of established worlds in the ten directions without exception;
because it causes all sentient beings to purify their defilements and attain purity;
and because it universally encompasses all great lands without attachment.
They enter deeply into the realm of all Buddhas because they are without obstruction;
they universally manifest the merits of all Buddhas;
and they are able to enter the true reality (*dharmatā*) of all phenomena, thereby increasing their wisdom.
Because they observe all gateways to the Dharma;
because they thoroughly understand the faculties of all sentient beings;
and because they are able to uphold the ocean of the scriptural teachings of all Buddhas and Tathāgatas.

At that time, all the Buddhas of the ten directions bestowed upon the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Samantabhadra the power of wisdom capable of entering the nature of all-knowledge; they bestowed the wisdom of entering the boundless measure of the Dharma-realm; they bestowed the wisdom of accomplishing the spheres of all Buddhas; they bestowed the wisdom of knowing the formation and destruction of all oceans of worlds; they bestowed the wisdom of knowing the vastness of all realms of sentient beings; they bestowed the wisdom of abiding in the non-differentiated samādhis of the profound liberation of all Buddhas; they bestowed the wisdom of entering the ocean of the faculties of all Bodhisattvas; they bestowed the wisdom of eloquence in turning the wheel of Dharma through the ocean of the languages of all sentient beings; they bestowed the wisdom of bodies that universally enter all oceans of worlds within the Dharma-realm; and they bestowed the wisdom of attaining the vocal resonance of all Buddhas.
In this world-system, before the Tathāgata, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva received such wisdom as granted by all Buddhas;
likewise, in all oceans of world-systems, and within every single atom of those oceans of world-systems, all Samantabhadras are exactly the same.
Why is this? Because the Dharma for realizing that samādhi is thus.
At that time, the Buddhas of the ten directions each extended their right hands and stroked the crown of Samantabhadra Bodhisattva’s head.
Their hands were all adorned with the marks and signs of excellence; exquisite webs of light radiated forth, and fragrant streams issued from blazing flames.
Furthermore, they produced the various sublime voices of all Buddhas, as well as accounts of their sovereign spiritual powers;

the ocean of Samantabhadra’s vows of all Bodhisattvas of the past, present, and future, the pure wheels of Dharma of all Tathāgatas, and all images of the Buddhas of the three periods of time—all appeared therein.
Just as in this world-system, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva is touched on the crown of his head by all the Buddhas of the ten directions;

so too, in all oceans of world-systems, and within every single atom of those oceans of world-systems, all Samantabhadras are likewise touched on the crown of their heads by all the Buddhas of the ten directions.
At that time, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva arose from this samādhi.
Upon arising from this samādhi, he arose from oceans of samādhi-gates as numerous as the atoms within all world-oceans.

That is to say: arising from the samādhi-door of skillful wisdom that knows the moments of thought throughout the three periods of time are without distinction; arising from the samādhi-door that knows all atoms within the entire dharma-realm of the three periods of time; arising from the samādhi-door that manifests all buddha-lands of the three periods of time; arising from the samādhi-door that manifests the dwellings of all sentient beings; arising from the samādhi-door that knows the ocean of the minds of all sentient beings; arising from the samādhi-door that knows the individual names of all sentient beings; arising from the samādhi-door that knows the distinct locations and positions of the dharma-realm in the ten directions; arising from the samādhi-door that knows that within every single atom there are clouds of infinite, vast buddha-bodies; and arising from the samādhi-door that expounds the ocean of the principles and methods of all dharmas.
When Samantabhadra Bodhisattva arose from such gateways of samādhi,

each of those bodhisattvas individually attained clouds of oceans of samādhis as numerous as the atoms in an ocean of worlds, clouds of oceans of dhāraṇīs as numerous as the atoms in an ocean of worlds,
clouds of oceans of skillful means regarding all dharmas as numerous as the atoms in an ocean of worlds, and oceans...
Clouds of oceans of gateways of eloquence as numerous as the atoms in an ocean; clouds of oceans of practices as numerous as the atoms in an ocean of worlds;
clouds of oceans of light of the wisdom-treasury of the merits of all Tathāgatas illuminating the entire dharma-realm as numerous as the atoms in an ocean of worlds;
and the undifferentiated power and wisdom of all Tathāgatas as numerous as the atoms in an ocean of worlds.
The ocean-cloud of diverse skillful means manifests within each and every pore of all Tathāgatas,
as numerous as the atoms in an ocean of worlds; from each of these pores, there appear clouds of myriad oceans of lands, as numerous as the atoms in an ocean of worlds,

wherein each and every Bodhisattva manifests the descent from the Tuṣita heaven, birth, attainment of Buddhahood, turning of the wheel of the sublime Dharma, and entry into parinirvāṇa, appearing as an ocean-cloud of such manifestations.
Just as in this world-system, when the Bodhisattva Samantabhadra arose from samādhi, the assembly of bodhisattvas obtained such benefits;
so it was in all oceans of worlds, and within every single atom of those oceans of worlds, it was exactly the same.
At that time, by the majestic spiritual power of all Buddhas and the power of Samādhi of the Bodhisattva Samantabhadra, all the oceans of worlds in the ten directions trembled slightly.
Each and every world was adorned with various jewels and emitted sublime sounds that expounded all dharmas.
Furthermore, throughout the ocean-like assemblies of all Tathāgatas’ places of enlightenment (*bodhimaṇḍa*), ten kinds of clouds of great *maṇi*-kings rained down everywhere.

What are these ten? They are: clouds of exquisite golden-star-bannered mani-kings; clouds of light-illuminating mani-kings; clouds of mani-kings with jeweled wheels suspended from them; clouds of mani-kings manifesting bodhisattva images from various jewel treasuries; clouds of mani-kings proclaiming the names of Buddhas; clouds of mani-kings whose blazing radiance universally illumines the sites of enlightenment in all Buddha-fields; clouds of mani-kings whose light manifests various transformations throughout the ten directions; clouds of mani-kings extolling the merits of all bodhisattvas; clouds of mani-kings as intensely radiant as the sun; and clouds of mani-kings whose delightful and pleasing sounds are heard throughout the ten directions.
After these ten kinds of great maṇi-king clouds had rained down everywhere, all the Tathāgatas emitted light from every pore of their bodies, and within that light they spoke these verses:
“Samantabhadra dwells pervasively in all lands, Seated upon a precious lotus, beheld by all;
There is no supernatural power he does not manifest, And he is able to enter infinite samādhis.”
Samantabhadra constantly manifests in various bodies, Pervading and filling the entire Dharma-realm;
Through the power of samādhi, supernormal faculties, and skillful means, He proclaims the universal sound extensively and without obstruction.
In the presence of all Buddhas throughout every land, they manifest various samādhis and supernatural powers;
each and every power pervades everywhere, reaching every single realm in the ten directions without exception.
As it is in the presence of all Tathāgatas in every land, so it is likewise within the atoms of those lands;
the manifestations of samādhi and supernormal powers are the result of Vairocana’s power of aspiration.
Samantabhadra’s physical form is like empty space; Abiding in reality, he does not dwell in a land.
According to the desires of the minds of all sentient beings, He manifests his universal body, equal to all.
Samantabhadra dwells securely in all great vows, And has attained this immeasurable power of spiritual penetration;
In all lands belonging to the bodies of all Buddhas, He manifests his form and proceeds to them all.
The oceans of all assemblies are boundless, and the emanated bodies dwelling therein are likewise immeasurable;
the lands they manifest are all pure and adorned, and within a single kṣaṇa, many eons are seen.
Samantabhadra dwells peacefully in all lands; The spiritual powers he manifests are supreme and peerless.
He causes the ten directions to tremble, reaching everywhere, So that all who behold him may see them.
Through the power of the wisdom and merit of all Buddhas, All various great dharmas are fully perfected;
By means of the gates of various samādhis and skillful methods, They reveal their own past practices for awakening.
Thus, with such inconceivable mastery, they manifest throughout the lands of the ten directions;
to reveal their universal entry into all samādhis, the Buddhas praise their merits from within clouds of light.
At that time, the entire assembly of bodhisattvas turned toward Samantabhadra, joined their palms, and gazed up at him. Empowered by the Buddha’s spiritual authority, they praised him with one voice:
“Born from the teachings of all Buddhas, And arisen through the power of the Tathāgata’s vows, O Treasury of Space, equal to True Suchness— You have already purified this Dharma-body.”
Within the assemblies of all Buddha-fields, Samantabhadra dwells everywhere;
he who is the radiance of the ocean of merit and wisdom shines equally throughout the ten directions, such that there is nowhere he is not seen.
Samantabhadra’s vast ocean of merit and virtue pervades the ten directions to attend upon the Buddhas;
within every single atom, he is able to reach all lands and manifest clearly therein.

O Son of the Buddha, we have constantly seen you; you have personally attended upon all the Tathāgatas, abiding within the true realm of samādhi throughout kalpas as numerous as the atoms of all lands.
The Sons of the Buddha, with their all-pervading bodies, Go to every land throughout the ten directions;
They deliver the vast ocean of sentient beings, Entering every atom within the dharma-realm.
Entering into every atom of the Dharma-realm, their bodies are inexhaustible and without distinction;
like space, they pervade everywhere, expounding the vast Dharma of the Tathāgata.
The Radiance of All Merit, vast and powerful like a cloud, supreme and extraordinary,
proceeds throughout the ocean of sentient beings to proclaim the peerless Dharma practiced by the Buddhas.
To deliver sentient beings throughout oceans of eons, I have cultivated all the supreme practices of Samantabhadra;
I manifest all dharmas like a great cloud, And my voice is so vast that there is nowhere it is not heard.
How are the buddha-fields established? How do the Buddhas appear,
as well as the ocean of all sentient beings?
I pray that you will speak according to the truth in accordance with its meaning.
Here, this immeasurable ocean-like assembly all stands before the Honored One in reverent attendance;
for the turning of the pure and wondrous wheel of Dharma, all Buddhas rejoice in unison.

Chapter Four: The Accomplishment of the World-System At that time, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Samantabhadra, through the spiritual power of the Buddha, universally observed the oceans of all world-systems, the oceans of all sentient beings, the oceans of all Buddhas, the oceans of all dharma-realms, the oceans of the karma of all sentient beings, the oceans of the faculties and desires of all sentient beings, the oceans of the wheels of Dharma of all Buddhas, the oceans of all three periods of time, the oceans of the power of the vows of all Tathāgatas, and the oceans of the miraculous transformations of all Tathāgatas.
Having observed these in this manner, he addressed the ocean-like assembly of Bodhisattvas at all the sites of enlightenment, saying:
"O Sons of the Buddha!
The Buddhas, the World-Honored Ones, possess inconceivable wisdom that knows the formation, destruction, and purification of all oceans of worlds;
they possess inconceivable wisdom that knows the ocean of karmic actions of all sentient beings; they possess inconceivable wisdom that knows the ocean of the established order of all dharma-realms;
and they possess inconceivable wisdom that proclaims the ocean of all boundless Buddhas.

The inconceivable wisdom that enters the ocean of all inclinations, understandings, and faculties; the inconceivable wisdom that universally knows all three periods of time in a single thought-moment;
the inconceivable wisdom that manifests the immeasurable ocean of vows of all Tathāgatas;
and the inconceivable wisdom that displays the ocean of all Buddhas' miraculous transformations—[with these,] they turn the wheel of Dharma.
The inconceivable wisdom, the inconceivable establishment and exposition of the ocean [of teachings], the inconceivable purity of the Buddha-body,
the inconceivable universal illumination of the ocean of boundless forms and marks, the inconceivable purity of all primary marks and secondary characteristics,
and the complete perfection of the ocean of wheels of light from boundless forms and marks.
The purity is inconceivable; the ocean of clouds of light from various forms and marks is inconceivable;
the ocean of supreme jewel flames is inconceivable; the ocean of accomplished speech and sounds is inconceivable;
and the manifestation of the three kinds of sovereign oceans to discipline and mature all sentient beings is inconceivable.
The inconceivable subduing of the ocean of sentient beings with heroic vigor, such that none pass by in vain; the inconceivable abiding in the stage of Buddhahood;
the inconceivable entry into the realm of the Tathāgatas; the inconceivable empowerment of majestic power for protection and sustenance;
the inconceivable contemplation of all that is practiced through the wisdom of the Buddhas; and the various powers.
The perfection that is invincible and inconceivable; the quality of fearlessness that none can surpass and is inconceivable;
the dwelling in the samādhi of non-differentiation and is inconceivable; the supernormal transformations and is inconceivable;
the pure, sovereign wisdom and is inconceivable; all the Buddha-dharmas that none can [overcome]...
They are inconceivable and indestructible.
Such dharmas as these, I shall fully proclaim by relying on the spiritual power of the Buddha and the majestic spiritual power of all Tathāgatas.
In order to cause sentient beings to enter the ocean of the Buddha’s wisdom;
in order to cause all bodhisattvas to attain stable dwelling within the ocean of the Buddha’s merits;
and in order to cause all oceans of worlds to be adorned by the sovereign power of all Buddhas.
In order that the lineage of the Tathāgatas may never be interrupted throughout the ocean of all kalpas;
in order to manifest the true nature of all phenomena within the ocean of all worlds;
and in order to expound the Dharma in accordance with the immeasurable oceans of understanding of all sentient beings;
In order to cause the various Buddha-dharmas to arise through skillful means in accordance with the ocean of the faculties of all sentient beings;
in order to shatter all mountains of obstacles in accordance with the ocean of the inclinations and desires of all sentient beings;
and in order to purify and cultivate the path of deliverance in accordance with the ocean of the mental activities of all sentient beings.
"It is for the sake of causing all bodhisattvas to dwell securely within the ocean of Samantabhadra’s vows.
At that time, the Bodhisattva Samantabhadra further desired to cause the ocean-like assemblies at the countless sites of enlightenment to give rise to joy,
to increase their love and delight for all dharmas, and to engender vast and true faith.
Because they understand the ocean [of phenomena], they cause the body of the treasury of the universal Dharma-realm to be purified;
because they establish the ocean of Samantabhadra’s vows; because they purify the eye of wisdom that enters into the equality of the three periods of time;
because they increase the great ocean of wisdom that universally illumines the treasury of all worlds; and because they give rise to the power of dhāraṇī to sustain all.
Because it is the Wheel of Dharma, which causes all Buddha-realms within every site of enlightenment to be fully revealed,
causes all the Dharma-gates of the Tathāgatas to be expounded, and causes the vast and profound nature of omniscience throughout the Dharma-realm to increase; he then spoke these verses:
The ocean of merit of profound wisdom universally manifests in the infinite lands of the ten directions;
according to what each sentient being should perceive, its radiance shines everywhere as it turns the wheel of Dharma.
The oceans of lands in the ten directions are inconceivable; throughout immeasurable eons, the Buddhas have adorned and purified them all.
To bring sentient beings to maturity through transformation, they appear in every single realm.
The realm of the Buddha is profoundly deep and difficult to conceive; he reveals it universally to all sentient beings so that they may enter it.
Yet those whose minds delight in the small and cling to various states of existence cannot penetrate what the Buddha has realized.
If one possesses pure faith and a firm mind, And always draws near to spiritual friends, All Buddhas will grant them their power; Thus one is able to enter the wisdom of the Tathāgata.
Free from all flattery and deceit, with a pure mind, Always delighting in compassion and naturally joyful,
Those of vast aspiration and deep faith— Upon hearing this Dharma, they give rise to joy.
Abiding in the stage of Samantabhadra’s vows, practicing the pure path of the bodhisattvas,
and observing the dharma-realm as being like space— this is how one can know the sphere of the Buddha’s activity.
These bodhisattvas have attained a sublime benefit, beholding all the Buddha’s supernormal powers;
those who practice other paths cannot know them, for only the practitioners of Samantabhadra can realize them.
Sentient beings are vast and boundless; the Tathāgata protects and mindfully regards them all.
The turning of the true wheel of Dharma reaches everywhere—this is the power of Vairocana’s realm.
All buddha-fields enter my body, and the Buddhas who dwell therein do likewise;
you should observe all my pores, for I now reveal to you the realm of the Buddhas.
The practices and vows of Samantabhadra are boundless; I have cultivated them until they are fully perfected.
This vast body within the realm of the Universal Eye— Listen attentively to this, the conduct of the Buddha.
At that time, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Samantabhadra addressed the great assembly, saying:
"O Children of the Buddha!
There are ten kinds of matters concerning the oceans of worlds, which all Buddhas of the past, present, and future have spoken, are speaking, and will speak."

What are these ten?
